tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// bsang mchod kyi rim pa rnams phyogs gcig tu bsdebs pa phan bde bdud rtsi'i gter mdzod ces bya ba bzhugs so//

a kā ro sa byin gyis brlabs la/ rin chen las grub snod yangs par// 'dod yon lnga ldan gtor ma ni// zad mi shes pa nam mkha'i mdzod// rgya chen rgyun mi chad par gyur// kyai/ chos dbyings skye ba med pa las// longs sku 'gag med cir yang 'char// sprul pas 'khor ba dong sprugs mdzod// 'phags mchog 'jig rten mgon po bsang*// gang 'dul thabs kyi skur bzhengs pa'i// tshe dpal ye shes skyed pa mo// rgyal ba kun gyi yum gyur ma// rje btsun sgrol ma'i lha tshogs bsang*// rgyal ba'i bstan pa bsrung ba'i phyir// 'dul dka' dregs can 'joms mdzad pa// dam chos mi nub rgyal mtshan bsgrengs// rdo rje ber can lcam dral bsang*// gzhan yang snying po'i bstan srung ba// rang phyogs bsrung zhing phas rgol 'joms// dam tshig bka' yi mna' bor ba// jo bo ma ki rgod mgo bsang*// gnas chen nyer bzhi dur khrod brgyad// yul chen so gnyis la gnas pa'i// dkar phyogs skyong bar zhal bzhes pa'i// mthu chen chos kyi srung ma bsang*// khyed rnams mchod pa'i yon tan gyis// gangs can skyabs gcig karma pa'i// phrin las lhun grub bstan pa spel// 'gro rnams dpal 'byor rgyas par mdzod// bstod par 'os pa sogs brjod nas/ bag chags 'khrul pa'i dbang gyur te// nyes par gyur pa'i tshogs rnams bshags// thams cad rang gi gnas su gshegs// dus su slar yang 'byon par gsol// gats+tsha sa gshegs/ bkra shis dpal 'bar 'dzam gling rgyan// mnga' ris rgyal khams bod kyi yul// kha ba can gyi byang phyogs su// chos sgrub brgyud kyi bstan pa dar bar shog /'dzam gling bde ba'i bkra shis shog /'dzam gling bde bar mdzad du gsol// zhes shis brjod dang*/ bsngo smon bya/ zhes pa gnas mdo'i dge slong karma rnam rgyal gyis rten dang bcas bskul bar brten/ si tu'i ming 'dzin gyis dpal gyi mtshur phu'i gan+dho lar bris pa skye 'gro thams cad la dge bar gyur cig// /

༈ mgon khang rgyun bsang las bzhi myur grub ces pa bzhugs/ rtsa gsum 'dus zhal rdo rje nag po chen po la na maḥ 'dir ye shes mgon po ber can lcam dral 'khor dang bcas pa mnga' gsol zhing bsang mchod 'bul ba mdor bsdus kyi rim pa ni/ dam tshig dang ldan pa'i sgrub pa pos/ rten bshams pa'i drung du/ dam rdzas gtor ma/ sman dang rak+ta'i argaṃ/ nyer spyod mchod pa/ phye mar 'bru sna dang sman sna/ phud sna dar sna tshogs/ rin chen phye ma/ gzhan yang spyan gzigs dkor chas kyi rigs dang*/ dar nag gi ba dan bsgreng*/ dri bzang po bdug pa'i bye brag dang*/ gsur chen gyi dud pa btang la/ dang po mchod rdzas byin brlab ni/ rang lhar gsal ba'i ngang*/ oṃ ā bigh+nan sogs kyis bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs la/ stong pa'i ngang las yam̐ las rlung dkyil steng*// ram̐ las me dkyil kam̐ las thod sgyed gsum// de dbus a las bhan+dha'i snod yangs par// go ku da ha na las sha lnga dang*// bi mu ma ra shu las bdud rtsi lnga// so sor yi ge de dag mtshan pa'o// rlung me'i sbyor bas rdzas kyi nyes skyon sbyangs// 'bru gsum 'phro 'dus ye shes bdud rtsir gyur// oṃ ā hūm̐/ lan gsum/ rol chen dang bcas/ gu ru de wa ḍā ki ni dharma pā la sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ ma hā ka la kā la ya/ de wa rak+ṣa dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ 'dir shog 'dir shog /a gats+tsha ya a gats+tsha ya/ hūm̐ ya dzaḥ hūm̐ ya dzaḥ rnga 'grigs dbyangs dang bcas/ hūm̐/ chos dbyings rnam dag pho brang nas// skyabs gnas bka' brgyud bla ma rnams// rnal 'byor gdung bas spyan 'dren na// 'dir gshegs mnga' gsol mchod pa bzhes// rang bzhin lhun grub zhing khams nas// yi dam dpa' bo ḍā ki'i tshogs// rnal 'byor= 'dir gshegs= 'og min byang phyogs dur khrod nas// dpal ldan rdo rje nag po che// rnal 'byor= 'dir gshegs= byang shar thod mkhar brtsegs pa nas// rdo rje nag mo re ma ti// rnal 'byor=

'dir gshegs= phrin las rnam bzhi'i dkyil 'khor nas// dpal mgon phyag bzhi bya rog gdong*// rnal 'byor= 'dir gshegs= 'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa yi// chos skyong srung ma ma lus pa// rnal 'byor= 'dir gshegs= mi 'gyur bka' gsang rdo rje yi// dam tshig gnyan po'i gzhal yas nas// rgyal chen rnam mang thos sras mchog /dam can skyes bu rdo rje legs// ga ya dha ra yab yum 'khor// srin mgon nag po thod phreng can// rnal 'byor= 'dir gshegs= klu rgyal jo bo sngags kyi bdag /dge bsnyen badz+ra rā dza che// dbyings phyug a phyi chos kyi sgron// bkra shis tshe yi dpal ster ma// lha sman rgyal mo mched lnga dang*// bod khams skyong ma bcu gnyis kyang*// rnal 'byor= 'dir gshegs= btsan rgod rdo rje dbang drag 'bar// sa brgyad sems dpa' lha chen gtso// thang lha yar zhur sras 'khor bcas// rma rgyal spom ra mched lcam dpung*// sku lha ger mdzo 'bri gnyan ldang*// zil phrom rdo rgyal mu nam sogs// rnal 'byor= 'dir gshegs= thub bstan chos 'khor gnyan srung ba// zo dor dbu che brag dkar ni// rdo rje dpal skyong rtsal zhes grags// dgyes sde sras 'khor sgo ba bzhi// smug sangs rtse rgyal zhal da sogs// dkar phyogs gzhi gnas yul bdag rnams// rnal 'byor= 'dir gshegs= zhes dang*/ de nas bsang khang du phye mar la sogs 'bru sman gyi rigs rnams gsum cha 'bul zhing*/ gtor ma dang gser skyems nam mkhar mchod la/ kyai/ 'khor 'das mnyam nyid spros bral klong*// skye med chos sku'i rang gdangs rtsal// 'gags med longs sku'i dkyil 'khor shar// gnas med sprul pa'i rol pa las// 'byung lnga rnam dag yum lnga'i dbyings// khams lnga 'dus pa'i rten 'brel gyis// snang srid snod bcud lhun gyis rdzogs// rab 'byams 'jig rten bkod pa gsal// dzam+bu bṛk+ṣas mtshan pa'i zhing*// sangs rgyas chos kyi dpal g.yang ldan// byang phyogs gangs ri'i phreng bskor ba'i// sman ljongs sna tshogs skyed tshal mdzes// dri bsung spos ngad ldang pa yi// bdud rtsi can shing rnam mang po// rin chen bsang khang zlum 'khyil dbus// 'bar g.yo'i 'phrul gyi dud pa'i sprin// phyogs kyi go skabs 'phrog byed pa'i// bkra shis rdzas rtags rgyal srid bdun// mtho ris dbang po'i longs spyod kyi// legs byas rang gzugs ci yang 'char// dag gtsang yid 'ong nyer spyod bdun// mtha' klas rgyas par 'gengs pa dang*// īn+d+ra snyil gyi yol go ru// dza gad dang sbyar gser g.yu'i skyems// bcud ldan dkar mngar bda' dgu'i phud// tshe gal mthun bsdebs dpang re mtho// dar sna bal tshon mdangs re gsal// spyan gzigs dkor chas rngams shing brjid// sha chen gtor ma ri ltar spungs// khrag chen ar+ghaṃ mtsho ltar bskyil// gsur chen dud pa sprin ltar gtibs// 'dod yod sna tshogs gcal du bkram// dar nag rgyal mtshan ba dan bsgrengs// rol mo sil snyan 'brug stong ldir// ting 'dzin mchod pa bsam mi khyab// gsol lo mchod do mnga' gsol lo// kyai/

'gro ba'i mgon gyur thugs rje'i bdag /dkon mchog kun 'dus ngo bo nyid// rtsa brgyud bla ma mnga' gsol lo// yi dam lha tshogs= /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro= /ye shes mgon po= ma hā kā la= /lha chen dpal 'bar= /legs ldan nag po= /mkha' 'gro'i gtso bo mnga'= /rig 'dzin srung ma mnga'= /rnal 'byor dgra lha= /dam nyams srog gcod= /'jigs byed chen mo= /ma gcig lha mo= /za byed chen mo= /dbugs len bcu drug= /phyogs bcu mgon po= /dregs pa don gnyis= /dregs pa rnam gsum= /ma bdun sring bzhi= /'bar dus lha mo= /dmag gi rgyal mo= /dbang phyug nyer brgyad= brtan ma bcu gnyis= /sprul dang yang sprul= /hūm̐/ dpal mgon phyag bzhi mnga' gsol lo// las mgon bya gdong= /rgyal chen rnam sras= /badz+ra sadhu= /dpal ldan zhing skyong = /srin mgon thod phreng= /ma dros bdag po= /klu rgyal mkhar nag= /dharma tā ra= /tshe ring mched lnga= /btsan rgod 'bar ba= /dri za'i rgyal po= /rma rgyal spom ra= /ger mdzo gnyan po= rdo rje blo gros// rdo rje g.yung drung= /mu nam mched brgyad= /rdo rje dpal skyong= /smug sangs dge bsnyen= /rtse rgyal zhal da= /gzhan yang yul ris sa phyogs 'dir// gnas pa'i sa bdag klu gnyan tshogs// gnyug gnas glo bur lhags pa rnams// mnga' gsol bsang mchod dgyes par rol// gsol dang mchod pa'i byin rlabs kyis// bsam pa sgrubs la re ba skongs// bar du gcod pa mtha' dag sel// dngos grub ma lus kun stsol cig / de nas 'dod don gsol zhing phrin las bcol ba ni/ skyems phud 'thor bzhin pas/ kyai/ gsol lo mchod do// drin chen rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams dang*/ yi dam dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs rnams dang*/ dpal ye shes kyi mgon po ma hā kā la/ bdud 'dul rdo rje'i ded dpon/ 'jigs byed chen po ber nag po can/ ye shes kyi mgon po/

las kyi mgon po/ 'jig rten gyi mgon po/ yab legs ldan nag po/ sku yi mgon po/ gsung gi mgon po/ thugs kyi mgon po/ yon tan gyi mgon po/ phrin las kyi mgon po/ dpal ldan lha mo rang byung gi rgyal mo/ 'dod pa khams kyi dbang phyug ma/ re ma ti/ re ma dza/ re ma dzu/ dbugs len gyi shan pa yab yum bcu drug /phyogs skyong ba'i mgon po bcu/ dregs pa'i gtso bo bdun cu rtsa gnyis/ myur mgyogs kyi dregs pa rkya gsum/ ma bdun sring bzhi/ 'bar ma dgu/ dus la 'char ba'i lha mo bzhi/ dmag gi rgyal mo chen mo bzhi/ dbang phyug ma nyer brgyad/ rdo rje'i brtan ma bcu gnyis/ gzhan yang sprul pa yang sprul nying sprul dam can rgya mtsho'i dmag tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams gsol lo mchod do// dpal khrag 'thung gi rgyal po phyag bzhi pa/ las mgon bya rog gi mtshan can/ rgyal chen ngal bsos po/ skyes bu badz+ra thig le rtsal/ zhing skyong kun dga' gzhon nu/ laṅka dur khrod bdag po/ klu rgyal sog ma med/ dge bsnyen rdo rje rgyal po/ sna nam lha'i lcam mo/ bkra shis tshe ring ma mched lnga/ mthu chen rdo rje brag btsan la sogs yab yum sras 'khor bka' sdod pho nya'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams gsol lo mchod do// gangs can bod kyi bstan srung khyab 'jug gnam mtsho'i bdag po/ sa brgyad dbang phyug rma rgyal rdo rje bdud 'joms/ srid pa'i lha chen a bo ger mdzo/ 'bri gnyan ldang badz+ra ma ti la sogs dkar phyogs skyong ba'i yul lha zo dor mthu bo che rnams dang*/ gdan sa gnas mchog 'di nyid kyi yul dang gzhi'i bdag po dbu che brag dkar gnyan po la sogs pa rang la rigs kyi 'go ba'i lha dang srung ma byams pa'i sems dang ldan pa rnams gsol lo mchod do// gsol zhing mchod pa la brten nas bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi rdo rje slob dpon sku tshe ring bar gyur cig

/mched dang lcam dral la na tsha med par gyur cig /sgrub pa po bdag cag gi sbyin pa'i zas zo/ bcol ba'i las gyis/ gdams pa'i ngag nyon/ dgos pa'i don sgrubs/ sdang byed kyi dgra sod/ gnod byed kyi bgegs thul/ bar chad kyi rkyen zlog /sdod sa'i gnas mal srungs/ mkho ba'i yo byad srungs/ brgyud 'dzin gyi slob ma srungs/ lus dang grib ma bzhin du mi 'bral bar 'grogs la/ bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod cig / ces brjod/ tshar grangs bton na slar yang gong gi bsang gzhung dang phrin bcol bcas kyi grangs 'dzin la/ rjes mar yang skyems phud phye mar 'bul zhing 'dod gsol spyi 'gro 'di'ang bya ste/ sangs rgyas bstan srungs dkon mchog dbu 'phang bstod// dge 'dun sde skyongs rnal 'byor tshe dpal spel// snyan pa'i dar phyor grags pa'i dung bus la// 'khor dang longs spyod rgyas pa nyid du mdzod// rgas med lang tsho ldan pa'i lus stobs rgyas// mig la ya mtshan ltad mo'i dga' ba dang// rna bar rtag tu snyan pa'i gtam thos shing*// dri zhim ngad pa sna dang mi 'bral bar// zas skom 'byor pas ro 'dzin tshim byed cing*// lus la reg bya bde ba kho nas 'tsho// yid la rnam par bkra ba'i shes rab dang*// zag med bde bas nam yang ngom par mdzod// khyod gsol khyod brten khyod mchod khyod rbad na// mthu rtsal ma chung brtse gdung che bar mdzod// gzhi la bkra shis phun tshogs longs spyod ldan// byes su lam 'phrang chu la sgrol 'don mdzod// 'jigs sar dgra jag chom rkun 'tshe ba skyobs// mdor na bsam don yid bzhin grub par mdzod// ces dang*/ bdag dang mtha' yas sems can thams cad kyis// bla med rdzogs pa'i byang chub bsgrub pa la// 'gal rkyen bar chad ma lus zhi ba dang*// mthun rkyen bsam don lhun gyis grub par mdzod// ces dang*/ srid zhi'i dpal 'byor ma lus 'byung ba'i gzhi// thub pa'i bstan pa yun ring gnas pa dang*// de 'dzin byed pa'i skyes bu dam pa rnams// dpal 'byor gyis brgyan yun ring zhabs brtan shog

/bdag cag yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa la// tshe ring nad med bde skyid phun sum tshogs// don rnams thams cad yid bzhin 'grub pa dang*// 'gro ba'i don la mthu dang ldan par mdzod// lha rnams nongs pa gang mchis bzod par bzhes// ye shes rten bzhugs 'jig rten rang gnas gshegs// 'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa'i dge legs tshogs// gong nas gong du 'phel ba'i bkra shis shog / ces bde legs kyi me tog 'thor bar bya'o// zhes pa'ang mgon khang chen mor rgyun bsang khyer bde 'di bzhin/ rje mkha' spyod pas mdzad pa'i mnga' gsol byin rlabs kyi khyad par gzhir bkod nas/ mchod 'os kha skong sogs kyi skor rnams si tu pas dge bskos karma lhas skyabs kyi bzhed ngor spel ba dge bar gyur cig dza yan+tu/// / ༈ dbu che'i bsang dgos 'dod char 'bebs bzhugs/ oṃ badz+ra s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ/ lan gsum gyis byin brlabs la/ lha rdzas 'dod dgu'i longs spyod kyi// bsang mchod zag med bde chen gyur// rang nyid lhar gsal thugs ka nas// 'od 'phros gnas bdag tshogs spyan drangs// bhu mi pa ti sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa ma dzaḥ kyai/ dzam+bu bṛk+ṣa'i byang rol na// gangs can mdo khams gling khri smad// 'bri rgyal chos phyug skyong ba'i yul// dal 'gro gser ldan klung gi ngogs// sbas gnas a ta rong gi char// thub bstan shrī ni kā ra// bsrung bar smon lam las grub lha// rab dkar ston zla cha gang ba// 'od 'tsher lta bu'i sra brtan gyi// lhun chags rdo rje pha lam brag /kai la sha yi mdangs 'phrog pa// phyi ltar mthong ba kun smon zhing*// nang ltar lha klu'i rin chen gyi// pho brang yid 'ong lta na sdug /gsang ltar rgyal ba rgya mtsho yi// dkyil 'khor gdod nas rang byung grub// gnas zhing skyong ba'i zo dor gnyen// dbu che rdo rje dpal skyong rtsal// dar thod dar ber g.yas ba dan// g.yon par gter bum phywa g.yang 'gugs// g.yas g.yon dpa' chas dgra la rngam// cang shes dung mdog rlung shugs bcib// dgyes sde sras dang sgo srung bzhi// dkar po lha yi dpung tshogs bskor// khyung 'brug stag seng lding dang 'phyo// sprin dang na bun dbyar rnga ldir// rin chen īn+d+ra'i mdangs ldan pa'i// rdza brag ri dbang gnas 'cha' ba'i// smug sangs mtsho sman 'khor bcas dang*// mar gad zhun ma dang mtshungs pa'i// sa 'dzin dpal g.yang can gyi bdag

/rtsa rgyal zhal da sras yum 'khor// kun kyang dam tshig rdo rje yi// bka' bsgos rjes dran 'dir gshegs bzhugs// dgyes rdzas mchod pa 'bul ba ni// bzang shing rigs dgu'i bsang dud las// mchod pa'i bye brag ci yang sprul// bkra shis rdzas rtags 'dod yon lnga// dkar gsum mngar gsum rin chen sman// 'bru sna phye mar gser skyems rdzas// dza gad phud sna go khrab dang*// dar gos rgyan chas rkang 'gro'i rigs// gnod sbyin dkor bas ches lhag pa// phyogs kyi go skabs 'gog byed pa'i// bdug spos sprin chen g.yo ba dang*// rang bzhin rnam dag bsung ngad ldang*// phyi snod nang bcud dri ma bsang*// nyams gyur nyes tshogs byang gyur cig /mthu stobs rtsal gyis pha rol gnon// lha yi dge bsnyen 'khor bcas bstod// sngon tshe pad 'byung byang chub gling*// grub chen pak+ṣi chos kyi 'byung*// spyan sngar dam mnos yal gam can// deng 'dir tha tshig brtser dgongs la// sgrub brgyud bstan dang bstan 'dzin skyongs// rnal 'byor bsam don lhun grub par// legs pa'i rgyal kha bstod pa dang*// sdong grogs rgyab brten mel tshe mdzod// mi 'bral rtag par srung zhing skyobs// rnam bzhi'i phrin las ma g.yel sgrubs// rgyal bstan mi nub rgyal mtshan mchog /srid rtser bsgreng pa'i bkra shis kyi// nyi zla dpal du 'bar ba yi// rnam kun phun tshogs khyab gyur cig /sarba bhū ta gats+tsha/

zhes pa'ang si tu pad+ma nyin byed dbang pos/ dge bshes karma tshe ring bzhed ltar spel/ sarba maṅga lam/// / ༈ 'bri rgyal gnyan ldang dang mu nam bcas kyi bsang mchod rin chen char 'bebs zhes pa bzhugs/ na mo ma hā gu ru rat+na pad+mā ka ra ye/ 'dir dkar po lha'i sde dpon rigs chos rgyud srung 'bri rgyal gnyan po dang*/ rdo rgyal bcas la bsang mchod spro bas dang po dkon mchog gi rten drung du bsang gzhung gang yin de'i dgos chas spyi dang bye brag pa gang dgos rnams 'du byas la/ dmigs bsal gzhi dkar po'i steng du 'bru dkar gyis g.yung drung g.yas 'khyil gnyis phan tshun du bkod/ de steng mañji lta bu'i khar dkar bshos gtso 'khor lnga tshom can/ rtser nyi zlas brgyan ba gnyis la/ dar sna/ stag gzig ras mo/ khyung dang seng ge g.yu 'brug /bya dang ri dwags g.yung dwags la sogs dkor nor gzugs 'gros rigs spar du btab pa mang pos brgyan cing bskor/ mchod yon sogs nyer spyod kyi mchod pa dang*/ grangs ci tsam 'don na de la dkar gtor gnyis re dang*/ phud phor gtsang mar gser skyems/ rin chen phye ma/ sman sna/ 'bru sna/ zas sna/ yos bkra/ phye mar/ ja chang*/ dkar phud sogs bshams/ bsang khang du bzang shing spos sman gang 'dzoms kyi rigs rnams spungs shing*/ bsang gzhung spyi ltar bton la skabs mtshams zhig tu/ slar yang mchod rdzas rnams/ oṃ badz+ra a mri ta sa bsangs/ oṃ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rin chen bsang khang bzang*// rab dkar zlum 'khyil de dbus dri bsung ngad// rmad byung sman spos bdud rtsi can gyi shing*// rnam mang bdug pa'i sprin phung phyogs kun khyab// gzhan yang skabs gsum gdengs can mi'i 'gro ba'i// longs spyod mkho dgu'i yo byad dpag tu med// mchod rdzas dngos po bzang zhing rgya che ba// mtha' klas zad mi shes pa nam mkha'i mdzod// kun bzang ting 'dzin smon lam las grub pa'i// 'dod pa'i yon tan bsam mi khyab par gyur/

oṃ a ka ro sa lan gsum byin brlabs la/ kyai/ skyabs gnas thugs rje'i bdag nyid can// skal bzang zhing gi 'dren pa mchog /stong dang rtsa gnyis 'byon pa'i gnas// lho rgyal dzam gling dbus 'gyur 'chang*// rgya gar 'phags yul rdo rje gdan// byang gi char brten gangs can ljongs// 'jig rten dbang phyug gdul bya'i zhing*// bod chen mdo khams gling khri smad// 'bri rgyal chos kyi 'phen phyug gis// skyong ba'i sbas yul a ta rong*// rjes 'brel chu bo gser ldan ngogs// rin chen sa 'dzin mar gad mdangs// mtho la brjid cing rdza dang brag /sra brtan gzhom bral rdo rje'i rdzong*// sngon tshe dpal chen he ru kas// bdud btul gsang sngags chos 'khor bskor// bar du pad+ma thod phreng gis// byin gyis brlabs shing zab gter sbas// tha mar las can chos bdag gis// gnas gter sgo 'byed 'gro don skyong*// gdod nas rnam dag sa spyod zhing*// mthong thos reg pa tsam gyis kyang*// bde chen thar pa'i lam la sbyor// rtsa ba brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams// thugs rje'i chu 'dzin thibs se thib// yi dam ḍā ki'i dkyil 'khor gsal// dngos grub sbrang char si li li// chos skyong dam can gzhi gnas bdag /myur mgyogs phrin las sprin sgra sgrogs// ngo mtshar mngon 'phags bkod legs kyi// dge mtshan re khā ci yang 'char// sna tshogs rin chen las grub pa'i// pho brang gzhal yas nyams re dga'// sa gsum dpal 'byor 'dod dgu'i mdzod// gnod sbyin nor dbang 'gran bzod pa// dkar po lha yi sde dpon che// sangs rgyas bstan srung phas rgol 'joms// ri dbang spun dgu'i ya gyal du// grags ldan chos kyi bden mthong ba// 'bri rgyal rdo rje blo gros ni// rab dkar ston zla dang mtshungs pa// mtho ris bdag po'i khengs 'phrog byed// zhi 'dzum sgeg pa'i nyams dang ldan /dar dkar thod bcings rin po che'i// snyan rgyan mgul rgyan do shal 'phyangs// phyag g.yas ba dan dkar po 'phyar// bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan srid rtser bsgreng*// g.yon pas bcud bkang rin chen bum// sgrub la dngos grub char ltar 'bebs// lha yi reg bya kun+da'i mdog

/lhab lhub dar gyi na bza' dang*// mdangs ldan rma bya'i ber thul gsol// zhabs zung rin chen mchil lham mdzes// dar stan gser sga rin chen rgyan// cang shes ngang dkar rtsal ldan chibs// phyi nang gsang ba'i dgyes sde dang*// sras lcam mched 'khor sprul pa dang*// yang sprul dpung gi tshogs dang bcas// rigs mthun rgyan dang cha lugs rnams// ma nges sna tshogs so sor ston// sngon gyi thugs dam dran mdzod la// gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol// kyai/ sangs rgyas chos kyi bka' nyan pa// shar phyogs mnga' ris dbang bsgyur zhing*// stobs kyi dpung pas legs brten pa'i// rdo rgyal mu nam mched brgyad po// kai lā sha yi lhun po la// gnas bcas lha yi dga' tshal bzhin// rkang 'thung ljon pa sman dang ni// me tog mtsho rdzing nyal 'gro'i rgyun// dus bzhir las bzhi'i kha dog bsgyur// 'dab chags ri dwags spu sdug rnams// 'tshe ba dang bral bag yangs rgyu// nang ltar rin chen khang bzang mdzes// dbyibs legs yid 'ong lta na sdug /der bzhugs lha yi dge bsnyen ni// rdo rje g.yung drung dpa' rab 'bar// mdog dkar dgyes pa'i 'dzum zhal g.yo// sku la dung khrab dar ber bklubs// dung rmog khyung dar stag 'phru ldem// sna tshogs rin chen phreng bas brgyan// phyag g.yas dar dkar ba dan dang*// g.yon pas rat+na'i gzhong pa bsnams// stag gdong gzig shubs ral gri sogs// 'khor gsum sked bskor za 'og gi /lham gsol dung rta g.yu rngog can// rin chen sga srab dar stan mdzes// rlung gi rtsal ldan chibs su bcibs// mched dang btsun mo sras 'khor rnams// rnam 'gyur cir yang ston cing bsgyur// mchod pa'i gnas 'dir spyan 'dren na// ma thogs myur bar gshegs su gsol// oṃ bhū mi pa ti lo ka pā la sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa ma ya dza dzaḥ zhes snyan pa'i dbyangs dang rol mo bcas kyis spyan 'dren la/

de nas bzhugs su gsol ba ni/ kyai/ sku mkhar 'phrul gyi lding khang rgya re che// sna tshogs rin chen khri bshams bkod re legs// pad+ma 'dab rgyas zla gdan mdangs re gsal// spyan gzigs dkor chas rnams ni lhab ma lhub// dgyes rdzas 'dod yon longs spyod spungs se spungs// lha chen 'khor bcas brtan par bzhugs su gsol// sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan/ de nas rang yi dam du gsal ba'i ngang nas spyi bor rdo rje bzhag par dmigs nas dam la bzhag pa ni/ hrīḥ sngon tshe kun bzang che mchog he ru kas// dkyil 'khor dbang bsgyur bka' yi srung mar bskos// bar du mtsho skyes pad+ma rgyal po'i drung*// khas blangs dam bcas zab gter gnyer kha gtad// tha mar rig 'dzin rtsa brgyud bla ma yi// spyan sngar bka' bsgos dam la bzhag pa'i tshe// sangs rgyas bstan pa srung bar ma chad dam// sgrub mchog skyong bar zhal bzhes ma lags sam// rdo rje'i tha tshig ma g.yel rjes dgongs la// deng 'dir chos kyi brgyud 'dzin rnal 'byor pas// dam tshig dbang gis gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gyi// bshams pa'i gdan la dgyes par bzhugs nas kyang*// mnyes pa'i mchod pa dam pa 'bul lags na// yal gam gnyan la ma 'da' sa ma ya// bhū mi pa ti sa pa ri wā re bh+yaḥs ma ya rak+ṣan+tu/ de nas mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ thal mo sbyar nas sangs rgyas kyi yon tan rjes su dran bzhin pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen mang la phyag 'tshal lo// de bzhin du/ gzugs mdzes dam pa la= sku 'byams klas la= 'jigs pa thams cad dang bral ba la= mchod sbyin gyi phyag rgya dang bcas/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo ki te oṃ sam+bha ra sam+bha ra hūm̐/ lan gsum gyis bsngo zhing*/ kye ho/ lha yi dge bsnyen chen po sman btsun sde// sras lcam sprul 'khor bcas pa thams cad dang*// zo dor mu nam mched brgyad rang rigs sde// chu shel nor bu'i 'dzum dkar rab 'tsher ba'i// dgyes zhal 'od snang phreng ba ngoms par mdzod// 'chi med bdud rtsi can shing rnam mang po// ma la ya klung dri bzhon dang mtshungs pa// 'bar g.yo'i 'du byed mkha' yi glang po dang*// dbang gzhu ltar bkra'i zer ma re re las// bkra shis rdzas rtags brgyad dang rgyal srid bdun// nye ba'i rin chen 'dod yon rnam pa lnga// dngos su 'byor dang yid kyis sprul nas su// zag med bde ba chen po skyed byed pa'i// mchod pa'i sprin phung rab 'byams mtha' klas pa// kun tu dkrigs pas zhing rnams bkang byas te// bsang mchod dgyes pa chen pos bzhes su gsol// rol mtsho bdun gyi dpal la co 'dri ba'i// yid la sim pa ster ba'i dal 'bab rgyun// dag gtsang dri med yan lag brgyad ldan chab// 'bul gyi thugs dam dbang gis bzhes su gsol// mtho ris me na ka yi spyod yul las// khyad 'phags steng 'thung rnam pa sna tshogs pa// 'dab rgyas ge sar bzhad pa'i skyed tshal rnams// 'bul gyi zag med bde bas tshim par mdzod// ha ri tsan+dan ljon pa'i nags klung ngogs// skyi bser dal bus bskul 'dra'i ngad ldang ba// dri bsung phun tshogs spos kyi bye brag 'thul// 'bul bzhes grib dang mi gtsang sel gyur cig

/phyogs kyi go skabs gsal bar byed pa yi// rin chen sgron me'i bye brag ji snyed pa// srid pa'i snang byed 'od zer dang mtshungs 'di// 'bul gyi dgyes pa chen pos rol par mdzod// gang zhig reg pas bde ba'i dpal ster byed// ga bur tsan+dan sih+la gur gum dang*// a ga ru sogs byug pa'i rnam pa gang*// 'bul bzhes nyams chag bskang zhing dag gyur cig /lha mi'i zhal zas ro bcud brgya ldan pa'i// bza' btung bca' ba bldag gzhib mchis so cog /ri ltar spungs shing mtsho ltar bskyil ba 'di// 'bul gyi g.yar dam gnyen po bskang gyur cig /gan+dhar dpal mo'i dbyangs la snyems ster zhing*// mi'am ci yi skad gdangs zil gnon pa'i// sgra snyan rol mo'i bye brag ci yang ldir// thos 'dzin dpyid du dgyes brtser rol par mdzod// oṃ ma hā de wa u pa si ka sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke/ gan+dhe/ ne wid+ya/ shab+da pra tī ts+tsha ye swā hā/ zhes rol mo'i rigs rnams gang yod bsgrags la/ de nas skyems dang phye mar gtor ma la sogs mthun rdzas rnams 'bul ba ni/ ho/ rin chen bai ḍūr+ya yi yol go ru// dza gad dpa' bo'i nying khu rgya mtshor 'khyil// gser dngul g.yu sogs rin chen 'bru sna sman// rmad byung bcud len lta bur dgyes par rol// rin chen īn+d+ra nī la'i snod yangs par// rtsi bcud yongs 'du dkar phud gtsang ma dang*// tsī na'i ljon 'dab las byung phud rgod skyems// 'bul bzhes thugs kyi dgyes pa bskang gyur cig /ba liṃ dkar bshos ri ltar zangs se zang// rtse rgyan nyi zla'i mdangs 'od ta la la// dar sna stag ras gzig ras lhabs se lhab// khyung 'brug 'dab chags rnams ni 'phur lding 'phyo// gdong lnga'i dbang dang stag gzig gcan gzan rnams// gtum zhing rngam pa'i ngar skad sgrog cing rgyu// ri dwags gnag phyugs khyu chen me re re// phye mar zas phud rnams ni spungs se spungs// nam mkha' mda' 'phang rgyang bu ldems se ldem// shel tshig khri dkar stong nag rkang 'gros rigs// rta g.yag ra lug du mar sprul pa dang*// go mtshon dpa' rtags rngam chas skyi g.ya' bar// gzhan yang lha mi'i dkor nor bsam yas pa// bkod legs tshar du dngar ba lta na sdug

/rgya chen rgyun mi chad par blos blangs nas// rnam dag thugs dam gnyan po bskang phyir 'bul// khyad par zhi ba bsang gi dud sprin 'dis// dkar phyogs lha klu sde brgyad thams cad la// snyigs lnga'i dus kyi sems can spyod ngan dbang*// gnas dang gzhi yi bdag rnams nyams shing gud// 'khrul dris nongs pas bslad pa'i dam grib dang*// mkhon grib dme grib dag gtsang sangs gyur cig /phog thug 'gal bar gyur pa gang mchis pa// bzod par bzhes la byang dag tshangs par stsol// oṃ bhū mi pa ti ma hā de wa sa pa ri wa ra i daṃ ba liṃ gṛh+na kha kha khā hi khā hi/ ma ma sarba karma sid+dhi m+me pra yats+tsha hūm̐/ zhes rol mo dang bcas bsang rdzas mchod pa rnams phul la/ zhal nas gsungs pa'i tshigs su bcad pa'i chos kyi sbyin pa'ang bya ste/ thal sbyar dril gsil dang bcas/ sdig pa ci yang mi bya zhing*// dge ba phun sum tshogs par spyad/ rang gi sems ni yongs su gdul// 'di ni sangs rgyas bstan pa yin// zhes so// de nas bstod pa ni rol mo dang bcas/ kye ho/ srid pa'i lha chen mthu ldan dregs pa'i tshogs// kun gyi rje bor legs byas bye ba brgyas// mngon par 'phags pa'i bstan skyong khyod kyi tshul// mthong nas rab snyan dbyangs kyis bstod par bgyi// ma ra ta ka'i zhun mas legs bkrus pa'i// bai ḍūr+ya yi sa 'dzin dwangs ba'i ngogs// dus bzhi'i ngo mtshar 'char ba'i ā dar+sha// lcang lo can gyi pho brang nyid dang mtshungs// 'chi med lha yi btung pa'i yon tan gang*// blo ldan blo la ri mor 'drir bzod pa'i// yan lag brgyad ldan dal gyis 'babs pa dang*// g.ya' spang sman ljongs me tog tshal chen por// dri za'i glu yis mgrin par mdzes pa yi// sbrang rtsi'i chang myos dga' ba'i gshog rtsal sgyur// sna tshogs rkang 'thung ljon pa'i yal 'dab rtser// 'dab chags rnams kyang rtse 'jo'i 'phur lding g.yo// ri skyes rkang bzhi pa rnams bag phebs shing*// mtho ris bdag po'i dkor nor bzhin du rgyu// mdor na dzam bus mtshan pa'i gling mchog gi

/phun tshogs dpal kun gcig tu spungs pa bzhin// phyi ltar yid can mig la sim pa bskyed// nang ltar rtsa gsum rgyal ba rab 'byams kyi// rang bzhin dkyil 'khor chen por lhun rdzogs pa// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rtag tu 'du ba'i zhing*// o rgyan rang byung gnas mchog gnyis pa ste// gsang ba don dam he ru ka yi gnas// dngos kun nyer zhi rdo rje btsun mo'i mkha'// mtha' yas zhing gi yon tan ji snyed pa// cig char rdzogs pa'i ngo mtshar brjod las 'das// gnas der bsti ba'i lha mchog dge bsnyen che// bstan la rab gus rnal 'byor skyong ba'i blo// dkar ba thun mong nyid gyur sku mdog dang*// cha lugs zhon pa 'khor tshogs bgrang yas rnams// gang zhig mchod cing bsnyen la re ba'i yid// shing rta 'gengs shing mthu stobs gzi byin gyis// bka' 'das nyams pa'i log 'dren dgra bgegs rnams// rtsad nas gcod cing thal bar rlog byed pa// chos kyi srung ma 'khor dang bcas la bstod// ces dang*/ kyai/ phyi ltar gangs can ri bo la// do zlar byed pa'i kha ba'i rdul// rab brtsegs bkra shis rtags kyi grangs// mtho la brjid cing dgung du bsnyegs// nang ltar rin chen las grub pa'i// sku mkhar gzhal yas bkod legs shing*// rnam par rgyal ba'i pho brang ni// ljongs 'di'i dpyid du 'phos pa bzhin// der gnas dkar phyogs skyong ba dang*// rgyal bstan srung ba'i mel tshe mkhan// dam ldan rnal 'byor bka' nyan zhing*// dam nyams bstan dgra'i dpung gzhom pa// rdo rgyal mu nam mched brgyad ni// lha yi rdzing ring mdzes pa'i gnyen// rgyu skar bdag po'i khengs 'phrog pa'i// sku mdog phyag mtshan bzhon par bcas// sred med bu dang gdong bzhi pa'i// sgyu rtsal rang dbang nyid gyur pa// myur mgyogs mthu rtsal stobs dang ldan// rigs mthun sprul dang yang sprul tshogs// ma lus 'khor dang bcas rnams la// dang ba'i yid kyis bstod par bgyi//

grangs 'don pa'i tshe/ gong gi de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan nas mthar chags su bton la/ tshar rjes mar mchod gtor lnga tshom can gnyis de yang 'bul nas/ 'dod don gsol zhing phrin las bcol ba ni/ kyai/ gsol lo/ mchod do/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che srung zhing*/ rnal 'byor sgrub pa po'i sdong grogs mdzad par zhal gyis bzhes pa'i dkar po lha yi sde ris yongs kyi gtso bo/ rigs chos rgyud kyi srung ma gnyan po/ srid pa'i lha chen rdo rje blo gros rtsal sman btsun dgyes sde ma mo'i tshogs dang*/ lha rigs kyi sras lcam rnams dang*/ phyi nang bka' yi las byed blon 'khor pho nya sprul dang yang sprul lha klu gnyan gyi dpung tshogs yan lag bzhi dang ldan pa khyed rnams gsol lo mchod do// bstod do// bsngags so// sgrub po// brten no// kyai/ lha yi dge bsnyen dam pa chos kyi srung ma/ shar gyi phyogs skyong rdo rgyal mu nam gnyan po rdo rje g.yu drung dpal 'bar dung gi mi pho chen po mched zla brgyad/ lha sman btsun mo sras dang 'khor tshogs las mkhan sprul pa sde dpung bsam gyis mi khyab pa khyed rnams gsol zhing mchod do// bstod cing bsngags so// sgrub cing brten no// gnas dang yul gyi bdag po khyed rnams la bcol pa'i phrin las su bya ba ni/ slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas/ grub pa'i dbang phyug karma pak+shi/ bdud 'dul nus ldan rdo rje la sogs pa rig 'dzin rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bsgos dam tshig gnyan las ma 'da' bar/ spyir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che dang*/ khyad par du sgrub brgyud bstan pa'i snying po karma kaṃ tshang gi ring lugs rgyal mtshan srid na mngon par mtho zhing bsgreng ba dang*/ de 'dzin gyi skyes mchog rnams kyang zhabs pad bskal brgyar brtan cing phrin las rnam bzhi lhun gyis grub pa dang*/

'phags tshogs dge 'dun gyi sde rnams dar zhing rgyas la bshad dang sgrub pa'i 'khor los sa steng khyab cing yun ring du gnas pa dang*/ mi dbang sa skyong sde~X bzhi mngon mtho'i chab srid brtan cing dkar po dge~X bcu'i tshul la rtag tu gzhol ba dang*/ mtha' bzhi'i dregs ldan rnams kyang blo dam pa'i chos la bsgyur nus pa dang*/ mnga' ris yul ljongs rnams su bde skyid dpal 'byor dbyar gyi mtsho ltar rgyas shing*/ char chu dus su 'bab/ lo phyugs rtag tu legs/ nad dang mu ge mtshon 'khrugs kyi bskal ba ngan pa mi mthun pa'i rigs thams cad zhi zhing rdzogs ldan gsar pa'i lang tsho bzhad pa dang*/ bka' las 'das pa'i dam sri dam log gdug 'dre rgyal 'gong mi bsrun pa dngos can dang dngos med thams cad drag po'i stobs kyi tshar bcad cing pha mthar bskrad pa dang*/ thal ba'i rdul phran bzhin du brlag pa'i phrin las mdzad du gsol/ rnal 'byor sgrub pa po bdag gis bcol pa'i las dang dgos pa'i don rnams sgrubs/ sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod pa'i bgegs rnams thul/ bar gcod kyi rkyen zlog /rtag tu srung skyob mdzod/ tshe dang bsod nams dpal dang grags pa thams cad yar ngo'i zla ltar gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas pa dang*/ mdor na gang bcol pa'i 'dod don mtha' dag thogs med yid bzhin du 'grub pa'i stongs grogs dam pa mdzod cig /ma hā sa ma ya ma nu sma ra hrīḥ zhes rol mo dang bcas gser skyems nam mkhar mchod do// de nas nongs pa bzod gsol ni/ rje btsun gong mas bsnyen cing brten pa'i lha// rigs chos bstan skyong ma grub rang 'khor ba'i// rtag tu 'go zhing srung skyob sdong grogs mkhan/ / rdo rje'i dam can khyed rnams dgongs su gsol// bdag cag gnyis 'dzin kun rtog 'khrul dbang gis// deng 'dir gtor mchod dman dang gtsang sbra chung*// le lo bag nyal dbang gis nyes pa'i tshogs// thugs dang 'gal bar gyur rnams bzod par gsol// rgyal bstan sri zhur lhag pa'i 'dod don gang*// yar ngo'i zla ltar 'phel ba'i bkra shis shog

/ de nas bsang gzhung gang yin de la 'jug par bya'o// 'di nyid kho na'i tshe rjes bsdu ni/ lha rnams rang rang gnas su bder gshegs la// dus dang dus su slar yang 'byon pa dang*// rnam kun dpag bsam yongs 'du dge ba'i char// yid la 'jo ba'i bkra shis mdzad du gsol// sa pa ri wā ra swa sbā naṃ gats+tsha/ zhes pa'ang lha chen po zung gis deng 'dir lhag par phrin las kyi 'od snang ches cher spro /lha mchog rdo rje gzhon nu dang*// rgyal dbang pad+ma 'byung gnas che// snang srid zil gnon karma pa// grub pa'i dbang phyug pak+ṣi yis// bka' bsgos dam bzhag ma bsnyel bar// dam tshig gnyan po rjes dran mdzod// srid pa'i lha chen dgra lha'i bla rgyal// mthu stobs rdzu 'phrul ci yang ston// dkar po lha yi dge bsnyen che// yul bdag 'khor bcas bstod par 'os// khyod la bcol pa'i phrin las ni// sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung ba dang*// skyes mchog zhabs pad bskal brgyar brtan// bdag dang rgyu sbyor yon bdag gi /mthun rkyen sgrubs la 'gal rkyen sol// dpal dang 'byor pa snyan grags spel// bde zhing dge ba'i stongs grogs mdzod// mi mthun nyer 'tshe'i bdud rigs rnams// rmeg med thal bar brlag pa dang*// mtha' bzhi'i dregs ldan khengs pa can// thams cad dbang du gyur nas su// chos kyi rgyal mtshan 'dzugs pa yi// ma g.yel ma 'da' thugs dam can// rnal 'byor bdag gi bcol ba'i las// thogs pa med par 'byung ba yi// phrin las rnam bzhi bsgrub par mdzod// kyai// srid zhi'i bde legs g.yang du len// phye mar 'di la bcud g.yang phob// phywa dang g.yang gi dngos grub rnams// 'bad med lhun gyis 'grub par mdzod// ces mda' dar g.yab cing phye mar drangs/ bshags pa dang bsngo smon bkra shis ni/ 'gal 'khrul lhag chad nongs pa bshags// byang dag tshangs par mdzad nas kyang*// 'khor bcas rang gnas ci bder gshegs// dus su slar yang 'byon par mdzod// gats+tsha sa gshegs/ de ltar mchod bstod dge ba des// 'gro kun gtan bde'i go 'phang thob// bkra shis don gnyis 'grub pa yi// dge legs dam par spyod gyur cig / ces yul lha ger mdzo'i bsang mchod 'di bzhin nye gnas pa dbon drung mdzod pa karma phrin las ye shes kyis bskul ltar si tu pad+ma nyin byed dbang pos spel ba sarba maṅga lam/// /

༈ a mṛ ta sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs la/ stong las bsang khang yid 'ong nang*// 'bru gsum 'od zhu mchod pa'i rdzas// zag med bde chen skyed byed pa'i// bdug spos sprin chen g.yo bar gyur// oṃ badz+ra s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ/ lan gsum gyis spel la/ kyai/ bla med dkon mchog rin chen gsum// bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dang*// dpa' bo dam can chos skyong tshogs// ti se thang lha spom ra gnyan// zil phrom gnyen ldang la sogs pa// dkar phyogs skyong ba'i yul gzhis bdag /gnas bdag dge bsnyen zhal da dang*// dbu che brag dkar smug sangs sogs// sgrub pa'i stongs grogs mdzad pa yi// gnyug mar gnas pa'i zo dor dang*// lha klu gnyan dang sa bdag rnams// 'dir byon dgyes pa'i gdan bzhugs la// yid sprul mchod pa'i rnam pa kun// blo yis blangs te kun bzang gi /rnam thar mchod sprin ji bzhin par// mchod 'os so sor mthun rdzas kyi// longs spyod rgya chen zad med pa// 'bul bzhes dngos grub dam pa stsol// legs dang rgyal kha gtong ba dang*// bsam pa yid bzhin 'grub par mdzod// gzhi byes kun tu bsrung zhing skyobs// tshe ring nad med bde zhing skyid// chos ldan 'byor pa rgyas pa dang*// bar chad nyer 'tshe 'gal rkyen tshogs// mi mthun phyogs kun bsgyur du gsol// khyed rnams thugs dang gang 'gal ba// bzod bzhes phrin las rnam pa bzhir// dbang bsgyur mthu rtsal can rnams bstod// dus kun dge ba'i bkra shis kyi// dpal du 'bar bas khyab pa dang*// rang bzhin gnas gshegs slar yang ni// dus su 'byon par mdzad du gsol// zhes pa'ang o chung gis bskul ltar spel/// / ༈ a mṛ ta sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ chos kun dmigs med stong nyid gyur// stong ba'i ngang las bsang mchod rdzas// 'dod yon rnam mang bkod pa'i tshogs// nam mkha' mnyam pa'i rang bzhin gyur// oṃ badz+ra s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ/

ma dper shog grangs nyer gcig pa ma tshang bas blo ldan rnams kyis btsal bar 'tshal/ mchan/ gsum gyis sbrus pa'i mchod gtor phye mar/ dar zab sna tshogs/ 'bru sna/ sman sna/ rin chen phye ma/ ja phud/ chang phud/ dkar phud/ gser skyems/ nyer spyod lnga sogs dang*/ dar dkar ba dan/ go khrab mtshon cha dkor chas gzugs 'gros sogs rgyas par bshams la/ rang nyid lha'i nga rgyal dang ldan bzhin pas mchod rdzas rnams/ a mṛ ta sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūm̐ las rin po che'i snod yangs zhing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i gtor ma 'dod dgu'i rgya mtsho chen po dang*/ bsang mchod dud pa'i sprin phung gi zer ma las 'phro ba'i mkho dgu'i yo byad lha mi'i dpal 'byor yid du 'ong bas yongs su gang ba dang*/ gzhan yang spyan gzigs dkor chas gzugs 'gros la sogs pa sa dang bar snang khyab pa so sor mos pa'i longs spyod mi zad pa nam mkha' mdzod kyi rang bzhin du 'char bar gyur/ a kā ro lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ kyai/ bskal pa bzang po'i zhing khams 'dir// bcom ldan rgyal ba stong 'byung ba'i// sangs rgyas drug pa seṅge yi// rnam 'phrul dpal ldan dus gsum mkhyen// skyes rabs phreng ba bcu gsum dang*// rnam 'dren lnga pa mi pham pa// byams pa mgon po'i gar rol pa// 'gro mgon ras chen la sogs pa// kaṃ tshang snying po don brgyud kyi// ngo mtshar sgrub gnas byin rlabs can// rang bzhin gdod nas lhun gyis grub// sngon tshe shākya seṅge yis// thugs rje'i 'od zer bstim pa las// sa spyod gsung gi dkyil 'khor che// 'khor lo sdom pa'i pho brang mchog /rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro 'du pa'i zhing*// karma ri gling chos 'khor gyi// gnas dang gtsug lag bka' srung ba// lha yi dge bsnyen chen po yi// sku mkhar ri dbang rab brjid pa// phyi ltar g.ya' spang sa 'dzin mtho// dbyar skyes sgra sgrogs chu khur 'khrigs// nang ltar bkod pa dpag tu med// bsam brjod bral ba'i rang bzhin can// rmad byung lha yi gzhal yas khang*// nor bu rin chen spungs pa dang*// za 'og 'phan dar lhab ma lhub// sna tshogs 'ja' 'od khyugs se khyug

/de ltar lha chen 'khor dang bcas// gnas 'dir mchod phyir spyan 'dren na// dam tshig dbang gis gshegs nas kyang*// rang rang dgyes dgur rol pa yi// gdan la ci ltar bde bar bzhugs// 'dir bshams gtsang zhing yid 'ong ba'i// nyer spyod bdun dang 'dod yon lnga// dkar mngar ro brgya ldan pa yi// mchod gtor ri ltar spungs se spung*// dza gad phud sna tshogs pa yi// rgya mtsho rba rlabs khrugs se khrug /rin chen gser g.yu'i skyems bzang dang*// spyan gzigs dkor chas dpag tu med// 'phan dar rgyal mtshan ba dan dkar// go khrab dar sna stag gzig rgyan// gser rta dung lug shel gyi ra// bye ba dung phyur grangs las 'das// khyad par bdud rtsi can gyi shing*// sna dgu'i dud pa'i dri bzhon dkrigs// srid gsum ma lus 'gengs nus pa'i// dud pa'i cha shas re re las// bkra shis rdzas rtags rgyal srid bdun// 'chi med skabs gsum longs spyod las// lhag pa'i dgyes bskang mthun pa'i rdzas// so sor mos pa'i 'dod yon gyis// sa dang bar snang kun khyab pa// zag med ye shes bdud rtsi dngos// ngo bor sbyang spel bsgyur byas te// kun tu bzang po'i mchod pa'i sprin// nam mkha' mdzod bzhin spel ba 'dis// mchog gsum rtsa gsum lha yi tshogs// zhi dang khro bo'i skur ston dang*// dpal chen bde mchog 'khor lo sdom// rdo rje phag mo la sogs pa// mkha' spyod sa spyod 'du ba yi// rig 'dzin dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs// ye shes mgon po ber nag can// dpal ldan lha mo rang byung ma// rgyal chen rnam sras gser phreng can// kun dga' gzhon nu rdo rje legs// srin mgon jo bo sngags kyi bdag /mkhar nag la sogs chos skyong ba// dregs pa pho rgyud mo rgyud rnams// gsol lo mchod do mnga' gsol lo// gsol dang mchod pa la brten nas// bdag rgyud byin gyis brlab pa dang*// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol// zhi rgyas dbang dang drag po yi// gang bcol phrin las kun 'grub mdzod// kye ho/

gtsug lag gnas kyi srung = dam tshig ldan pa'i srung = btsun mo blon po sprul 'khor tshogs// yang 'khor dkar phyogs sde skyong ba// thams cad ma lus bsang ngo brngan// gsol lo mchod do dgyes gyur cig /oṃ shrī mān pra dz+nyā s+ya sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ ba ling ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes mchod gtor 'bul nas phrin las bcol ba ni/ kyai/ sngon tshe o rgyan chen po dang*// dus mkhyen pak+shi rang byung rje// 'gro mgon ras chen la sogs pa// bka' brgyud bla ma'i spyan snga ru// khas blangs dam bcas bka' bsgos bzhin// deng 'dir tha tshig rjes dran nas// sangs rgyas bstan pa rin po che// dri med brgyar spel// dge 'dun 'dus pa'i sde rgyas shing*// bshad dang sgrub pa'i 'od snang gis// 'dzam gling khyab par gsal ba dang*// gtsug lag chos kyi 'khor lo'i gzhi// dpal gyi karma'i gnas mchog 'di// tshogs dbang bsgyur zhing*// khams gsum gung gnyis khyab par rgyu// rgyal ba'i bka' nyan dam tshig can// bstan dang bstan 'dzin grogs byed cing*// rang phyogs srung zhing phas rgol 'joms// dkar po lha mchod phyir bskul ba'i tshe// dus su 'byon par mdzad du gsol// sarba bhu ta gats+tshaḥ

'jig rten skyong ba'i tshogs// mchod cing bstod dang bskul ba'i mthus// gdan sa yul ljongs 'di nyid du// rdzogs ldan lang tsho rgyas par shog / ces gzhan yang bsngo ba smon lam shis brjod ci ltar rigs 'dzin ma dag rtog tshogs sbyang byas nas// kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin phung rgya cher spel// oṃ a kā ra ོsa byin brlabs lan gsum/ kyai/ chos dbyings gdod nas skye med ngang*// bde chen ye shes snang gan+dho la// chos 'khor skyong zhing srung pa yi// dkar phyogs lha yi sde dpon che// dpal ldan shes rab 'khor bcas dang*// yul ljongs dge ba'i stobs rtsal gyi// dpung tshogs yan lag bzhi ldan pa'i// mnga' dbang 'byor dang rigs kyi lha// zo dor yongs kyi rje bo ste// rdo rje sman dpal mchog rab rtsal// 'chi med bdud rtsi'i gter 'chang ba// gzhan yang stobs ldan dgra 'dul dang*// rdo rje rtsal ldan /rig 'dzin pad+ma thod phreng rtsal// dpal ldan karma pa sogs kyis// bka' bsgos dam tshig rjes dran la// rang rang gnas nas gshegs su gsol// 'dir bshams gdan la bzhugs nas kyang*// bkram pa'i mchod pa rgya chen po// phyi dang nang dang gsang ba yi// dngos 'byor lha klu mi'i longs spyod// 'dod yon rgyal srid bkra shis kyi// rdzas rtags brgyad dang dkor chas rigs// spyan gzigs tshar du dngar ba dang*// phye mar ja phud dza gad skyems// rin chen lnga dang spos sman sna// lha shing g.yu lo'i dri bsung las// dud pa'i sprin tshogs dbang gzhu ltar// bkra shis re khā 'bar ba dang*// gang 'dod mchod pa'i char chen po// nam mkha' mdzod bzhin spro ba yis// yul gzhi gnas bdag sku lha'i tshogs// dgyes bskang zag med bde ba che'i// rang bzhin nyid du rol par mdzod// snyigs ma'i skye bo mi bsrun pas// brlang spyod dbang gis nyams grib mnol// kun kyang zhi zhing bde legs shog /rigs mtshun lha srung yal gam can// bden pa mthong zhing dam tshig ldan// rnal 'byor skyong bar zhal bzhes pa// thogs med rtsal ldan rnams la bstod// nongs par gyur kun bzod par bzhes// bcol pa'i phrin las khyad par ni// thub mchog bstan pa rin po che// nub med phyogs bcur spel ba dang*// sangs rgyas gnyis pa pad 'byung gi /nges gsang bla med rdzogs pa che// dri med snying po'i ring lugs gang*// dar rgyas yun gnas de 'dzin gyi// skyes bu zhabs pad bskal brgyar brtan// 'gro don phrin las lhun grub cing*// dge 'dun 'dus pa 'phel zhing rgyas// thugs mthun dam tshig la gnas shing*// rgyal po chos ldan skye dgu rnams// byams dang snying rjes rgyud brlan nas// dkar po dge la spyod pa dang*// char chu dus 'bab lo tog legs// nad 'khrugs dbul phongs bskal pa zhi// rdzogs ldan dus bzhin bde skyid spel// mdor na gang bcol las 'grub pa'i// sdong grogs mel tshe ma g.yel bar// rnam kun bkra shis phun sum tshogs// don gnyis dpal 'bar dge legs shog

/bhū ta gats+tsha/ zhes rgyal dbang mchog sprul rin po ches bka' stsal ltar si tu pad+ma nyin byed dbang pos phul ba dge// / ༈ a kā ro sa byin brlabs/ kye hoḥ rgyal dbang mtsho skyes rgyal po yi// bka' mnyan dkar po'i sde skyong ba'i// lha btsan rdo rje thogs med rtsal// sngon tshe yal gam rjes dgongs la// 'dir gshegs zhi ba bsang mchod rdzas// dgyes mchod mos pa'i rang bzhin gyi// 'dod yon rgya mtsho dkrigs pa 'di// bzhes shig rol cig pu dza ho// bdag cag dpon slob gzhi byes kun// dge zhing legs pa'i sdong grogs dang*// kha 'dzin rgyab brten ma g.yel mdzod// bar chad rkyen las bsrung zhing skyobs// dam las ma 'da' sa ma ya// zhes chags med rin po che'i bzhed ltar si tu pas spel ba maṅga lam/// / ༈ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong las rin chen snod yangs par// 'dod yon sna tshogs kun tu dkrigs// bdug spos dri ldan zer ma las// nyer spyod rnam mang char 'babs gyur// oṃ badz+ra s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ/ kyai/ sngon tshe o rgyan chen po gsang ba'i bdag /grub chen karma pak+shi la sogs pa'i// spyan sngar rdo rje'i tha tshig g.yar dam can// zo dor stab rgyal ngang pa seng seng dang*// 'bum rdzong yul gzhi gnas bdag dge bsnyen che// dpa' khams dpal rgyal spor ne rtse rgyal dang*// ka na yangs rtse tshwa sman g.yung drung dkar// 'khor dang yang 'khor snang srid gzhi bdag tshogs// ma lus 'khor bcas 'dir gshegs gdan la bzhugs// dngos 'byor yid kyis sprul pa'i mchod sprin rnams// nam mkha' mdzod bzhin rgya chen spel ba 'dis// yul lha gnas bdag dkar phyogs skyong rnams la// 'bul lo dgyes bzhes khyad par bsang mchod mthus// nyams grib dme grib mkhon grib mun pa'i dpung*// bsang mchod 'od zer 'dod yon 'bum 'phro bas// rmugs pa sangs shing bde dang ldan gyur cig /sa bdag mthu chen so so rang rang gis// skyong ba'i yul ljongs phan bde'i dpal yon gyi// rdzogs ldan gsar pa'i dga' ston spel ba dang*// bstan 'gror nyer 'tshe bgegs dpung rtsad nas bcom// char chu dus 'babs lo legs 'bru 'phel zhing*// skye dgu dkar po'i chos la bkod pa dang*// 'byung po'i rgyud bskul bslu brid chos min gzhig
/sngon gyi dam bca' g.yel med phrin las kun// lhun gyis grub pa'i sdong grogs mdzad du gsol// gats+tsha/

zhes bstan 'dzin rin po che mchog gis bskul bzhin/ si tu pad+ma nyin byed dbang pos spel/ sarba maṅga lam/// / ༈ kyai/ rin chen snod mchog rgya che'i nang*// mchod rdzas gtsang zhing yid 'ong ba// nam mkha' mdzod bzhin sprin gtibs gyur// deng 'dir mchod 'os skyabs gsum dang*// yul lha zo dor gnyan po'i tshogs// khyad par gnas bdag dge bsnyen che// gnyu rgyal ra la bya khyung lha// dgyes pa'i mchod 'bul bzhes su gsol// thugs 'gal bzod gsol mthu chen gyi// rtsal ldan dkar po'i sde skyong ba// 'khor bcas bstod 'os bsngags par bgyi// de ltar bsang mchod phul ba'i mthus// pad+ma thod phreng he ru ka'i// dam la ma 'da' bstan 'gro la// bde legs rgyun mi chad par stsol// dus kun bkra shis rdzogs ldan gyi// dpal la spyod bzhin chos 'phel shog / ces pa 'di btsan ne skal bzang nas bskul bzhin si tus bris pa'o/// / ༈ kyai/ sngon tshe mtsho skyes pad 'byung gi /bstan pa skyong bar khas blangs pa'i// zil phrom rdo rje g.yu drung rtsal// dam tshig dbang gis gnas 'dir gshegs// dgyes pa'i gdan bzhugs 'dir bshams kyi// mchod rdzas dkor nor bsam mi khyab// 'bul gyi dgyes par bzhes su gsol// yul bdag 'khor bcas rab tu bsngags// rgyal pa'i bstan pa rin po che// mi nub rgyal mtshan srid rtser bsgrengs// rnal 'byor bdag gi mthun rkyen sgrubs// 'gal rkyen sol la bar chad zlog /bsam pa yid bzhin 'grub pa dang*// skye dgu bde la gzhol ba yi// phrin las thogs pa med par sgrubs// rtag par bkra shis bde legs stsol// gats+tsha sa gshegs/ zhes pa'ang khang sar tshe 'phel gyis bskul ltar si tus spel ba maṅga lam/ dge'o/// / ༈ oṃ badz+ra a mri ta sogs kyis bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong las rin chen snod yangs par// kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin phung gi /zag med bde chen bskyed pa'i rdzas// rgya chen rgyun mi chad par gyur// a kā ro

sa byin brlabs la/ kyai/ skyabs yul mchog gsum rtsa gsum po// kun 'dus pad+ma thod phreng rtsal// bla med gsar rnying brgyud pa bsang*// rgyud bzhir 'brel ba'i yi dam lha// gnas gsum dpa' bo ḍā ki bsang*// ye shes mgon po ber nag can// rang byung rgyal mo rnam thos sras// zhing skyong srin mgon dam can mgar// sngags bdag rdo rje rgyal po bsang*// dpal ldan a phyi mched lnga 'khor// tshe ring mched lnga thang lha dang*// spom ra nor bdag thams cad bsang*// yul phyogs 'dir gnas gzhi yi bdag /so sor mthun pa'i rdzas kyis bsang*// de ltar mchod pa la brten nas// rnal 'byor bsam don lhun gyis 'dir gnyug mar rgyu ba yi// mchod par 'os pa'i mgron rnams la// mchod pa'i sprin tshogs nam mkha' gang*// 'dod yon lnga ldan zad mi shes// rang rang dgyes dgur rol pa ru// 'bul bzhes tshim zhing mnyes pa'i mthus// rig 'dzin pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi// yang zab bstan pa phyogs bcur rgyas// bstan dang bstan 'dzin 'tsho gzhes nas// 'gro don phrin las lhun gyis grub// yul ris sa phyogs 'di nyid du// char /gats+tsha sa gshegs/ zhes pa'ang bstan snying mchog sprul gyi bzhed ltar si tu pad+ma nyin byed dbang pos spel ba dge// / ༈ swa bhā wa sa bsangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bsang rdzas lha mi'i 'dod yon nam mkha' mdzod bzhin rgya chen rgyun mi chad pa'i rang bzhin du gyur/ oṃ badz+ra s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ/ lan gsum/ rang nyid lhar gsal thugs ka nas// 'od 'phros mchod 'os mgron rigs rnams// spyan drangs dgyes pa'i gdan la bzhugs// kyai/ sngon tshe o rgyan slob dpon che// pad+ma thod phreng karma pa// la sogs rdo rje 'dzin rnams kyi// spyan sngar zhal bzhes dam bcas bzhin// tha tshig gnyen las ma 'da' bar// dkar po'i phyogs rnams skyong ba yi// dpal zo yab yum sras 'khor dang*// gzhan yang yul ris ljongs rnams su// gnas pa'i mgon skyob byed pa yi// lha klu gnyan rigs zo dor dang*// dge bsnyen sman mo la sogs pa'i// yid kyi gzugs can thams cad la// so sor mos pa'i 'dod yon tshogs// bkra shis rtags kyi phyag rgya dang*// dkar gsum mngar gsum sman phud gtor// spyan gzigs dkor cha rten dang sgrub// mchod rdzas yid 'ong phun tshogs can// rgya chen zad med mchod pa'i sprin// dud pa'i zer gyi cha shas las// so sor mos thob tshim zhing dgyes// zhi dang byams pa'i sems ldan shog /khyed rnams mchod pa'i dge legs kyis// bstan pa dar rgyas yul phyogs 'dir// lo legs skya rgyal char chu 'bebs// nad med bsam don chos bzhin 'grub// rnal 'byor bar chad sel ba dang*// mthu dang sdong grogs rgyab brten mdzod// bdud ris phyogs las rnam rgyal zhing*// bkra shis rdzogs ldan dga' ston ltar// lhun grub yid la 'dod 'jor shog /sarba bhū ta gats+tsha sa gshegs/ zhes karma yan lag dang rab rgyal bcas kyi bzhed ltar spel/// / ༈ amṛ ta sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong las bsang khang rin chen snod yangs par// lha mi'i 'dod yon kun bzang mchod sprin gyur// oṃ badz+ra s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ/

longs spyod mkho dgu'i tshogs// dpag yas bdug pa'i sprin phung las// gang 'dod yid bzhin 'char ba yi// bsang mchod dam pa 'di bzhes shig /pad 'byung rtsa brgyud bla ma yi// bka' dang tha tshig dran mdzod la// sangs rgyas chos kyi bstan pa srungs// de 'dzin skyes bu'i phrin las spel// rnal 'byor bdag gis gang bcol las// thogs med yid bzhin myur sgrub cing*// rgyal khams bde zhing bkra shis spro na/ mchod rdzas bsang shing sogs 'du bgyis nas/ swa bhā wa sogs/ stong par gyur pa'i ngang nyid las// bsang khang yid 'ong rgya che'i nang*// sman spos dri ngad bdug pa'i tshogs// sprin phung gtibs pa lta bu dang*// de las 'dod yon dpag med pa// rab 'phros sa dang bar snang gi /phyogs kun rgyas par 'gengs pa dang*// gzhan yang mchod rdzas nyer spyod dang*// spyan gzigs dkor cha la sogs pa// lha mi'i longs spyod las lhag gyur// oṃ badz+ra s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ/ lan gsum brjod/ kyai/ skyabs gnas rtsa gsum thugs rje can// mchog gsum spyi dpal pad+ma 'byung*// gsar rnying rgyud sde'i lha rab 'byams// ji snyed rgyal ba sras bcas rnams// bsang ngo mchod do dgyes par rol// thang lha yar zhur spom ra gnyen// dge bsnyen chen po thams cad dang*// mdo khams sgang drug khyad par du// zal mo'i sgang du gnas pa yi// sku rgyal she ne 'khor bcas dang*// chos 'khor 'di nyid skyong byed pa'i// gnas bdag yul lha gzhi bdag rnams// zo dor ston rgyal gnyan po dang*// rgyal chen gru gu la sogs pa// thams cad 'dir gshegs bsang la byon// sngon tshe o rgyan chen po dang*// rig 'dzin grub thob rgya mtsho yi// spyan sngar tha tshig mna' bor ltar// sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung ba'i phyir// rnal 'byor sgrub po'i dam la 'dus// 'dir bshams yid 'ong bsang mchod rdzas// ma la ya yi nags rlung gi
