gsol lo= nongs pa bshags so bzod par bzhes// sngon tshe pad+ma 'byung gnas dang*// grub dbang karma pak+shi yi// dam tshig gnyan po rjes dran mdzod// sangs rgyas bstan pa rin po che// snying po don gyi ring lugs 'di// srid pa'i rtse mor bsgrengs ba dang*// bstan 'dzin 'gro don phrin las rgyas// 'gro rnams dam pa'i chos ldan zhing*// dge legs lhag bsam 'grub pa dang*// log 'dren bdud kyi g.yul ngo las// yongs su rnam par rgyal gyur cig /rnal 'byor bdag gis bcol ba'i las// yid bzhin phrin las bsgrub tu gsol// phywa dang g.yang gi dngos grub stsol// mgron rnams rang gi gnas su gshegs// dus su slar yang 'byon par mdzod// gats+tsha sa gshegs/ maṅga laṃ sid+dhi dza ya a la la ho/ bkra shis gang rigs brjod/ ces pa 'di zhe 'dzong bla ma rnam gnyis kyi thugs bzhed bskang ba'i phyir shing yos lor si tu pas thub bstan chos 'khor gling du spel ba'o/// / ༈ swa sti/ lha brag dkar po'i bsang mchod spro na/ mchod rdzas rnams gtsang zhing bzang ba 'du bar byas la rang lha'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas/

a mṛ ta sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las snang srid kyi// chos rnams gzung 'dzin bral ba'i ngang*// rin chen bsang khang nang du ni// mchod sprin rab 'byams char 'bebs gyur// oṃ badz+ra s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ kyai/ dzam bu bṛk+shas mtshan pa'i byang*// bsil ba'i ljongs kyi mdo khams smad// bod chen smar khams sgang gi cha// bye brag gru gu'i gnas mchog gi /rin chen shel gyi lding khang na// rig 'dzin pad+ma'i dge bsnyen che// sangs rgyas chos kyi srung ma ste// bka' dang zab gter gnyan gyi bdag /yul lha zo dor kun gyi gtso// lha brag rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal// zhi 'dzum rin chen rgyan dang ldan// dar thod gser gyi prog zhu mdzes// sku mdog dkar la ber dkar gsol// g.yas pas dar dkar ba dan dang*// g.yon pas rin chen rgyal mtshan bsnams// bstan pa skyong dang rnal 'byor srung*// dgra bgegs 'dul ba'i rtags kyis brgyan// rat+na'i sga srab rab brjid pa'i// mgyogs 'gro 'phur shes rta dkar bcibs// sras dang btsun mo blon 'khor bcas// sa bdag gter bdag yul gnas bdag /lha klu gnyan gyi sde ris bskor// gnas 'dir dam tshig dbang gis gshegs// rang rang dgyes pa'i gdan la bzhugs// 'dir bshams phyi nang mchod pa'i tshogs// rnam mang bkod legs yid du 'ong*// spyan gzigs dkor chas rta phyugs dang*// 'phur dgu 'dzul bcu'i gzugs 'gros dang*// bkra shis rdzas rtags rgyal srid bdun// nye ba'i rin chen 'dod yon lnga// nyer spyod sna tshogs mchod pa'i rdzas// so so'i yid bzhin 'char ba yi// zag med nam mkha'i mdzod ji bzhin// kun tu bzang po'i smon lam ltar// bdug spos sprin gyi phung po yi// 'od kyi drwa ba'i cha rnams las// gru char bzhin du spungs se spung*// chu 'dzin 'khrigs ltar thibs se thib// gser mngal can dang ku be ra// klu dbang la sogs rnam dpyod 'phrul// zil gnon ya mtshan yid sprul gyis// stong gsum 'jig rten kun bkang 'bul// dgyes pa chen pos bzhes su gsol// brtse bas dgongs te rol par mdzod// gsol lo mchod do mnga' gsol lo// mthu stobs rdzu 'phrul cir yang bsgyur// dkar phyogs srung zhing nag phyogs gzhom// thogs med rtsal ldan sku lha gnyan// 'khor dang bcas la bdag bstod do// seṅge brag gi yang rdzong du// sngon tshe dpal chen he ru ka

/pad+ma thod phreng la sogs dang*// drag po nus ldan rdo rje yi// spyan sngar zhal bzhes g.yar dam gyi// tha tshig gnyan po dran mdzod la// rig 'dzin byang chub bsgrub pa yi// bar chad nyer 'tshe bdud dpung rnams// pha mthar bskrad cing gnas skabs su// bsam don lhun grub tshe bsod rgyas// 'khor slob mnga' thang dbyar mtsho ltar// rgyas shing gzhi byes rtag par skyongs// sangs rgyas bstan pa dar ba dang*// gsang ba sngags kyi zab chos gang*// phyogs mthar khyab yun gnas par mdzod// bstan 'dzin 'tsho brtan rgyal khams bde// nad 'khrugs dbul phongs zhi ba sogs// mdor na legs pa'i dpal yon rnams// rab dkar chu shel ri bong 'dzin// yar ngo'i cha gang ltar 'phel ba'i// sdong grogs ma g.yel phrin las kun// bde blag nyid du 'grub par mdzod// bdag sogs ma shes 'khrul dbang gis// nongs par gyur rnams bzod par bzhes// bkra shis ljon bzang rgyal ba'i bstan// 'phel zhing de 'dzin lo 'dab rgyas// rnal 'byor bsam don re ba'i 'bras// yongs su smin pa'i bkra shis shog /gats+tsha sa gshegs pa'am/ rten la bstim par bya'o// zhes pa'ang kun mkhyen sprul pa'i sku'i bzhed pa ltar si tu pad+ma nyin byed dbang pos spel ba dge bar gyur cig /shubhaṃ/// / ༈ amṛ ta sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong las bsang khang yid 'ong nang*// bdug spos mchod sprin mi zad pa// nam mkha' mdzod bzhin 'dod yon tshogs// rgya chen rgyun mi chad par gyur// oṃ badz+ra s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ/ kyai/ sngon tshe rig 'dzin pad+ma 'byung*// spyan sngar zhal bzhes dam tshig can// lha yi dge bsnyen chen po ni// 'dzi rgyal dga' bro sras yum 'khor// gcig tu ma nges sna tshogs su// rdzu 'phrul rol pa bsam las 'das// dkar po'i sde skyong yul lha'i gtso// gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol// phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa'i rdzas// mthun pa'i dngos 'byor yid sprul pa// 'bul gyi dgyes par bzhes su gsol// khyad par bsang mchod dam pa 'dis// mi gtsang nyams grib dag gyur nas// lha zhal zla bzhin gsal gyur cig

/rtsa brgyud bla ma'i bka' bzhin du// yal gam gnyan las ma 'da' bar// rnal 'byor las bzhi'i phrin las kun// gang bcol 'grub pa'i sdong grogs mdzod// gzhi byes kun tu srung zhing skyobs// sangs rgyas bstan pa'i snying po spel// bstan 'dzin zhabs brtan dge 'dun rgyas// yul khams bde ldan rnam kun tu// bkra shis kun tu khyab pa yi// dge legs du mas skyong gyur nas// thugs 'gal dag tshangs dngos grub stsol// ces pa'ang bla ma bsod nams chos 'phel bzhed ngor/ yul lha gnyan pos skyong ba'i chos sgar du spel ba maṅga laṃ/// / ༈ a mṛ ta sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ bsang mchod bdug pa'i sprin phung zag med kyi// bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin nam mkha'i mdzod bzhin gyur// kyai/ rab dkar kai la sha yi sa 'dzin ni// mtho ris gnas su bsnyegs 'dra'i sku mkhar nas// zo dor yongs kyi gtso mchog zil phrom zhes// rdo rje g.yu drung sras lcam 'khor dang bcas// 'dir byon 'dod yon sna tshogs bsang brngan rdzas// dgyes dgur rol la rnal 'byor bsam don kun// yid bzhin 'grub pa'i sdongs grogs dam pa dang*// kha 'dzin srung skyob g.yel med phrin las kun// chos bzhin smin par mdzod cig lha chen po// mthu rtsal rdzu 'phrul ldan la bstod par bgyi// nongs par gyur bshags tshangs par bstsal du gsol// rnam kun bkra shis dpal dang ldan gyur cig /gats+tsha sa gshegs/ zhes lha bris rta mgrin ngor si tus spel/// / ༈ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes 'bru gsum gyis mchod rdzas byin brlabs la/ kyai/ snang zhing srid pas bsdus pa'i chos thams cad// dag pa ye shes bdud rtsir byin brlabs nas// dngos kun snang ba sna tshogs rten 'brel gyi// sgyu ma tsam du rang rig gsal ba'i ngang*// tshul khrims rnam dag dri bsung ngad ldang zhing*// lha mi'i 'byor pa mchod pa'i bye brag tshogs// 'dod dgu'i longs spyod dpag med sprin ltar gtibs// mchog gsum rtsa gsum lha la mchod pa 'bul// yul gnas gzhi yi lha klu sde brgyad sogs// mchod 'os kun la mnyes pa'i dgyes rdzas 'bul// phyi snod gzhal yas 'jig rten dri ma bsang*// bde ldan pad+mo bkod kyi rnam par gyur// nang bcud sems can sgrib gnyis bag chags bsang*// glo bur 'khrul rtog ma lus zhi gyur cig

/bkra shis rab dkar cha shas yongs rdzogs shing*// dge legs bdud rtsi'i 'od snang bsil zer gyis// snod bcud kun kyang bde skyid ldan gyur cig /rgyal bstan rin chen srid mthar khyab yun gnas// de 'dzin zhabs brtan dge 'dun thugs mthun zhing*// bslab gsum rnam dag skye dgu'i bsod nams zhing*// mngon par mtho zhing chos kyi chab srid brtan// phas rgol las rgyal rtag tu bsam pa'i don// nongs med yid bzhin 'grub pa'i phrin las mdzod// rgyal khams bde dga'i dpal la dbang 'byor zhing*// rnam kun dge legs rgya mtshor spyod par shog / ces si tu pas bla ma nor bu chos 'phel bzhed ngor li yul gyi cha bkra shis chos gling skyong ba'i lha rnams la 'dod gsol mchod phreng du spel ba dge// / ༈ bsang mchod ji ltar 'os pa 'du bar byas la/ a kā ra ོ lan gsum gyis byin brlab/ kyai/ stobs bcu'i mnga' bdag bde bar gshegs pa dang*// zhi ba chags bral dam pa'i chos kyi mchog /rig dang grol ba'i sar gnas dge 'dun sde// bla med rin chen rnam gsum byin rlabs dang*// bdag sogs mos blo'i stobs kyi dge tshogs las// phyi nang gsang ba'i dam tshig dag gtsang zhing*// sdom pa'i tshul khrims la sogs phar phyin drug /yongs su rdzogs pa'i dri bsung phun tshogs ldan// chos spyod bcu dang 'khor lo rnam gnyis sogs// rab dkar lhag pa'i dge mtshan sprin phung gtibs// de lta'i legs par byas ba'i rang gzugs ni// phyogs dang tha grur khyab pa'i yon tan gyis// 'phags tshogs dgyes shing dam can thugs dam bskang*// dkar phyogs kun kyang dga' bde'i sim pa bskyed// snod bcud snang zhing srid pa'i sems can rnams// mi mthun nongs pa'i dri ma ba sang gyur cig /rkyen ngan bar chad thams cad zhi gyur cig /byams pa snying rje dga' ba btang snyoms bcas// tshad med bzhi la rtag tu gnas gyur cig

/ yul gzhi gnas bdag lha yi dge bsnyen tshogs// mtsho sman la sogs mchod 'os mgron rnams kyang*// rnam dag lhag pa'i dri bzang dang lhan cig /gtsang zhing yid 'ong skabs gsum mchod pa'i rdzas// 'dod yon rgya mtsho 'bul ba'i dge gang des// mnyes zhing tshim nas dga' mgu yi rangs ldan// de mthus rgyal bstan bsrung zhing bstan 'dzin gyi// zhabs brtan rnal 'byor bsam don chos bzhin 'grub// gzhi byes kun tu dge ba'i sdong grogs mdzod// legs kha zungs la rgyal kha btod ba dang*// mi nor phyugs gsum nyer 'tshe las rgyal zhing*// lo legs 'bru 'phel nad mug mtshon bskal zhi// tshe dpal longs spyod dbyar mtsho lta bur rgyas// rtag par bkra shis snang bas khyab gyur cig / ces pa'ang si tu pas lhun grub sprul sku'i bzhed ltar 'ba' lung yul lha'i bsang mchod du spel pa dge bar gyur cig// / ༈ na mo pad+mā ka ra ya/ 'dir yul lha zhal da gnyan po'i bsang mchod spro bar 'dod na/ gtsang zhing bzang ba'i mchod rdzas 'du bar byas la/ a mṛ ta sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong las bsang khang rin chen las grub par// bdug spos sna tshogs dri bsung ngad ldang zhing*// gzhan yang lha mi'i 'byor ba mtha' yas pa// mchod pa'i bye brag nam mkha' gang bar gyur// oṃ badz+ra s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ/ lan gsum dang*/ rang nyid rdo rje drag rtsal gsal ba yi// thugs las 'od 'phros mchod yul spyan drangs gyur// kye/ sngon tshe mtsho skyes rdo rje thod phreng rtsal// bka' brgyud bla ma rnams kyi spyan snga ru// dam bzhag dbang bskur tha tshig yal gam can// lha yi dge bsnyen rtse rgyal zhal da gnyan// sbas pa'i yul ljongs byang gi a ta rong*// gnas shing skyong ba'i dkar phyogs sde dpon che// phyi ltar rin chen mar gad lhun po la// nang ltar bkod legs lha yi pho brang mdzes// gsang ba rang bzhin rnam dag dkyil 'khor shar// ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i bsti gnas kyi// yul gzhi'i bdag po btsun mo sras 'khor bcas// khyed rnams dgyes mdzad sman spos dud pa'i sprin// rgya mtsho'i gos can khyab par g.yo ba yi// dbang gzhu'i kha dog zer ma'i cha shas las// bkra shis rdzas rtags 'dod yon rgyal srid bdun// lha klu mi yi longs spyod mi zad pa// 'dod dgu yid bzhin so sor 'phro ba dang*// nam mkha' mda' 'phang ljang bu 'phen bzang ldan// dkar gsum mngar gsum 'bru sna ba ling ta// phye mar ja phud dza gad rin chen skyems// sra brtan go cha mtshon dang dar sna tshogs// stag gzig dkor chas bsam las 'das pa dang*// 'dab ldan cang shes tsa ra shel sgong sogs// 'phur lding rkang 'gro rnam pa mang po bcas// dngos 'byor yid kyis sprul nas 'bul bar bgyi// zag med bde ba chen po'i ngang du rol// bsang gi spos sprin dra ba'i 'od zer 'dis// nyams shing rmugs pa'i grib kun sangs gyur cig

/thugs 'gal nyes rnams byang zhing dag tshangs stsol// rang phyogs bsrung zhing phas rgol 'joms pa'i lha// mchod do bstod do brngan no mnga' gsol lo// rgyal ba'i bstan srung bstan 'dzin phrin las spel// dge 'dun sde skyongs bdag cag gzhi byes la// srung skyob rtag par 'go zhing sdong grogs dang*// pho lha dgra lha bla ma lha bu rdzir mdzod// yul phyogs 'di ru char chu dus 'bebs shing*// lo legs 'bru 'phel skye dgu bde skyid ldan// nad mug mtshon bskal zhi ba'i phrin las mdzod// mdor na rnal 'byor bsam don ma lus pa// thogs med yid bzhin 'grub pa'i bkra shis stsol// gats+tsha sa rang gnas gshegs par bya'o// zhes pa'ang si tu pad+ma nyin byed dbang pos gtsug lag zung gi mkhyen stobs dang ldan pa gnyer mgon brtan bzhed ngor spel ba dge// / ༈ rang nyid lhar gsal thugs ka nas// 'od 'phros gnas bdag dge bsnyen che// 'khor bcas spyan drangs gshegs su gsol// bsang mchod 'dod dgu'i rgya mtshor spel// a kā ro sa byin brlabs/ kyai/ sngon tshe kun bzang thod phreng rtsal// bar du hūm̐ mdzad thugs gter 'dzin// deng 'dir bka' babs brgyud bcas kyi// spyan sngar zhal bzhes tha tshig can// rdo rje lcang phug shel brag dkar// sra mkhregs pha lam gzhal yas nas// gnas bdag lha yi dge bsnyen che// rdo rje 'bar ba dgyes sde sras// blon 'khor dpung gi tshogs bcas la// bsang mchod lho sprin gtibs pa yi// zer ma'i cha la bkra shis rdzas// rgyal srid 'dod yon la sogs dang*// spyan gzigs dkor chas lha klu mi'i// dpal dang 'byor pa ma tshang med// gang 'dod char bzhin 'bebs pa dang*// phye mar ja chang gser skyems dang*// rin chen 'bru sman la sogs pas// mchod do zab gter chos skyong ba'i// zo dor 'khor dang bcas pa rnams// gsol lo mchod do mnga' gsol lo// thugs 'gal dag tshangs stsal ba dang*// mthu stobs rdzu 'phrul ldan rnams bstod// khyod la phrin las bcol ba ni// sangs rgyas bstan srung bstan 'dzin rnams// dbu 'phang bstod cing dge 'dun sde// 'phel zhing rnal 'byor 'dod pa'i don// yid bzhin gegs med 'grub pa dang*// gzhi byes 'go zhing srung skyob mdzod// don gnyis mtha' ru phyin pa dang*// bkra shis rtag brtan dngos grub stsol// gats+tsha

sa gshegs par bya'o// zhes si tu pas chos ldan gyi bzhed ngor spel/// / ༈ a kā ro sa bsang rdzas byin brlabs/ rin chen snod mchog yangs shing rgya che'i nang*// 'bru gsum 'od zhu bsang rdzas zag med kyi// bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin nam mkha'i mthar khyab pa// bde chen ye shes skyed byed mchod sprin gyur// kyai/ sngon tshe rig 'dzin thod phreng rtsal// dbyer med grub chen pak+shi yi// bka' srung dge bsnyen rdo rje rgyal// yab yum sras 'khor mang po bcas// gzhan yang khra shod spom brag dang*// rgyal ba thod dkar la sogs pa// dam tshig can gyi gnas yul bdag /kun kyang 'dir byon bsang mchod bzhes// dngos 'byor sprul pa'i lha rdzas kyi// mchod tshogs dpag med yid 'ong ba// so sor mos pa'i nyer spyod rnams// 'bul bzhes dgyes bskang nyams gyur bshags// rnal 'byor bcol pa'i phrin las mdzod// yul phyogs 'dir gnas skyong ba dang*// srung zhing kha 'dzin rgyab brten dang*// lo legs 'bru 'phel rtswa rgyas zhing*// sad ser gnod pa bzlog tu gsol// phog thug nyes pa byang pa dang*// mi gtsang mnol ba sangs gyur cig /gnas skabs dge zhing 'dod pa'i don// 'bad med 'grub pa'i bkra shis stsol// gats+tsha

sa rang gnas gshegs/ bla ma dpal ldan gyi ngor spel ba dge// / ༈ a mṛ ta sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong las bsang khang rin po che'i// snod mchog yangs par lha dang mi'i// longs spyod mchod pa'i dngos po rnams// zag med bde skyed nyid du gyur// oṃ badz+ra s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ/ lan gsum gyis byin brlabs la/ kyai/ sngon tshe rgyal bas byin brlabs pa'i// gnas mchog sbas yul tsha ba'i rong*// sa 'dzin chen po skyong ba yi// zo dor gnyan dang dge bsnyen tshogs// brtan ma lha klu yul gzhi'i bdag /kun kyang sngon gyi zhal bzhes ltar// dam tshig dbang gis gnas 'dir byon// bdug spos dri bsung tshar dngar ba'i// mchod pa'i sprin las bkra shis brgyad// rgyal srid 'dod yon dkor nor dbyig /'phur dgu 'dzul bcu rkang 'gros tshogs// lha las lhag pa'i longs spyod rnams// 'bul bzhes dgyes zhing tshim gyur cig /mthu rtsal stobs ldan phas rgol gzhom// btsan po'i go bgos dpa' rngam can// dpung tshogs drag gtum 'bar ba rnams// bstod do bsang ngo mnga' gsol lo// dbang chen pad+ma thod phreng sogs// rtsa brgyud bla mas bka' bsgos ltar// rang dam rang gis ma bkral bar// sangs rgyas bstan skyong rnal 'byor srungs// skye dgu bde skyid dpal 'byor ldan// char chu dus 'bebs 'bru 'phel zhing*// nad yams 'khrugs zhi rnam kun tu// dga' bdes rtag par 'tsho 'gyur zhing*// phun tshogs ldan pa'i bkra shis mdzod// ces pa'ang dbu mdzad rin chen ngor spel ba dge// / ༈ smug po'i gnas kyi bsang mchod bzhugs/ oṃ swa sti/ 'dir li yul lcang ra smug po'i gnas zhing skyong ba chen mo'i bsang mchod spro na/ 'di nyid kho na bton pa'i tshe skyabs sems dang yi dam gyi bdag bskyed mos pa lam byed tsam sngon du btang nas/ dkar gsum mngar gsum gyis sbags pa'i dkar bshos dar snas brgyan pa dang*/

phye mar/ 'bru sna/ ja chang*/ 'o phud la rin chen phye ma btab pa dang*/ bsang khang zlum po la bdug spos kyi rigs dri bsung sna tshogs tshar du dngar ba gtsang zhing rgya che ba 'du byas par bshams la/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las dhī las bsang khang yid du 'ong ba dang*/ bh+rūm̐ las byung ba'i rin po che'i snod rnams su oṃ āḥhūm̐ las byung ba'i mchod rdzas rnams kha dog dri ro reg bya nus pa phun sum tshogs pa'i rang bzhin can zag med ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen po nam mkha'i mdzod du gyur// oṃ badz+ra s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ/ zhes lan gsum gyis byin brlabs nas/ hūm̐ hrīḥ bde chen ye shes 'khor lo chen po ru// dngos snang drwa ba sdom pa bcom ldan yab// lhan skyes yum bcas dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma// dgyes rol thar pa chen po'i zhing gi mchog /skyong mdzad sna tshogs sgyu 'phrul tshul shar bas// gnas dang nye ba'i gnas su gang 'dul gyi// skur ston mi las 'das pa'i gzugs can ma// mtshar sdug yid 'ong ḍā ki dpa' mo'i tshogs// gtso dang 'khor rnams 'jig rten skyong ba'i gzugs// grangs med kyis bskor sngon tshe dpal chen po// he ru ka yi bran du dam bcas bzhin// dam tshig rjes dgongs 'dir spyon sa mā dzaḥ zhes spyan drangs la/ yid sprul rnam mang rin chen khang bzang dbus// dam tshig brten pa'i rdzas la bag phob la// 'jam mnyen pad+ma spungs pa'i gdan bzhugs te// rig 'dzin rgyal ba rnams kyis dbang bskur ba'i// rdo rje'i tha tshig gnyen po dran mdzod la// khams kyi rags pa'i zas kyi sred bral yang*// mos dang dad pas legs sbyar bza' bca' dang*// btung ba'i tshogs rnams zag med bde ba che'i// ye shes bdud rtsi chen por byin brlabs nas// dang bas 'bul bzhes gang gi sku gsung thugs// dgyes bskyed rnam mang 'dod rgu kun bzang gi

/smon lam las byung mchod sprin nam mkha' yi// mtha' klas rgyas par 'gengs pa ji snyed dang*// khyad par dkar mngar kha zas bzang rgu yis// sbags pa'i bshos bu gzugs sgra dri dang ro// reg bya'i skye mched nyer spyod rnam pa lnga// bkra shis rdzas rtags spyan gzigs dkor cha sogs// phye mar ja chang gser skyems bdud rtsi'i mtsho// gang gi ljags kyi pad+mar rjes mthun du// 'bul gyi dgyes rol las bzhi'i phrin las sgrubs// dam tshig sdom pa ma smin dri bsung gis// ngo bo yum lnga'i rnam 'phrul bzang shing tshogs// ye shes zhugs lces sbar ba'i dud sprin gyis// lha srung grib kyis gos pa bsang gyur cig /lha zhal ri bong 'dzin las dkar ba yi// lha yi 'dzum 'od zer phreng spro bar mdzod// phyi ltar 'jig rten dbang phyug pho brang ste// nang du bde mchog 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor dngos// gsang ba rdo rje btsun mo'i mkha' dbyings mchog /rdo rje gnas kyi srung ma chen mor bstod// de ltar mchod bstod thugs dam bskul ba'i mthus// byams pa'i thugs kyis brtse bar rjes dgongs la// bstan dang 'gro la phan bde'i dpyid 'gyur pa'i// phrin las gang bcol thogs med 'grub par mdzod// khyad par dpal chen tsakra sam+ba ra'i// bskyed rdzogs zab lam rdo rje'i rnal 'byor che'i// brgyud 'dzin mnyam med dwags po bka' brgyud kyi// bstan pa rin chen spel pa'i las mdzod cig /sgrub mchog bsam don chos bzhin yongs 'grub cing*// tshe ring nad med dpal 'byor ye shes rgyas// 'jig rten bde zhing nad mug 'khrugs rtsod zhi// rdzogs ldan dus bzhin bskal pa bzang spyod pa'i// phrin las rab 'byams yid bzhin 'grub pa dang*// deng 'dir gnyis 'dzin 'khrul pas bslad pa yi// mchod rdzas mi gtsang ting 'dzin ma gsal sogs// nongs pa gang mchis bzod par gsol nas kyang*// 'jig rten 'jig rten las 'das dge legs tshogs// gong du 'phel zhing rab rgyas bkra shis shog

/ ces brjod/ badz+ra mūḥ gshegs su gsol/ zhes pa'ang si tu pad+ma nyin byed dbang pos/ drung pa sprul pa'i sku karma bstan 'dzin chos kyi rgyal po'i bzhed ngor spel ba dge// / ༈ gzhan yang bsang mchod mgron du 'os pa yi// sngon tshe pad+ma 'byung gnas spyan snga ru// khas blangs dkar phyogs skyong ba'i mthu rtsal can// so so rang rang gnas nas 'dir spyon la// dgyes dgu'i mchod sprin rgya mtsho dpag tu med// spyan gzigs dkor chas 'dod yon rnam pa lnga// sna tshogs blo yis blangs te mchod pa 'bul// zag med bde ba chen por tshim gyur cig /dam tshig ldan pa'i bka' nyan bstan skyong ba// bdud sde'i dpung gzhom lha srung rnams la bstod// de ltar gsol dang mchod pa la brten nas// rgyal bstan dri med nges don snying po yi// ring lugs phyogs bcur spel zhing rgyas pa dang*// de 'dzin skyes bu'i 'gro don phrin las sogs// rab 'phel yul ris sa phyogs 'di nyid du// char chu dus babs lo phyugs rtag tu legs// nad dang mtshon bskal la sogs mi mthun zhi// skye dgu bde la gzhol zhing rtag pa ru// rdzogs ldan dus bzhin dpal 'byor gong 'phel nas// chos mthun bsam pa 'grub pa'i phrin las mdzod// bdag cag ma rig 'khrul pas bslad pa yi// thugs 'gal nyes tshogs ma lus mthol zhing bshags// dkar phyogs lha dang srung ma'i bkra shis g.yang*// deng 'dir rtag tu bde legs ldan gyur cig / ces pa'ang ljang yul ya kre ma kwa sogs dge ba'i sems ldan rnams kyi ngor si tus smras pa sarba maṅga lam/// / ༈ 'dir yul lha khams gsum dbang phyug la bsang mchod byed par spro na/ a kā ro sa byin brlabs nas/ bsang mchod 'dod pa'i yon tan gtsang zhing yid 'ong dang ldan par gyur/ kyai/ sngon tshe rgyal dbang pad+mas byin brlabs pa'i// grub pa'i gnas mchog srung mar dam bcas shing*// bstan 'dzin skyong dang skye dgu'i legs stsol ba'i// khams gsum dbang phyug 'khor dang bcas pa kun// spyan drangs bzhugs gsol bsang mchod bdug pa'i sprin// 'dod yon rgyal srid dkor chas mchod pa'i tshogs// so sor mthun pa'i dngos 'byor yid sprul rnams// nam mkha' gang bar 'bul gyi bzhes su gsol// dkar phyogs skyong ba'i bstan srung mthu rtsal can// ma lus 'khor dang bcas kun bstod par bgyi// ma rig gnyis 'dzin 'khrul pa'i dbang gyur pas// thugs 'gal nyes tshogs byang dag tshangs par stsol// rgyal bstan srung dang rnal 'byor mthun rkyen sgrubs// gang bcol phrin las thogs med 'grub par mdzod// rang rang gnas gshegs slar yang byon pa dang*// bkra shis dpal gyi snang bas khyab gyur cig

/ ces bsod tshe'i ngor bris pa'o/// / ༈ rdo rje gdan mchog karma yi// gnas mchog 'di ru sa 'dzin bdag /dge bsnyen chen po 'khor bcas la// gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya chos// nyer spyod dkor nor 'dzam gling gi /yul gru so so'i longs spyod bcas// 'bul lo bzhes la karma pa'i// bstan srung phas rgol gzhom pa dang*// lus med rgyud bskul bslu chos mkhan// sangs rgyas bstan la dma' 'bebs rnams// skad cig thal bar brlag pa dang*// ming rus tsam yang med par mdzod// dus kun dag pa'i yul ljongs 'dir// skye dgu'i dpal 'byor rab rgyas shing*// bstan 'dzin zhabs brtan 'dus sde rgyas// bde legs char chen spel bar mdzod// ces karma rnam rol ngor spel/// / ༈ kyai/ yul lha 'dzi rgyal dga' bro la// dgyes dgu'i mchod 'bul bzhes su gsol// nongs pa'i tshogs kun dag tshangs stsol// gang bcol las kun 'grub par mdzod// ces dar rgyas nas bskul bzhin spel/// / ༈ bsang mchod kyi rim pa 'dod don lhun grub ces bya ba bzhugs so// oṃ badz+ra s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ/ dngos dang yid sprul rgya mtshos drangs pa'i bsang mchod zag med ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin rgya chen rgyun mi chad par gyur/ rang nyid lhar gsal ba'i thugs las 'od 'phros/ gnas bdag yul lha dge bsnyen la sogs pa bsang mgron gyi tshogs rnams gshegs par gyur// kyai/ dzam gling gangs can bsil ldan gyi// sa 'dzin phreng bas bskor ba'i zhing*// sngon tshe rgyal bas byin brlabs gnas// da lta gtsug lag chos 'khor gyi// bka' srung yul lha dkar phyogs skyong*// yongs kyi sde dpon dam tshig can// go che skyid dge gnyan po dang*// phyogs bzhi'i bka' nyan lha chen bzhi// la bzhi lung brgyad la sogs par// gzhi bdag gnyug mar gnas pa yi// mchod 'os mgron rnams thams cad la// so sor dgyes pa'i bsang mchod kyi// dud pa'i sprin phung zegs ma las// 'dod yon yid 'ong dpag med pa// nam mkha' mdzod kyi rang bzhin can// 'bul bzhes dgyes par rol par mdzod// spyan gzigs dkor cha gzugs 'gros sogs// phyi nang mchod pa bla med kyi// gsol lo mchod do mnga' gsol lo// nyams gyur nongs pa ci mchis pa// mthol bshags bzod gsol dag tshangs stsol// mthu rtsal thogs med rdzu 'phrul can// phrin las sna tshogs cir yang sgyur// bsngags 'os kun kyang bstod par bgyi// sngon tshe o rgyan chen po dang*// sgrub brgyud bla ma'i rdo rje'i bka'// dam tshig gnyan po dran bzhin du// yal gam ma 'das sa ma ya// khyod la phrin las bcol ba ni// yul ljongs sa phyogs 'di nyid du// nges don bstan pa'i ring lugs mchog

/nyams med dar zhing rgyas pa dang*// chos mthun bstan 'dzin dge 'dun sde// 'khor lo gnyis kyi yon tan rgyas// nyer 'tshe gzugs can gzugs med kyi// dam sri'i rgyud bskul byed pa rnams// tshar gcod rjes 'dzin phrin las mdzod// rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas rnams// nyin mtshan rtag par skyong ba dang*// bsam pa yid bzhin lhun gyis grub// tshe ring nad med bde skyid ldan// 'di dang gtan 'dun yongs kyi gtso// bstan pa'i zhabs tog spel nus pa'i// snang srid dbang bsgyur stongs grogs mdzod// skye dgu ma lus thams cad kyang*// rtag par byams pa'i sems ldan zhing*// kun kyang bde ldan yongs grub pa'i// bkra shis kun khyab 'od stong can// nyin mtshan gung la gsal gyur cig /gats+tsha sa mchod yul rang gnas btang*/ zhes gnas mdo'i dge slong karma rnam rgyal ngor bkra shis sgang gi chos sgar nas si tus spel ba dge// / ༈ a mṛ ta sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong las bsang khang rin chen du// bdug pa'i sprin tshogs mi zad pa// nam mkha' mdzod kyi rang bzhin can// mchod rdzas yid 'ong dpag med gyur// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ/ lan gsum/ kye/ dkon mchog gsum dang rtsa ba gsum// phyogs bcu dus gsum bde bar gshegs// rgyud sde bzhi 'brel yi dam lha// gnas gsum dpa' bo ḍā ki'i tshogs// ye shes las dang 'jig rten gyi// dregs byed chos skyong rgya mtsho dang*// dgra bla ye brdzu mched 'khor g.yog /lha brag dkar po rdo rje 'bar// rang sde sprul dang yang sprul sogs// lha rigs mgon dang skyob pa yi// yang mes rgyud kyi srung ma dang*// gzhan yang yul ljongs 'dir gnas pa'i// dam tshig can dang stongs grogs mkhan// gzhi bdag yul lha zo dor dang*// dge bsnyen sman mo sa bdag sogs// mdor na mchod 'os mgron rnams kun// thams cad 'dir gshegs bsang la byon// rang rang dgyes dgur rol pa yi// 'dod yon zag med longs spyod kyi// dri bsung phun sum tshogs pa 'dis// bsang ngo mchod do mnga' gsol lo// rang phyogs srung zhing gzhan phyogs 'joms// rtsal ldan dpa' bo rngams brjid can// myur mgyogs drag shul ldan pa yi// dkar po'i phyogs skyong rnams la bstod// de ltar mchod bstod dge ba'i mthus// bstan 'gro'i bde skyid mkha' dang mnyam// khyad par mi dbang lha yi gdung*// rigs kyi sku lha ma g.yel bar// mnga' ris sde dpung dpal 'byor gyi// longs spyod 'dzad med char bzhin phob// tshe bsod dbang thang klung rta dar// mi brgyud 'phel zhing phyugs spel ba'i// phrin las stongs grogs myur du mdzod// nad yams chod la dal kha bsgyur// bsam ngan sbyor rtsub dug rlangs can// dgra bgegs thal ba'i rdul du rlogs// sngon tshe o rgyan chen po dang*// rig 'dzin mi 'gyur rdo rje yis// bka' bsgos tha tshig rjes dran nas// ji ltar bcol pa'i phrin las rnams// ma g.yel ma 'da' sa ma ya// rang rang gnas su bder gshegs la// slar yang mchod phyir 'byon par gsol// sarba bhū ta gats+tsha

sa gshegs/ zhes lha thog dpon tshang gi rta dpon pa a lha nas bskul ba ltar/ si tu pad+ma nyin byed dbang pos spel/// / ༈ a mṛ ta sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong las bsang khang yid 'ong nang*// 'dod yon lnga ldan dri mchog gi /yon tan zag med nam mkha'i mdzod// skabs gsum longs spyod las lhag gyur// a kā ra ོsa byin brlabs nas/ kyai/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dang*// dpa' bo rnal 'byor chos skyong dang*// zhing skyong gnas srung yul lha'i tshogs// dkar po'i phyogs rnams skyong byed pa// thams can ma lus 'dir gshegs la// rang rang dgyes dgur rol pa yi// yid 'ong bsang mchod dpag med 'di// 'bul gyi brtse bar dgongs mdzod la// o rgyan rje dang rang byung ba// grub pa'i dbang phyug mchog rnams kyis// bka' bsgos dam bzhag ma bsnyel bar// sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung ba dang*// sgrub pa'i bar chad bzlog tu gsol// yul phyogs kun kyang bde zhing skyid// rdzogs ldan bskal par spyod pa yi// phrin las myur mgyogs stongs grogs mdzod// sarba bhū ta gats+tsha

sa gshegs/ zhes pa'ang lha steng grwa pa zhig gi ngor si tus spel/ bkra shis/// / ༈ a mṛ ta sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong las bsang khang yid 'ong bar// shing sna tshogs pa'i dud sprin las// lha mi'i 'dod yon dkor nor tshogs// zag med bde chen skyed byed gyur// oṃ badz+ra s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ/ lan gsum/ kye/ mchog gsum rtsa gsum kun 'dus rdo rje 'chang*// pad+ma 'od 'bar rje btsun sgrol ma yum// gsar rnying brgyud pa'i lha tshogs thams cad dang*// ber nag gur mgon re ti dam zhing sogs// chos skyong pho rgyud mo rgyud thams cad bsang*// ti se thang lha spom ra ger mdzo gnyen// dkar phyogs skyong ba'i zo dor ma lus dang*// yul phyogs 'di yi gnyug mar gnas kun bsang*// so sor dgyes pa'i longs spyod dpal 'byor bzang*// rgya chen rgyun mi chad pa 'di dag kun// dngos 'byor yid sprul bla med mchod pa'i sprin// 'bul bzhes mthu yis rnal 'byor tshe bsod spel// mthun rkyen bsgrub la 'gal rkyen bar chad sol// kha 'dzin sdong grogs srung skyob mi 'bral bar// legs kha rgyal kha thob cing la chu 'phrang*// sngun bsu rgyab brten rtag par mel tshe dang*// gzhi byes kun tu dge ba'i phrin las mdzod// nyin mtshan kun tu g.yel med mgon skyob sogs// mdor na bsam don thogs med bde blag tu// 'grub pa'i dngos grub thogs med stsal du gsol// thugs rje myur mgyogs byin rlabs mtha' klas pa// bstod 'os rnams la dad pas bsngags par bgyi// mchod rdzas dngos 'dzin dri mas bslad pa yi// nongs pa dag tshangs dus dang gnas skabs kun// bkra shis bde legs char gyi dpal 'bar shog /sarba bhū ta gats+tsha sa gshegs/ zhes pa'ang dbon drung mgon po don grub kyis bskul ba bzhin/ si tu pad+ma nyin byed dbang pos spel/// / ༈ bh+rūm̐ las rin chen snod yangs par// kham zhu 'dod yon dud pa'i sprin// rgya chen rgyun mi chad par gyur// kyai/

grub dbang mtsho skyes pad+ma 'byung*// rig 'dzin rtsa brgyud bla ma yi// spyan sngar mna' bor yal gam can// rngom thi dge bsnyen 'khor dang bcas// 'dir gshegs 'dir bshams gdan la bzhugs// nyer spyod tshang zhing yid 'ong ba// zad mi shes pa'i mchod sprin tshogs// rang rang dgyais dgur rol pa yi// srid zhi'i dpal 'byor dngos kun 'di// gnas mchog skyong ba'i tshogs la 'bul// mi gtsang rkyen gyis mnol ba kun// dri ldan spos mchog 'di dag gis// sangs shing mthu rtsal stobs dang ldan// rgyal bstan srung dang 'gro tshogs skyongs// char chu dus 'bebs skya rgyal zhing*// rnal 'byor gang bcol phrin las kun// g.yel med nyid du 'grub par mdzod// ces mthar phyin dang bsam 'grub bcas kyi ngor si tus spel/// / ༈ a kā ro sa byin brlabs/ bh+rūm̐ las rin chen snod yangs par// kham zhu bsang mchod 'dod yon rnams// kun bzang smon lam ji bzhin par// rgya chen nam mkha' mdzod bzhin gyur// kyai/ rgyal bas byin brlabs grub pa'i gnas// 'bum rdzong chos kyi pho brang mchog /bka' brgyud rig 'dzin rgya mtsho dang*// bde mchog 'khor lo'i lha yi tshogs// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro sprin bzhin gtibs// chos skyong dam can rlung ltar 'tshubs// gzhan yang yul gzhi gnas kyi bdag /dge bsnyen dkar po'i sde skyong ba// 'byung po mthu chen gnyug mar gnas// glo bur lhags pa'i mgron rnams la// so so'i yid mthun dngos 'byor dang*// yid sprul blo yis blangs nas su// rtsa gsum lha tshogs dgyes bskangs shing*// mchog thun dngos grub char chen stsol// las bzhi'i 'dod don lhun grub mdzod// snang srid gzhi bdag dge bsnyen sogs// mchod sbyin 'dis tshim mthu rtsal ldan// byams pa'i sems kyis skye dgu skyongs// lo legs 'bru 'phel rtswa rgyas shing*// bkra shis snang ba'i 'od zer gyis// mi mthun rgud pa'i mun pa zhi// phan bde'i pad tshal rgyas gyur cig

/ ces nya khe lhun grub dbang rgyal ngor spel/// / ༈ a mṛ ta sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong las bh+rūm̐ yig ser po yongs su gyur// yid 'ong gtor snod srid gsum khyab pa'i nang*// 'bru gsum 'od zhu zag med ye shes kyi// bsang mchod bdud rtsi'i sprin gtibs char 'bebs gyur// a kā ro lan gsum gyis byin brlabs la/ kyai/ dam tshig 'du 'bral med pa yi// bla med gsang sngags zab mo'i lam// ston mchog dpal ldan rdo rje can// bka' brgyud grub thob rgya mtsho dang*// theg pa rim dgu'i lha yi tshogs// dpa' bo ḍā ki chos srung ma// khyad par gnas chen skyong ba yi// dkar po lha yi sde dpung gi /tshogs rje'i bdag por dbang bskur zhing*// rig 'dzin pad+ma'i dge bsnyen che// 'bri gnyan rdo rje blo gros rtsal// sras yum sprul dang yang 'khor bcas// sngon gyi thugs dam brtser dgongs la// rnal 'byor sgrub pa'i gnas mchog 'dir// spyan 'dren ci ltar bde bar bzhugs/ kun bzang smon lam ji bzhin pa'i// bsang mchod bdug pa'i sprin phung las// bkra shis rdzas rtags 'dod yon dang*// lha klu mi yi longs spyod tshogs// rgya chen rgyun mi chad pa 'di// 'bul bzhes dgyes pa bskang gyur cig /bag med nongs par gyur pa bshags// grub pa'i dbang phyug mchog rnams kyi// rdo rje'i bka' las ma 'da' bar// las bzhi'i phrin las bsgrub pa dang*// dri med rgyal bstan ring lugs gang*// dar rgyas yun gnas bstan 'dzin rnams// 'tsho gzhes dge 'dun chos spyod 'phel// rgyal khams nad yams mtshon 'khrugs zhi// char chu dus 'bebs lo 'bras legs// gzugs can gzugs med 'gro ba rnams// byang chub sems kyis rgyud bskul nas// yang dag bden pa mthong ba dang*// rtag tu bkra shis phun tshogs shog / shu bhaṃ/// / ༈ oṃ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong las bh+rūm̐ yig yongs su gyur// rin chen snod du yig 'bru gsum// 'od zhu 'dod yon dpag med dang*// dri bsung kun bzang mchod sprin gyur// oṃ badz+ra s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ/

kyai/ rgyal dbang mtsho skyes rdo rje 'chang*// grub pa'i slob dpon u rgyan rje// pad+ma 'byung gnas 'gro ba'i mgon// karma pak+shi la sogs pa'i// spyan sngar tha tshig g.yar dam can// dkar phyogs lha yi sde dpon che// zil phrom rdo rje g.yu drung rtsal// 'khor bcas 'dir gshegs gdan la bzhugs// bsang mchod nam mkha' mdzod bzhin pa'i// zag med ye shes bdud rtsi dngos// sbyang spel bsgyur ba bla med kyi// spyan gzigs dkor cha nor dbyig sogs// 'dod dgu'i dpal 'byor char ltar 'bebs// 'khor bcas mthun rdzas dpag med kyis// gsol lo mchod do mnga' gsol lo// nyams gyur nongs pa ci mchis bshags// sngon tshe grub pa'i dbang phyug mchog /rtsa ba brgyud pa'i bla ma yi// bka' dang dam tshig rjes dgongs la// nges don bstan pa rin po che// srid mthar gnas shing bstan 'dzin dang*// 'dus pa dbyar mtsho ltar rgyas shing*// skye dgu kun kyang byang chub kyi// sems kyis rang rgyud yongs smin nas// rnam dag dam pa'i chos spyod cing*// nad mtshon yams dang lo nad zhi// char chu dus babs bde skyid ldan// rtag tu bkra shis rab rgyas shog /gats+tsha sa gshegs/ bsang mchod le tshan gnyis 'di bzhin dad dam ldan pa bsod nams dbang rgyal bskul ngor/ si tu pad+ma nyin byed dbang pos bris pa dza ya/// / ༈ snang srid chos kun stong nyid gyur// rang nyid skad cig pad+ma 'byung*// gsal ba'i mdun du 'jig rten gyi// dregs byed dkar po'i sde skyong ba// rdo rje lha rtse 'khor dang bcas// sngon gyi dam tshig rjes dgongs la// thugs dam dbang gis 'dir gshegs bzhugs// bsang dang gser skyems mchod pa'i sprin// sna tshogs 'dod dgur dbang sgyur ba'i// yid dang mthun pa'i mchod rdzas tshogs// 'bul gyi dgyes bskang tshim gyur cig /las bzhi'i dngos grub dpal ster zhing*// sangs rgyas bstan dang bstan 'dzin gyi// bar chad kun sel phrin las sgrubs// rgyal ba'i spyan sngar dam bcas pa'i// yul bdag chen po 'khor dang bcas// rab tu dge ba'i sems kyis bstod// de ltar mchod dang bstod pa'i mthus// nges don dri med pad+ma dkar// 'dab brgya grol ba'i gnyen gcig pu// thub dbang pad 'byung karma pa'i// ring lugs nor 'dzin khyon yangs por// nyin mo byed ltar gsal ba dang*// gzhan yang skye dgu bde legs kyi// lo 'dab kun tu dkrigs pa yi// mthu rtsal nus pa'i dri bzhon gyis// phan bde'i char chen stsol gyur cig

/dus dang gnas skabs thams cad du// byams pa'i sems kyis rtag tu skyongs// rnam kun bkra shis dge legs kyis// rtag par bde dang ldan par mdzod// gats+tsha sa gshegs/ zhes karma phun tshogs nas bskul ltar spel/// / ༈ rang nyid lhar gsal thugs ka nas// 'od 'phros mchod rdzas 'dod yon gyi// gnyis 'dzin dri ma kun bsangs nas// gang 'dod longs spyod nam mkha'i mdzod// ji bzhin rgyun mi chad par spel// mgron rnams dgyes bskyed rang bzhin gyur// oṃ badz+ra s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ/ lan gsum brjod/ kyai/ sngon tshe o rgyan chen po dang*// dpal ldan byang chub gling pa yi// spyan sngar tha tshig yal gam can// yul phyogs 'dir gnas gzhi yi bdag /gnyug mar gnas pa ma lus dang*// khyad par dpal rgyal ra rje gnyan// gzhan yang gnas yul skyong byed pa// kun kyang 'dir gshegs mchod pa'i rdzas// 'dod yon zag med sna tshogs rnams// so sor dgyes rdzas mkho dgu'i tshogs// dngos 'byor yid las sprul pa yi// bsang dang mchod pa 'di bzhes la// rtsa brgyud bla mas bka' bsgos ltar// rang phyogs srung zhing skyong ba dang*// sangs rgyas bstan dang bstan 'dzin spel// rnal 'byor bdag gis gang bcol ba'i// phrin las ma g.yel sdong grogs mdzod// gzhi byes kun tu legs kha dang*// rgyal kha btod la 'tsho ba sbyor// lo legs 'bru 'phel skya rgyal zhing*// char chu dus 'bab bde skyid ldan// nad mug mtshon bskal zhi ba dang*/ kun kyang dkar po'i chos la spyod// bsam don lhun gyis grub nas su// rtag par bkra shis bsam don kun// ji bzhin 'grub par mdzad du gsol// gats+tshas gshegs/ zhes pa'ang karma nor bus bskul ngor spel/// / ༈ oṃ badz+ra s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ/ bsang mchod 'dod dgu'i rgya mtsho mtha' klas gyur/ kyai/ sngon tshe gsang bdag pad 'byung gi /bka' gnyan yul lha dkar phyogs skyong*// smug sangs dge bsnyen chen po dang*// mi nyag rgya yi zo dor sogs// khyad par sum dil la gnas pa'i// gzhi bdag gnyug mar gnas pa rnams// 'dir gshegs zhi ba bsang mchod 'bul// dgyes bskang yid la 'dod 'jo ba'i// rnam bzhi'i phrin las ma g.yel sgrubs// kha 'dzin sdong grogs rgyab brten dang*// legs dang rgyal kha thob par mdzod// mthu dang rtsal ldan rnams la bstod// gnyis snang 'dzin pa'i 'khrul dbang gis// nongs pa bshags so byang dag stsol// rnam kun bkra shis dge ba'i char// 'bad med lhun grub dpal du shog

/ ces pa dge slong bsam gtan la spel/// / ༈ bsang rdzas rnams/ a mṛ ta sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong las bsang mchod 'dod yon rdzas// dngos 'dzin dri sbyang zag med kyi// bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin rgya chen po// so sor mos thob longs spyod gyur// a kā ro sa byin brlabs la/ kyai/ phyogs bcu'i zhing bzhugs bla ma dang*// sangs rgyas byang sems yi dam lha// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos srung ma// khyad par rdo rje nag po ber// lcam dral bka' 'khor bcas pa dang*// lha yi dge bsnyen chen po ste// dpal ldan shes rab 'khor dang g.yog /sprul dang yang sprul rgya mtsho rnams// 'dir byon dgyes pa'i gdan la bzhugs// dngos 'byor mchod pa'i bye brag rdzas// rab 'byams mkha' dbyings khyon bkang ba// lha mi'i dpal 'byor sna tshogs pa// 'dod yon lnga ldan mi zad gter// bsang mchod dam pa 'bul gyi bzhes// dgyes par rol mdzod smin grol gyi// mchog thun dngos grub stsol ba dang*// las bzhi'i phrin las lhun grub cing*// sangs rgyas bstan dang bstan 'dzin gyi// zhabs brtan rnal 'byor bdag cag gi /'dod don yid bzhin re ba skongs/ tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor rgyas// nad gdon sngon las 'phral rkyen gyi// mi mthun phyogs rnams zhi bar mdzod// rtag par srung skyob mi 'bral bar// kha 'dzin sdong grogs dpung gnyen mdzod// mchod 'os rang bzhin gnas su gshegs// bkra shis snang bas skyong gyur cig / ces pa'ang lha bris pa dbang rgyal ngor spel ba'o/// / ༈ oṃ las rin chen snod yangs par// bh+rūm̐ yig yongs gyur mchod pa'i rdzas// bsang dang brngan pa'i yo byad kyi// longs spyod nam mkha' mdzod bzhin spel// oṃ badz+ra s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ/ kyai/ rgyal bas byin brlabs grub pa'i gnas// gdan sa chos 'khor skyong ba yi// mgon byed lha dang srung ma dang*// yul phyogs 'dir gnas gzhi yi bdag

/dkar po'i phyogs rnams dgyes pa yi// dngos 'byor yid sprul mchod tshogs 'bul// mi gtsang nyams grib thams cad sol// lha zhal zla ltar dkar ba dang*// sangs rgyas bstan pa rin po che// nyi ltar kun khyab rab gsal zhing*// sems can thams cad bde ldan shog / ces pa'ang mdzod dgon grwa pa zhig gi ngor spel/// / ༈ rang nyid lha yi nga rgyal la gnas bzhin pas/ a mṛ ta sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ bh+rūm̐ las byung ba'i snod yangs par// 'bru gsum 'od zhu zag med bcud// bla med mkha' dbyings khyon bkang ba// rgya chen rgyun mi chad par gyur// a kā ro sa byin brlabs la/ kyai/ sngon tshe grub pa'i rig 'dzin mchog /o rgyan pad+mā kā ra yi// zab gter rgya mtsho'i 'byung gnas kyi// sbas pa'i yul ljongs nyams re dga'// dpa' bo ḍā ki yi dam dang*// bka' brgyud bla ma sprin bzhin gtibs// dam can srung ma char ltar babs// sgrub gnas dam pa byin re che// pad 'byung dngos snang gang 'dul gyi// sgyu 'phrul rdo rje'i gar ston pa// zab don bdud rtsi'i yang snying gang*// mnga' bdag mi 'gyur mtshan can zhabs// la sogs rtsa bar brgyud pa yi// bka' dang dam gnas dkar po yi// sde dang phyogs rnams skyong byed cing*// mgon dang kha 'dzin stongs grogs mkhan// lha yi dge bsnyen chen po ni// lha brag dkar po rdo rje 'bar// 'khor tshogs sprul dang yang sprul dang*// gnas brgyad dge bsnyen sba nag gnyan// khams rgyal re pho dkrigs rgyal dang*// se tho khyung rdzong pha wong gwa// la sogs gnas yul 'dir brten pa'i// gnas dang gzhi yi bdag po bsang*// mchod do yul lha'i dpung tshogs mchod// brngan no rigs kyi srung ma brngan// gsol lo mchod do mnga' gsol lo// sangs rgyas bstan srung mnga' gsol lo// rnal 'byor dgra bla mnga' = dkar po'i phyogs skyong mnga' = nag phyogs g.yul bzlog=

rten sgrub mgon byed mnga' gsol lo// bsang mchod so sor mos thob kyi// longs spyod 'dod yon lnga ldan pa// spyan gzigs dkor chas skong rten rdzas// ma tshang med 'bul dgyes brtser rol// khyod la bcol ba'i phrin las ni// dkon mchog dbu 'phang bstod pa dang*// bstan dang bstan 'dzin zhabs pad brtan// rig dang grol ba'i sde chen po// phyogs mthar khyab yun gnas pa dang*// mnga' ris bde zhing skye dgu rnams// chos mthun bsam 'grub log phyogs kyi// bdud dpung nam yang ldang med shog /mdor na ci ltar bcol ba yi// las bzhi'i phrin las gang yin pa// thogs med bde blag 'grub pa dang*// bde legs bsam don lhun grub shog /gats+tsha

brlabs la/ rang nyid lhar gsal thugs ka nas// 'od 'phros mgron rnams spyan drangs gyur// kyai/ sngon tshe rgyal dbang pad 'byung dang*// grub chen karma pak+shi sogs// rtsa brgyud bla ma'i spyan snga ru// tha tshig dam bca' yal gam can// dkar phyogs skyong ba'i dge bsnyen che// rtse rgyal zhal da 'khor bcas la// rang rang dgyes dgur rol pa yi// 'dod dgu'i dpal 'byor lha dang mi'i// longs spyod sna tshogs bkra ba dang*// bsung zhim ngad bzang ma la ya'i// dri bzhon lta bu'i bsang dud sprin// rab 'byams khams kun spros te 'bul// mi gtsang nyes pa'i dri ma sol// bstod do bsang ngo mnga' gsol lo// de ltar mchod bstod la brten nas// bdag cag gzhi byes lam gsum du// kha 'dzin sdong grogs rgyab brten dang*// gang bcol 'dod don yid bzhin du// lhun gyis grub pa'i phrin las mdzod// bkra shis mkha' yi nor bu'i 'od// phan bde'i 'dab brgya bzhad pa dang*// tshe dpal ye shes snang ba bskyed// mi mthun phyogs las rnam rgyal shog /gats+tshas gshegs/ zhes pa'ang dpon bi dza ya'i bzhed ngor spel ba dge
