skyong yul phyogs 'dir// nad mug mtshon bskal zhi ba dang*// rtswa rgyas 'bru 'phel dga' dang bde'i// dpal 'byor rgya chen stsol gyur cig

/ ces pa'ang dpon dzam lhas bskul ngor yul lha de nyid dang nye bar spel/// / ༈ a mṛ ta sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong las rin chen snod kyi nang*// 'bru gsum 'od zhu bsang mchod rdzas// zag med dpal 'byor 'dod dgu'i char// nam mkha' mdzod bzhin rgya chen gyur// a kā ro sa byin brlabs la/ kye/ sngon tshe 'chi med grub pa'i gtso// rgyal dbang pad+ma thod phreng gi /bka' bsgos yal gam dam tshig can// gnyu rgyal ra la bya khyung dang*// btsun mo sras 'khor yang sprul pa// dkar phyogs mthu ldan stongs grogs mkhan// yul ljongs bde skyid spel ba yi// gnyug mar gnas pa'i dge bsnyen dang*// gzhi bdag gnas bdag mchod sgrub cing*// rigs chos rgyud kyi srung ma rnams// kun kyang 'dir byon bsang mchod bzhes// dngos 'byor mchod sprin rgya mtsho'i tshogs// rang rang mos pa'i mkho dgu yi// longs spyod sna tshogs blos blangs te// 'bul bzhes dgyes pa bskang gyur cig /bag med nyes pa'i dbang gis ni// nongs pa mchis rnams bzod pa mdzod// khyod la phrin las bcol ba ni// sangs rgyas bstan dang bstan 'dzin spel// dge 'dun sde skyong rnal 'byor gyi// yid la gang bsam sgrub pa dang*// yul ris sa phyogs 'di nyid du// char chu dus 'babs lo legs shing*// nad mug mtshon bskal dal yams zhi// skye dgu dkar po'i chos ldan zhing*// dus kun bkra shis 'byung gyur cig / ces pa'ang ban chen bla ma karma rab dga'i ngor spel/// / ༈ 'dir ma mgon lcam dral gtsor bton pa'i yul lhar bsang brngan mdor bsdus spro na/ mchod rdzas rnams/ a mṛ ta sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bsang mchod rdzas// 'bru gsum ngo bo 'od du zhu// zag med longs spyod 'dod dgu'i char// mkha' dbyings khyon gang bde chen gyur// oṃ badz+ra s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ/ hūm̐/ rang nyid lhar gsal thugs ka nas// 'od 'phros 'og min byang phyogs kyi// dur khrod rab 'jigs gzhal yas nas// dpal ldan ma hā kā la che// rdo rje ber nag zangs gri can// 'dod khams dbang phyug dpal lha mo// ma gcig rang byung srid rgyal mo// bka' sdod bstan srung dam tshig can// 'khor bcas 'dir byon bsang mchod bzhes// skong rten sgrub dang mchod pa'i rdzas// spyan gzigs dkor chas lha dang mi'i// dpal 'byor phun tshogs nam mkha'i mdzod// ji bzhin spel 'di dgyes brtser rol// phrin las rnam bzhi'i mnga' dbang can// dregs byed srung ma'i tshogs la bstod// bdag cag byang chub bsgrub pa la// mthun rkyen spel la 'gal rkyen sol// bcol pa'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod// gzhan yang mgron du 'os pa yi// yul lha zla rgyal dge bsnyen che// g.yung drung lha rtse 'khor dang bcas// khyad par dgon gnas 'di nyid du// gnyug mar gnas pa'i yul gzhi'i bdag

/mgon skyob dpung grogs byed pa rnams// 'bod pa'i gnas 'dir spyan 'dren na// 'dir gshegs so sor mos thob kyi// bsang dang mchod rdzas sna tshogs pa// 'bul bzhes dgyes bskang rtsa brgyud kyi// bla ma'i bka' las ma 'da' bar// dkar po'i phyogs skyongs nag phyogs thul// god 'dre dbul sri zhi bar mdzod// 'gal rkyen sol la stongs grogs dang*// rgyab brten kha 'dzin ma g.yel bar// legs kha rgyal kha thob pa dang*// gang bcol phrin las myur 'grub mdzod// ye shes 'jig rten mgron rnams kun// rang bzhin gnas gshegs dus su ni// slar 'byon rnam kun bkra shis pa'i// nyin byed 'od stong gsal gyur nas// dge legs rgya mtsho mtha' rgyas shog / ces pa'ang drung ram pa bla ma karma snyan grags dpal bzang ngor spel ba dza yan+tu/// / ༈ bh+rūm̐ las rin chen snod yangs par// mchod rdzas zag med bde ba che'i// ye shes bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor 'khyil// bdug spos sprin bzhin gtibs par gyur// oṃ badz+ra s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ/ lan gsum/ kyai/ dkar po lha yi phyogs skyong zhing*// nag po'i bdud ris mthar byed pa'i// yul lha zo dor yongs kyi gtso// sa yi nyi zla'i ri bo dang*// ljang ra smug po'i gnas kyi bdag /khyad par la shrī gan+dho la'i// srung ma dge bsnyen yab yum sras// gzhan yang nyal 'gro 'dzin ma'i gzhir// gnas bcas klu gnyan sa bdag dang*// brag btsan la sogs gnyug mar gnas// mchod 'os spyi dang glo bur mgron// kun kyang 'dir gshegs bsang mchod rdzas// so sor mos thob dkor nor rdzas// srid gsum dngos po'i longs spyod dang*// ma la ya klung ha ri ljon// dri bzhon gyis bskul ngad bzang spos// rgya mtsho'i gos can kun khyab pa'i// sdom pa dam tshig tshul khrims kyi// byin rlabs chu 'dzin rab tu gtibs// byams dang snying rje'i rang rtsal mdangs// 'phros pas lha klu yul gzhi'i bdag

/rmugs dang nyams dang mnol grib sangs// byang chub sems kyis rgyud brlan cing*// sngon tshe sur+ya 'od zer dang*// rtsa brgyud bla ma'i bka' bzhin du// dam gnas tha tshig rjes dran la// rgyal bstan skyong zhing bstan 'dzin srung*// dge 'dun 'phel rgyas 'gro khams bde// char chu dus 'babs lo phyugs legs// nad mug mtshon bskal dal yams zhi// rnal 'byor bcol ba'i 'dod don kun// thogs med nyid du 'grub par mdzod// srung skyob mi 'bral dus kun skyongs// dge zhing shis pa'i phun tshogs kyi// bkra shis rab brtan rab rgyas shog /gats+tsha sa gshegs/ zhes pa'ang sgrub pa tshe dbang dpal 'bar nas bskul ngor spel/// / ༈ a mṛ ta sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ oṃ las rin chen snod yangs par// kham zhu bsang dang mchod pa'i rdzas// dud sprin zer las 'dod dgu'i char// yid bzhin zag med bde bskyed gyur// oṃ badz+ra s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ/ kyai/ rgyal dbang mtsho skyes pad 'byung gis// bka' bsgos lha yi dge bsnyen che// khyung drag rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal// dgyes sde 'khor dang yang 'khor bcas// gzhan yang yul phyogs 'dir gnas pa'i// dge ba'i sdong grogs mdzad pa yi// gnyug mar gnas pa'i dkar phyogs skyong*// kun kyang 'dir byon bsang mchod 'bul// so sor mos thob sna tshogs rdzas// 'chi med bdag po'i longs spyod bzhin// dgyes bskang mthun pa'i yo byad tshogs// 'bul bzhes thugs dam brtser dgongs la// nyams chag mnol grib bsang gyur cig /rtag tu 'go zhing srung ba dang*// mthu rtsal stobs ldan phywa ga yang phob// sngon tshe rtsa brgyud bla ma yi// bka' dang dam tshig ma g.yel bar// rnal 'byor bsam don myur 'grub pa'i// phrin las thogs med bsgrub par mdzod/ / gats+tsha sa rang gnas gshegs/ zhes pa dad dam ldan pa bkra shis lha dar ngor spel ba dge// / ༈ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong las rin chen snod yangs par// 'bru gsum 'od zhu mchod pa'i rdzas// dri zhim bdug pa'i sprin phung gis// phyogs kun rgyas par 'gengs par gyur// oṃ badz+ra s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ/

kyai/ sngon tshe rgyal dbang pad+ma thod phreng gis// sbas pa'i yul ljongs byin rlabs shar phyogs kyi// rgyal mo tsha ba rong gi gzhi gnas bdag /'jig rten dregs byed dam tshig can gyi grogs// yul lha tho bug bha we dre dang ni// ya phri ta phyi ka ra wa rnams dang*// ya wo ni sogs gnas yul skyong ba rnams// 'dir byon zhi ba bsang gi mchod pa'i rdzas// so sor mos thob spyan gzigs dkor chas brjid// lha mi'i longs spyod 'dod yon sna tshogs dang*// khyad par dri bzhon gyis bskul dbyar skyes kyi// phreng ba dkrigs 'dra ma la ya rlung gis// bskyod pa'i ha ri tsan+dan ngad ldang pa'i// bsang mchod 'di 'bul tshim zhing dgyes par rol// mi gtsang ngan spyod grib kyis gos pa bsang*// mthu rtsal nus ldan dkar phyogs skyong rnams bstod// rgyal bstan skyong dang chos 'khor 'dus pa rgyas// yul ris sa phyogs rgyal khams 'di nyid du// skye dgu rnams kyang bde dga'i dpal ldan cing*// lo legs 'bru 'phel nad dang gnod pa zhi// mthun rkyen 'dod dgu grub par mdzad du gsol// mdor na rnal 'byor bsam don gang yin pa// lhun gyis grub par bcol kun phrin las mdzod// gats+tsha sa rang gnas su gshegs/ zhes pa 'di rgyal rong legs bshad ngor spel/// / ༈ a mṛ ta sa bsangs la/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong las bh+rūm̐ yig rin chen snod// yid 'ong mkha' ltar khyab pa'i nang*// 'bru gsum 'od zhu bsang mchod rdzas// zag med bde chen skyed byed pa// 'dod yon sna tshogs sprin gyi char// snang srid zhing khams 'byams klas pa'i// kun tu bzang po'i smon lam bzhin// rgya chen rgyun ma chad par spel// a kā ro sa byin brlabs la/ rang nyid lhar gsal thugs 'od las// zer 'phros mchod 'os mgron rigs rnams// sngon gyi dam tshig rje dran nas// skad cig thogs med 'dir gshegs gyur// kyai/

bcom ldan shākya seng ge yis// bdud btul mngon byang chub pa'i sa// rdo rje gdan gyi byang gi phyogs// bsil ri'i ljongs te gangs can yul// shar gyi char bstan sbas pa'i gnas// rgyal mo tsha ba'i rong chen gyi// dkar po lha yi sde dpon che// nag phyogs bdud ris mthar byed pa'i// yul lha zo dor yongs kyi gtso// a'u thabs shes gnyan po ni// rdzu 'phrul sna tshogs stobs 'chang zhing*// sku mdog cha lugs cir yang bsgyur// btsun mo sras 'khor yang sprul dang*// gzhan yang chos 'khor gtsug lag skyong*// dge ba'i grogs dang mgon byed pa'i// gzhi bdag gnyug mar gnas pa rnams// kun kyang 'dir byon gdan la bzhugs// 'dir bshams bsang mchod dud pa'i sprin// cha shas zer ma re re las// bkra shis rdzas rtags 'dod yon lnga// mkho dgu'i spyan gzigs dkor chas dang*// nyer spyod rin chen gser gyi skyems// rang rang ji ltar mos thob kyi// sna tshogs yid la 'dod 'jo ba'i// mchod rdzas rgya chen 'bul bzhes gsol// ngad bzang bdug pa'i dri bzhon gyis// bying rmugs dme dang nyams grib sogs// mi gtsang nyes pa thams cad sol// sangs rgyas chos kyi 'khor lo'i gzhi// bstan pa gnyan srung phas rgol 'joms// dkar phyogs skyong ba'i sde dpon che// gsol lo mchod do mnga' gsol lo// rnam dag nges pa'i ring lugs gang*// 'dzin byed rdo rje slob dpon dang*// slob mar bcas kun skyong byed pa// gsol lo= rgyal khams bde ldan nyer 'tsho'i gnas// sa skyong mi bdag mnga' ris kyi// yul ljongs dge ba'i mgon byed pa// gsol lo= rnal 'byor brten bsgrub 'go ba yi// rigs chos rgyud kyi srung ma ste// kha 'dzin sdong grogs rgyab rten byed// gsol lo= mthu chen rtsal drag ldan pa yi// sbas pa'i gnas yul bder skyong ba// gzhi bdag zo dor dpung gi tshogs// 'khor bcas bstod do rab tu bsngags// sngon tshe pad+ma thod phreng dang*// lo chen bai ro la sogs pa// rtsa brgyud bla ma'i spyan snga ru// tha tshig rdo rje'i mna' bor ltar// bka' bsgos dam bzhag ma bsnyel bar// mi nub bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan bsgreng*// nges gsang snying po sgrub brgyud kyi// bstan dang bstan 'dzin phrin las 'od// rgya mtsho'i gos can khyab pa dang*// dge 'dun 'dus pa tshul gnas thos// chos spyod phar phyin bslab gsum ldan// nongs med 'phel rgyas khams kun tu// rgyal po chos mthun skye dgu rnams// dge la gzhol zhing rtag bde skyid// char chu dus 'bab lo phyugs legs// yid srubs rgyud bskul chos min rnams// ming med rtsad nas gzhom pa dang*// nad yams bskal ngan 'jigs chen brgyad// dal kha mtshon kha bsgyur du gsol// rdzogs ldan dang po'i lang tsho ni// gsar du 'char 'dra'i dpal 'byor gyis// 'jig rten khyab par mdzad du gsol// rnal 'byor mthun rkyen 'dod pa'i don// yid bzhin 'grub pa'i sdong grogs mdzod// nyin mtshan dus kun 'bral med du// srung skyob mel tshe ma g.yel cig

/'gal rkyen nad gdon bar chad rigs// mi mthun g.yul ngo bzlog tu gsol// gnyis snang 'dzin pa'i bag chags kyi// 'khrul rtog gis bslad nongs pa rnams// bzod bzhes mnyam nyid mkha' yangs por// bshags so dag tshangs dngos grub stsol// rang rang gnas gshegs slar yang ni// mchod pa'i slad du 'byon par gsol// sarba bhū ta gats+tsha sa gshegs/ bkra shis phun tshogs dge ba'i char// srid zhi'i dngos kun legs byas su// deng 'dir mngon par yongs grub nas// bsam pa 'grub pa'i bkra shis shog / ces pa'ang rgyal rong khro chu shu bham dgon gyi bla ma tastsa rje drung pas bskul ngor/ si tu pad+ma nyin byed dbang pos spel ba dge bar gyur cig// /

༈ rdo bla lcags rtse gnyan po'i bsang mchod bzhugs/ 'dir yul lha'i bsang brngan bgyi bar spro na/ bsang khang zlum po yid du 'ong ba phub/ phye mar/ 'bru sna/ dkar phud/ dar zab/ rin chen phye ma sogs mchod pa bshams/ rang nyid lha yi nga rgyal dang ldan pas/ a mṛ ta sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las dhī yig yongs gyur las// rin chen bsang khang yangs shing rgya che bar// dri bzang sman spos shing sna dud pa'i sprin// 'dod yon longs spyod nam mkha' mdzod bzhin spel// oṃ badz+ra s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ/ lan gsum dang*/ a kā ro sa byin gyis brlabs la/ kyai/ snang srid zil gnon gdug pa 'dul// phyi ltar che mchog drag po rtsal// nang ltar pad+ma 'byung gnas sku// gsang ba thod phreng he ru ka /'khor 'das kun la dbang bsgyur ba'i// rdo rje'i tha tshig gnyan po yi// bka' bsgos dam bzhag yal gam can// dkar po'i phyogs rnams skyong bar byed// nag phyogs phas rgol 'joms pa'i lha// shar zla'i ljongs kyi bye brag tu// rdo yul stod smad mnga' ba'i bdag /zo dor rnams kyi gtso bo ste// sku lha lcags rtse gnyan po dang*// dil dkar dang ni g.yung drung rtse// lha ri dil dkar la sogs pa// cha lugs zhon pa phyag mtshan rnams// ma nges sna tshogs ston cing bsgyur// gzhan yang yul phyogs 'dir gnas pa'i// dge bsnyen sman mo 'byung po'i tshogs// thams cad ma lus 'khor dang bcas// 'dir gshegs mchod phyir spyan 'dren no// rin chen bsang khang yid 'ong bar// dri ldan sna tshogs dud pa'i sprin// rab 'byams phyogs mthar kun khyab pa'i// cha shas zer las 'phros pa yi// bkra shis rdzas rtags 'dod yon dang*// mkho dgu'i longs spyod dpal 'byor rnams// yongs 'du'i ljon bzhin char ltar 'bebs// gzhan yang phye mar 'bru sna'i rigs// ja chang dkar phud dar tshon lnga// rin chen gser g.yu'i phye ma dang*// mthun rdzas dkor chas sa gzhi dang*// bar snang khyab par 'phro ba yi// rta phyugs gnag lug gzugs 'gros sogs// mdor na so sor mos thob kyi// mchod pa'i yo byad sna tshogs phul// rab tu tshim zhing dgyes gyur nas// bde dang dga' bas ngoms gyur cig

/sngon tshe dpal chen he ru ka /grub pa'i dbang phyug karma pa// rtsa brgyud bla ma'i spyan snga ru// ci ltar khas blangs dam bcas bzhin// dam tshig rjes su dran par gyis// rgyal ba'i zhal mthong dge bsnyen che// ma 'ongs 'khor ba mtha' can du// sems bskyed 'bras bu thob gyur pa// khyod la bstod cing bsngags par 'os// bcol ba'i phrin las dam pa ni// sangs rgyas bstan dang bstan 'dzin rnams// dar rgyas yun gnas dge 'dun sde// 'phel zhing rgyal po chos bzhin spyod// mnga' ris bde skyid lo legs shing*// nad mug mtshon bskal zhi bar mdzod// rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor dang bcas// gzhi byes bya ba gang brtsam par// legs kha btod la rgyal kha zungs// mthu dang rgyab rten sdong grogs mdzod// nyin dang mtshan du bya ra dang*// srung skyob mi 'bral spa bar mdzod// gang bcol bsam pa'i don rnams kun// thogs med bde blag 'grub gyur pa'i// myur mgyogs rdzu 'phrul stobs bskyed la// kun tu dge zhing shis pa yi// phrin las rnam bzhi lhun grub shog /mi gtsang nyes par gyur pa rnams// bshags so tshangs par mdzad nas kyang*// rang rang gnas su so sor gshegs// dus su slar yang 'byon par gsol// sarba bhū ta gats+tsha sa gshegs la/ bsngo ba smon lam bya'o// de ltar sgrub chen bla ma karma gzi brjid kyis bskul ba'i ngor/ si tu pad+ma nyin byed dbang pos snron zla'i tshes la spel ba maṅga lam̐/// / ༈ na mo pad+mā ka ra ye/ 'dir bstan pa'i bka' srung yul lha rnams kyi bsang mchod bgyid par spro na/ bsang rdzas gtsang zhing bzang ba tshar du dngar ba 'du bar byas la/ a mṛ ta sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bsang mchod rdzas// 'dod pa'i yon tan rgya che zhing*// rgyun mi chad pa'i rnam pa can// nam mkha' mdzod kyi rang bzhin gyur// oṃ a kā ro lan gsum brjod pas byin gyis brlabs/

de nas mgron rnams spyan drangs ba ni/ kyai/ sngon tshe o rgyan rdo rje 'chang*// mtsho skyes pad+ma badz+ra gyi// bka' dang dam la gnas pa yi// dkar phyogs skyong ba yongs kyi rgyal// lha yi dge bsnyen grags ldan pa// gnas zhing srung ba'i zo dor gtso// khra shod sbom brag gnyen po dang*// jo bo lha 'khor seng gnam brag /khyad par chos 'khor gdan sa yi// bka' srung zhal bzhes g.yar dam can// yul ljongs dge zhing shis pa yi// stobs kyi dpung pas legs skyong ba// rmugs 'dzin nor bdag mdo rgyal gnyen// sras lcam btsun mo'i 'khor tshogs dang*// phyā rgyal rdo rje g.yu drung rtsal// mched gsum rang rigs sde dpung dang*// 'dzi rgyal sgab gro bkram rgyal sogs// 'dir dmigs bsal yul lha gang rung 'dzud kyang chog / rnal 'byor sgrub pos spyan 'dren na// ma thogs myur bar gnas 'dir gshegs// rang rang gdan la bzhugs su gsol// 'dir bshams phyi nang gsang mchod rdzas// byang sems kun tu bzang po yi// mchod sprin rab 'byams dang mnyam pa'i// zad med phun sum tshogs pa'i gter// zhing khams rgya mtshor 'gengs pa yi// spyan gzigs dkor chas sna tshogs dang*// dza gad rat+na'i gser skyems phud// phye mar dkar gsum mngar gsum dang*// dar sna stag ras gzig ras sogs// bzang shing rnam mang bdug spos kyi// 'od zer drwa ba'i re khā las// mtho ris bdag po'i longs spyod kyi// bkra shis rdzas rtags rgyal srid bdun// nye ba'i rin chen 'dod yon lnga// dge mtshan ri mo ci yang 'char// gnas yul gzhi yi bdag rnams la// 'bul gyi dgyes pa bskang gyur cig /gnyis 'dzin 'khrul pas nongs pa yi// thugs 'gal nyes tshogs bshags par bgyi// byang dag tshangs par bstsal du gsol// rab dkar brgyud pa'i bka' srung ba// dregs ldan mthu stobs thogs pa med// mchog gsum dam par skyabs gsol ba'i// dge bsnyen chen po sras lcam dang*// mched 'khor sprul dang yang sprul tshogs// gzhan yang yul ris sa phyogs 'dir// gnyug mar gnas dang glo bur lhags// mchod 'os mgron rnams thams cad la// zhi ba bsang gi mchod pa 'bul// mnyes shing dgyes pa bskang gyur cig

/rgyal ba'i bka' sdod dam tshig can// phas rgol 'joms pa'i mthu rtsal ldan// chos kyi srung ma khyed rnams bstod// sngon tshe dbang drag he ru ka /rig 'dzin rtsa brgyud bla ma dang*// khyad par mi 'gyur rdo rje can// nus ldan drag po rtsal sogs kyi// spyan sngar khas blangs rjes dran nas// sangs rgyas bstan pa skyong spel dang*// sgrub pa'i mthun rkyen sgrub pa dang*// phyi nang bar chad bzlog tu gsol// yul ris sa phyogs rnam kun bde// dge zhing dge ba'i sdong grogs mdzod// bkra shis chos kyi rgyal srid che// rtag brtan nongs med lhun gyis grub// rnam kun dge legs 'dod dgu'i char// yongs su 'bebs pa'i bkra shis shog gats+tsha sa rang gnas su gshegs par bya'o// zhes pa'ang si tu pad+ma'i ming can gyis rig 'dzin mi 'gyur rdo rje'i mchog sprul gyi dgongs bzhed bskang phyir spel ba yi ge pa ni karma puṇ+ye dharma war+dha zhes pa'o// sarba thā maṅga lam/// / ༈ a kā ra ོsa byin brlabs/ kyai ho/ rgyal dbang mtsho skyes rgyal po yi// bka' gnyan dkar po'i sde skyong ba'i// lha btsan rdo rje thogs med rtsal// sngon tshe yal gam rjes dgongs la// 'dir gshegs zhi ba bsang mchod rdzas// dgyes mchod mos pa'i rang bzhin gyi// 'dod yon rgya mtsho dkrigs pa 'di// bzhes shig rol cig pū dza ho// bdag cag dpon slob gzhi byes kun// dge zhing legs pa'i sdong grogs dang*// kha 'dzin rgyab brten ma g.yel mdzod// bar chad rkyen las bsrung zhing skyobs// phrin las ma g.yel dam tshig can// dam la ma 'da' sa ma ya// zhes chags med rin po che'i bzhed ltar si tu pas spel ba maṅga lam/// / ༈ yul lha'i bsang brngan bgyid par spro na mchod rdzas rnams 'du bgyid la/ rang nyid che mchog pad+ma 'byung gnas gsal// thugs ka'i 'od kyi 'phro 'dus yul lha rnams// sngon gyi dam tshig gnyen po'i smon lam gyi// rang rang gnas nas ma lus spyan drangs gyur//

mchod rdzas rnams/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum dang*/ a kā ro lan gsum dang*/ oṃ badz+ra s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ/ gsum gyis byin brlabs sbyangs spel byas la/ hrīḥ kun bzang pad+ma 'byung gnas dang*// grub chen karma pak+shi yi// spyan sngar khas blangs dam bcas pa'i// gnas dang gzhi yi bdag po ni// 'bum rgyal gnyan po gnam rdzong dang*// khra tshug dzo nag khra 'bal dang*// go ri ri bkra la sogs pa// rgyal ba'i bstan srung g.yar dam can// dkar po'i phyogs rnams skyong ba yi// zo dor yul bdag dge bsnyen sogs// bsang mgron mchod par 'os pa rnams// 'dir gshegs mnga' gsol bsang mchod bzhes// 'dod dgu'i longs spyod mthun rdzas tshogs// dpag med dngos bshams yid las sprul// nam mkha' mdzod kyi rang bzhin can// blo yis blangs nas 'bul gyi bzhes// dgyes par rol zhing tshim par mdzod// mthu dang rtsal ldan rang phyogs srung*// gzhan phyogs 'joms par zhal bzhes pa'i// bka' srung gnyan por bstod par bgyi// bdag cag gnyis 'dzin 'khrul dbang gis// nongs par gyur rnams bzod par bzhes// sangs rgyas bstan srung dkon mchog gi /dbu 'phang bstod la bstan 'dzin rnams// phrin las dar rgyas 'dus pa 'phel// rgyal khams bde skyid phun tshogs kyi// dpal yon rnam par rgyas pa yi// bcol ba'i las rnams 'grub par mdzod// bkra shis snang bas khyab gyur cig /sarba bhu ta gats+tsha sa rang gnas su gshegs par bya'o// zhes si tu pa pad+ma'i ming can gyis/ khra phug gnas sprul dh+wa dza'i mtshan gyis bskul ngor spel ba dge legs su gyur cig// / ༈ na mo pra wā ka ra ye/ 'dir 'bol yag bkra shis mthong smon gnas kyi zo dor rnams la bsang mchod 'bul bar 'dod na/ mchod rdzas spyi dang bsang shing sna tshogs gtsang la bzang ba 'du bgyid la/ rnal 'byor pa lha'i bskyed rdzogs dang ldan pa'i ngang nas/ a mṛ ta sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa

sa sbyangs la/ stong las bsang khang bh+rūm̐ yig las// rin chen bkod mdzes rab yangs par// 'bru gsum 'od zhu bsang brngan rdzas// lha klu mi yi longs spyod gang*// rgya che rgyun chad med gyur ba// sems dpa' kun bzang smon stobs bzhin// dpag med bsam yas brjod bral zhing*// mchod sprin rab 'byams rgyas 'gengs gyur// a kā ro lan gsum byin brlabs la/ bsang mgron mchod yul rnams spyan drangs pa ni/ hrīḥ sku gsum yon tan zhing gi bdag /rgyal dang rgyal sras rtsa brgyud kyi// bla ma rig 'dzin yi dam dang*// dpa' bo ḍā ki chos skyong tshogs// sprin ltar 'du zhing gnas pa yi// gdod nas rang byung dag pa'i zhing*// thub bstan gsang sngags chos kyi rdzong*// bkra shis mthong smon gtsug lag gi /srung ma rdo thi gangs dkar gnyan// rdo rje cang phug dge btsan po// khyad par gnas kyi zo dor ni// dgu btsun gangs pa dkar po dang*// ja sti nyi ma lha rtse sogs// pad+ma'i dge bsnyen mthu rtsal can// ma lus 'khor dang yang 'khor tshogs// gnyug mar gnas pa'i yul gzhi'i bdag /rang la rigs kyi 'go ba yi// lha dang srung ma dam tshig can// bsang mgron tshogs rnams 'dir gshegs shig /rang rang dgyes pa'i gdan la bzhugs// 'dir bshams phyi nang gsang ba yi// mchod pa'i bye brag rnam mang po// nyer spyod bdun dang 'dod yon lnga// bkra shis dge ba'i rdzas rtags dang*// rgyal srid nye ba'i rin chen bdun// spyan gzigs dkor chas rkang 'gros rigs// dar sna rin chen spos sman dang*// dza gad phud sna'i skyems bzang dang*// phye mar dkar gsum mngar gsum sogs// bdug spos sprin gyi drwa ba las// sa gsum 'dod dgu'i longs spyod rnams// cir yang 'char ba'i yid sprul kyis// rang bzhin blo yis blangs nas su// 'bul gyi dgyes pa chen por rol// mtha' yas 'gro sgrol phrin las bzhi'i// mnga' bdag dkyil 'khor lha tshogs bstod// gnas dang zhing skyong sgrub pa po'i// sdong grogs dpung gnyen mel tshe mkhan// zo dor srung ma'i tshogs rnams bstod// de ltar mchod sprin rgya mtsho yis// gsang gsum dgyes pa bskyed pa'i mthus// sangs rgyas bstan pa rin chen srungs// bstan 'dzin zhabs brtan dge 'dun rgyas// skye dgu'i dpal dang 'byor pa spel// khyad par rnal 'byor 'khor bcas la// legs kha rgyal kha btod pa dang*// bsam don yid bzhin lhun gyis grub// nad gdon bar chad las rgyal zhing*// tshe ring bde skyid phun sum tshogs// yul 'dir mi mthun rgud pa bral// sad ser btsa' 'bu zhi ba dang*// char chu dus 'bebs lo 'bras legs// rtag tu bde dang ldan gyur cig

/bkra shis yon tan kun 'byung gnas// pad 'byung rtsa gsum lha tshogs kyi// byin rlabs dngos grub char gyi rgyun// deng 'dir bde legs rab rgyas shog /sarba bhū ta gats+tsha sa rang gnas gshegs/ zhes pa'ang si tu pad+ma'i ming gis mdzod dgon a cang bsod dbang sprul sku'i bzhed ngor 'bol yag yul lha'i bsang mchod ched du spel ba dge// / ༈ dgra lha bla ye brdzu'i gsol mchod phrin bcol spro na/ bsang gsur gser skyems sogs bshams la/ lha'i nga rgyal ldan pas/ mchod rdzas/ a mṛ ta sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong las snang srid rab 'byams zhing*// mtha' klas rgyas par 'gengs byed pa'i// 'dod yon mchod rdzas rnam mang po// rgya chen mchod pa'i sprin du gyur// oṃ badz+ra s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ/ lan gsum gyi byin gyis brlabs/ hūm̐/ kun bzang gdod ma'i sangs rgyas rdo rje sems// snying rje khros pa badz+ra kī la ya'i// bka' nyan las byed dung gi skyes bu mchog /bod yul gzhi gnas bdag po rdo rje legs// ma sangs skyes gcig sprul bsgyur cir yang ston// dgra lha bla ye brdzu sum brgya drug cu ste// lha rigs dkar por 'go zhing stongs grogs byed// dpung gnyen sngon gyi dam bca' rjes dgongs la// 'dir gshegs mnyes rdzas nyer spyod bsang gsur dud// khyad par ba liṃ dgra bo'i sha khrag rus// sbyangs spel bsgyur ba'i bdud rtsi rgya mtsho 'di// bzhes nas bdag cag rigs brgyud 'khor bcas la// mgon skyabs mel tshe rgyab rten grogs mdzod cig /dkar phyogs lha yi lha mchog mnga' gsol lo// dgra bla gnyen dang 'bral med dpang bstod do// gsang bdag pad 'byung rtsa brgyud rig 'dzin gyi// tha tshig brtser dgongs thugs dam ma g.yel bar// chos 'khor skyongs dang rgyal blon mnga' 'bangs rnams// bde skyid 'byor rgyas mi 'phen rta hrags shing*// zhi rgyas dbang drag phrin las ma lus pa// myur sgrub rang phyogs srung dang phas rgol 'joms// gang bcol 'dod don yid bzhin bsgrub tu gsol// gats+tsha
sa rang gnas gshegs/ zhes si tu pas/ ja'i sang skal bzang nas dpon sde'i dgra lha bla dpang bstod phrin bcol bskul ngor spel/// /

༈ na mo gu ru de wa ḍā ki ni ye/ 'dir yon bdag klung rta bskyed pa'i 'dod gsol bya ba ni/ rtsa gsum rten drung mchod pa tshar du dngar ba ji snyed pa dang*/ khyad par phye mar/ ja chang 'o phud/ dar tshon/ sman dang rin chen phye ma*/ dar ras lo khams mdog mtshungs la klung rta spar btab pa rnams dang*/ gsas mkhar la rten btsug rgyu'i khyung 'brug seng stag /bkra shis rdzas rtags rgyal srid/ gzhan yang spyan gzigs dkor chas kyi rnam pa mtshon ris bkra ba legs par bris pa dang*/ mda' dar/ shug pa rtse rgyal bal tshon gyis brgyan pa/ bsang khang zlum por bdug spos bsang shing sogs 'du byas nas/ dud sprin btang zhing mchod rdzas rnams bran la rim par mchod cing dang po gnas dang yo byad rnams/ a mṛ ta sa bsangs*/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi rgyas/ a kā ro lan gsum brjod la rgya cher spel zhing dar phyar dung 'bud rnga rol dang dbyangs snyan pos 'di skad do// kyai/ rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i bla ma dang*// yi dam rgyal ba zhi dang khro// ḍā ki dam can chos skyong ba// rang la rigs kyis 'go ba yi// pha mes rgyud kyi srung ma dang*// srid gsum dbang bsgyur lha yi lha// tshogs rje tshogs bdag chen po dang*// skyes bu rdo rje legs pa rtsal// ti se thang lha spom ra gnyan// bod kyi mgur lha bcu gsum dang*// dge bsnyen nyi shu rtsa gcig dang*// ma mo brtan ma bcu gnyis po// pad+ma'i spyan sngar dam bcas pa'i// rdo rje'i tha tshig yal gam can// rnal 'byor skyong bar zhal bzhes pa'i// rgyal ba'i bstan srung mthu bo che// dkar phyogs skyong ba'i tshogs rnams dang*// khyad par yul ris sa phyogs 'dir// gnas pa'i lha klu sde brgyad dang*// dge bsnyen sman mo yul gnas bdag /gnyug mar gnas pa'i 'byung po rnams// gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol// rang rang dgyes pa'i gdan la bzhugs// 'dir bshams phyi nang gsang ba yi// mchod pa'i bye brag rnam mang po// dngos su 'byor dang yid kyis sprul// lha mi'i dpal 'byor 'dod yon rnams// bla med kun bzang smon lam gyi// mchod sprin zag med ji bzhin par// dang pa'i mos blos 'bul gyi bzhes// bsang ngo brngan no mnga' gsol lo// mchod do 'bul lo dgyes par rol// gsol zhing mchod pa la brten nas// rnal 'byor bdag cag sgrub pa po// rgyu sbyor yon gyi bdag po la// rma g.yang dngos grub stsol ba dang*// tshe bsod dpal dang 'byor ba spel// klung rta yar skyed snyan grags rgyas// rigs rgyud mnga' thang 'phel ba dang*// zhi rgyas dbang dang mngon spyod kyi// las rnams yid la bsam ma thag

/'dod don gegs med myur 'grub mdzod// pha rol sdang sems ldan pa yi// mi dang mi min thams cad kyi// log par lta ba'i dpung gzhom ste// tshar gcod rjes su 'dzin nas su// dam pa'i chos la spyod pa yi// sangs rgyas bstan pa rgyas par mdzod// mdor na bcol ba'i phrin las gang*// thogs pa med par 'grub par mdzod// sngon gyi thugs dam rjes dgongs la// rnal 'byor 'khor srung rkyen ngan zlog /phyogs rnams kun las rnam rgyal ba'i// mi nub ba dan bsgreng bar mdzod// bkra shis dpal bskyed yod tan gyi// dge legs dngos po rgyas gyur cig /rang phyogs srung zhing phas rgol 'joms// stobs rtsal ldan rnams bstod par bgyi// zhes mchod cing phrin bcol bstod par bya'o// grangs gsog tshe 'di nas mchod rdzas bsang sbyangs phyin nas mthar chags su bton/ rjes ni/ de ltar ye shes las 'jig rten// dge zhing dge ba'i stongs grogs can// 'go ba'i lha dang srung ma rnams// gta' 'dzugs rten la brtan par bzhugs// gzhan yang 'jig rten skyong ba dang*// glo bur lhags pa'i mgron rigs rnams// rang rang gnas gshegs mchod sbyin gyis/ mnyes tshim dga' mgur ldan pa'i ngang*// mthun rkyen sgrubs la gnod pa spongs// zhi dang byams pa'i sems ldan mdzod// sarba bhū ta gats+tsha sa gshegs/ zhes gnas ri byin chen nam yul lha gnas pa'i ri mthon po'am khang thog la sogs par klung rta rnams dang brten rdzas shing byang bcas btsugs/ mda' dar g.yab/ 'dod gsol sngags rnams 'don/ lha rgyal 'bod/ shug pa sbra'am khang pa'i dkyil ka la bcings la bzhag / ye dharma dang*/ su pra tiṣ+ṭha lan gsum mam bdun brjod la so sor me tog 'thor/ rab tu gnas shing*/ phye mar dngos grub tu rol/ bkra shis brjod pa dang*/ dge ba bsngo ba sogs spyi dang mthun par bya'o// zhes pa'ang si tu pad+ma'i ming can gyis nang chen ching hu'i mdun na 'don chos dang ldan pa sman dga' zhes pa'i bzhed ngor spel ba dge bar gyur cig

/sarba maṅga laṃ/// / ༈ na mo pra wā ka ra ye/ 'dir seng chen gnam brag gi gnas zhing skyong ba'i zo dor rnams la bsang mchod 'bul bar 'dod na/ mchod rdzas spyi dang bsang shing sna tshogs gtsang la bzang ba 'du bgyid la/ rnal 'byor pa rnams lha yi bskyed rdzogs dang ldan pa'i ngang nas/ a mṛ ta sa bsangs*/ swa hā wa sa sbyangs la/ stong las bsang khang bh+rūm̐ yig las// rin chen bkod mdzes rab yangs par// 'bru gsum 'od zhu bsang brngan rdzas// lha klu mi yi longs spyod gang*// rgya che rgyun chad med gyur pa// sems dpa' kun bzang smon stobs bzhin// dpag med bsam yas brjod bral zhing*// mchod sprin rab 'byams rgyas 'gengs gyur// a kā ro sa lan gsum byin brlabs la/ bsang mgron mchod yul rnams spyan drangs pa ni/ hrīḥ sku gsum yon tan zhing gi bdag /rgyal dang rgyal sras rtsa brgyud kyi// bla ma rig 'dzin yi dam dang*// dpa' bo ḍā ki chos skyong tshogs// sprin ltar 'du zhing gnas pa yi// sbas yul seng chen gnas rdzong brag /gdod nas rang byung dag pa'i zhing*// pad+ma dbang gi dkyil 'khor che'i// ye shes lha tshogs 'khor yang 'khor// sprul par bcas pa thams cad dang*// gnas kyi rjes 'brel dkar po'i sde// skyong zhing rgyal bstan spel mdzad pa// pad+ma'i dge bsnyen mthu rtsal can// spom brag smug sangs ri bkra dang*// 'bri gnyan rdo rje blo gros rtsal// zil phrom mo nam 'bri spo bo// mdo rgyal phya rgyal bkram rgyal gnyen// rtse rgyal zhal da sras lcam 'khor// phyogs bzhi'i sgo srung so sbram dang*// bo thog ri bkra lcags de'u// sham ri khra leb gnas rdzong chen// zhe mog lha sman la sogs pa// seng lung yul ljongs 'dir 'khod pa'i// gnyug mar gnas pa'i yul gzhi'i bdag /rang la rigs kyis 'go ba yi// lha dang srung ma dam tshig can// bsang mgron tshogs rnams 'dir gshegs shig

/rang rang dgyes pa'i gdan la bzhugs// 'dir bshams phyi nang gsang ba yi// mchod pa'i bye brag rnam mang po// nyer spyod bdun dang 'dod yon lnga// bkra shis dge ba'i rdzas rtags dang*// rgyal srid nye ba'i rin chen bdun// spyan gzigs dkor chas rkang 'gros rigs// dar sna rin chen spos sman dang*// dza gad phud sna'i skyems bzang dang*// phye mar dkar gsum mngar gsum sogs// bdug spos sprin gyi drwa ba las// sa gsum 'dod dgu'i longs spyod rnams// cir yang 'char ba'i yid sprul kyi// rang bzhin blo yis blangs nas su// 'bul gyi dgyes pa chen por rol// mtha' yas 'gro sgrol phrin las bzhi'i// mnga' bdag dkyil 'khor lha tshogs bstod// gnas dang zhing skyong sgrub pa po'i// sdong grogs dpung gnyen mel tshe mkhan// zo dor srung ma'i tshogs rnams bstod// de ltar mchod sprin rgya mtsho yis// gsang gsum dgyes pa bskyed ba'i mthus// sangs rgyas bstan pa rin chen srung// bstan 'dzin zhabs brtan dge 'dun rgyas// skye dgu'i dpal dang 'byor ba spel// khyad par rnal 'byor 'khor bcas la// legs kha rgyal kha btod pa dang*// bsam don yid bzhin lhun gyis grub// nad gdon bar chad las rgyal zhing*// tshe ring bde skyid phun sum tshogs// yul 'dir mi mthun rgud pa bral// sad ser btsa' 'bu zhi ba dang*// char chu dus 'bab lo 'bras legs// rtag tu bde dang ldan rgyur cig /bkra shis yon tan kun 'byung gnas// pad 'byung rtsa gsum lha tshogs kyi// byin rlabs dngos grub char gyi rgyun// deng 'dir bde legs rab rgyas shog /sarba bhū ta gats+tsha sa rang gnas gshegs/ zhes pa'ang si tu pad+ma'i ming gis sku tshab karma'i bzhed ngor spel ba dge// / ༈ swa sti/ yul lha gnas bdag la bsang mchod 'bul bar spro na/ bsang dang mchod rdzas gang 'byor gtsang zhing bzang bar 'du byas la/

rang nyid lhar gsal thugs las 'od zer 'phros// bsang mchod mi gtsang dri ma sbyangs byas nas// dag pa ye shes bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin can// mkha' dbyings kun khyab rgya cher spel bar gyur// oṃ badz+ra s+pha ra na khaṃ/ lan gsum dang*/ a ka ro lan gsum gyis byin brlabs nas/ hrīḥ sngon tshe gsang bdag pad+ma ka ra dang*// sgrub mchog pak+shi'i spyan sngar dam mnos pa'i// sangs rgyas bstan pa skyong bar zhal bzhes pa'i// dkar po lha'i rigs dge bsnyen zo dor che// a bo ger mdzo skyid ri sman chen sogs// yul 'dir lhags pa'i gnyug gnas glo bur mgron// deng 'dir rnal 'byor bdag gi mchod pa'i gnas// 'dir gshegs dngos su 'byor dang yid kyis sprul// rnam mang sna tshogs 'dod yon mi zad pa// kun bzang mchod sprin so sor mos thob pa'i// dgyes rdzas dkor nor lha mi klu'i longs spyod// 'bul bzhes tshim par spyod la thugs dam bskang*// bsang ngo brngan no bstod do mnga' gsol lo// thugs 'gal nyes tshogs nongs bshags bzod par bzhes// bstan pa bsrung zhing rnal 'byor skyong ba yi// mthu stobs rtsal ldan khyed rnams bstod par bgyi// de ltar mchod bstod bshags pa la brten nas// rgyal bstan dri med sgrub brgyud dar zhing rgyas// de 'dzin zhabs brtan phrin las rnam bzhi spel// dge 'dun sde rgyas 'gro rnams chos dang ldan// rtag par tshe ring nad med bsam don 'grub// nad mug mtshon bskal la sogs 'jigs brgyad zhi// char chu dus bab lo legs skya rgyal zhing*// rnam kun bde legs lhun gyis 'grub par mdzod// sarba bhū ta gats+tsha/ brjod la rang gnas su gshegs par bya'o// zhes pa'ang si tu pad+ma'i ming can gyis/ mgul zhag ri khrod sbyin bdag rnams kyi ngor spel ba dge legs 'phel/ sarba maṅga laṃ/// / ༈ bsang mchod 'dod dgu'i dpal 'byor ci yang 'char ba'i sprin phung du gyur/

a kā ra ོsa byin brlabs la/ kyai/ sngon tshe rgyal dbang thod phreng gi /bka' dang dam gnas yul gzhi'i bdag /mchod par 'os rnams 'dir gshegs shig /rang rang dgyes pa'i gdan la bzhugs// 'dir bshams dngos 'byor yid sprul gyi// sna tshogs 'jig rten longs spyod rdzas// ji snyed lha mi'i dkor nor tshogs// rgya chen nam mkha' mdzod ji bzhin// mkho dgu'i mthun rdzas dpag med rnams// bsang mchod bdug spos sprin chen las// char bzhin bab 'di dgyes par rol// mi shes rmongs pas nongs pa yi// mi gtsang thams cad sangs gyur cig /lha zhal yar zla'i cha gang bzhin// rab tu gsal zhing rnal 'byor gyis// gang bcol phrin las ku muta tshal// 'dzum pa'i dge mtshan sangs rgyas bstan// bstan 'dzin dge 'dun sde rgyas shing*// rgyal khams rgud pa'i dbul phongs zhi// bde skyid 'byor pa drug ldan pa'i// kha 'dzin sdong grogs ma g.yel bar// ji ltar bcol pa'i phrin las mdzod// gats+tsha sa rang gnas btang*/ zhes a phyug grwa tshang rnams kyis bskul ltar/ si tus spel/// / ༈ bhūm̐ las rin chen snod yangs par// 'bru gsum 'od zhu bsang mchod rdzas// zag med bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin can// rab 'byams mtha' klas kun khyab gyur// oṃ badz+ra s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ/ lan gsum gyis byin brlabs la/ kyai/ dus gsum rgyal ba'i rang gzugs pad+ma 'byung*// spyan sngar dam mnos dkar po'i phyogs skyong gtso// rdo rgyal mu nam mched brgyad sras yum 'khor// yal gam gnyan po rjes dgongs 'dir gshegs bzhugs// bkod mdzes lha klu mi yi longs spyod rnams// dbyibs legs mthun rdzas dkor nor sna tshogs pa// ma la ya klung ha ri tsan+dan ngad// dri bzhon bskul mtshungs bdug spos sprin chen g.yo// chabs cig kun bzang rnam thar rjes 'gro pa'i// g.yu dud zer las dpal 'byor 'dod dgu'i char// ci dgar 'bab 'di lha chen 'khor bcas la// dgyes bskang 'bul bzhes khyod thugs pad+ma'i tshal// zag med bde chen 'dab stong rgyas gyur cig

/'jig rten dregs pa'i khengs 'phrog stobs rtsal can// gsang sngags rnal 'byor bka' srung mnga' gsol ba// dkar phyogs lha yi sde dpon khyod la bstod// sngon tshe rdo rje'i tha tshig bro bor pa// ma g.yel ma 'da' bskal dus snyigs ma 'dir// pad 'byung bka' gter spel dang bstan 'dzin srungs// dge 'dun sde rgyas mnga' ris yul ljongs rnams// nad mug mtshon gyi ser bu ring bskrad nas// mtha' bzhi'i rkang drug dbang bsdus bslu chos mkhan/ / lus med rgyud bskul rmeg med tshar chod la// mdor na las bzhi'i phrin las ma lus sgrubs// bdag cag gzhi byes kha 'dzin rgyab brten dang*// sdong grogs mel tshe bu bzhin skyong bar mdzod// gang bcol re ba'i shing rta 'gengs pa yi// bkra shis bsam don lhun grub bde legs shog /gats+tsha sa rang gnas btang*/ si tu pad+ma nyin byed dbang pos/ bla ma kar lu'i bzhed ltar spel ba dge/ maṅga lam/// / ༈ yul lha'i bsang mchod spro na/ phye mar phud skyems bzang shing tshogs 'du bgyid la/ rang nyid pad 'byung skur gsal ba'i// thugs las 'od 'phros mchod rdzas rnams// mi gtsang dri ma sbyangs nas kyang*// dag pa ye shes bdud rtsir gyur// a kā ra ོsa byin brlabs la/ rang gi snying ga'i 'od zer gyis// yul gnas gzhi bdag gle brag ces// 'khor bcas mchod pa'i gnas 'di ru// spyan drangs dgyes par bzhugs su gsol// 'dir bshams mkha' dbyings gang ba yi// bzang spos dud sprin zer ma las// mkho dgu'i longs spyod 'dod yon tshogs// dpag med cir yang spro ba dang*// phye mar rin chen sman sna dang*// dar zab dza gad phud bzang skyems// 'bul bzhes thugs dam bskang gyur cig /sngon gyi dam tshig g.yar dam gnyen// rjes dgongs rgyu sbyor yon bdag la/ 'gal rkyen sel zhing mthun rkyen sgrubs// mi la na tsha ma btang zhig /phyugs la god yams ma btang bar// lo legs 'bru 'phel rtswa rgyas mdzod// kha 'dzin sdong grogs ma g.yel bar// lha khyod rtag par mchod bskul na// ji ltar bcol ba'i phrin las sgrubs// khyed rnams thugs 'gal nongs pa'i tshogs// ci mchis bshags shing bzod par bzhes// mthu rtsal rmad byung dkar phyogs skyong*/

gtso dang 'khor bcas bstod par bgyi// bkra shis bde legs phun tshogs char// yongs su smin pa'i dpal 'bar shog /gats+tsha/ zhes si tu pas sgrub gnyer karma bde legs ngor spel/// / ༈ dpal mgon ma ning nag por bsang mchod 'bul bar spro na/ mchod rdzas rigs 'du byas la/ rang nyid lha'i bskyed rim ldan pas 'di skad do//

bsang rdzas mchod pa'i sprin phung rnams// zag med bde chen skyed byed gyur// 'bru gsum gyis byin brlabs la/ hūm̐/ chos dbyings skye med kun tu bzang po'i klong*// ma 'gags thabs kyi tshul snang he ru ka /sgyu 'phrul rol pa khro rgyal 'chol ba'i rje// gcig shur ma ning nag po srog bdud che// dpal 'bar yum dang mgon chen sde lnga po// yang 'khor sde brgyad dpal mgon bdun cu la// dgyes rdzas bsang mchod dam pa 'bul ba ni// nyer spyod bdun dang bkra shis rdzas rtags brgyad// rgyal srid bdun dang stong gsum 'jig rten gyi// bkod pa yul ljongs 'dod yon mchod pa'i sprin// rig ma bcu drug sman gtor rak+ta'i tshogs// brten rdzas bskang rdzas bsgrub rdzas mchod pa'i rdzas// dngos 'byor yid sprul nam mkha'i khams gang bas// gsol lo mchod do bsang ngo thugs dam bskang*// thog med dus nas ma rig bdag 'dzin gyi// sgrib gsum rnam rtog dri mas nyes bsags kun// rang rig brjod bral ka dag klong yangs ngang*// mthol lo bshags so dag tshangs dngos grub stsol// sangs rgyas bstan skyong bstan 'dzin zhabs brtan cing*// dge 'dun sde rgyas rnal 'byor bsam don kun// thogs med yid bzhin sgrubs la rkyen phyi nang*// bar chad sol la chos mthun bsam pa sgrubs// byang chub lam gyi nyer 'tshe zhi ba dang*// rnam kun bkra shis bde legs 'byung gyur cig / ces si tu pad+ma'i ming can gyis/ a mchod bkra shis ngor spel ba dge/// / ༈ a kā ro sa byin brlabs/ swa bhā sa sbyangs/ stong las bsang khang yi ge dhī// 'od zer 'phro 'dus 'dod yon tshogs// dpag med mchod rdzas kun bzang gi /smon lam las grub zag med gyur// oṃ badz+ra s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ/ kyai/ rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam lha/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro ye shes kyi// chos skyong rdo rje ber lcam dral// 'khor lnga bkra shis tshe ring ma// dgra lha bla ye brdzu yul gnas skyong*// rdza rgyal ar me mu ne dang*// gnyu rgyal klu mo rdza bkra dang*// spo rgyal rdol pa la sogs pa// rang la rigs kyi 'go ba yi// lha dang srung ma dge bsnyen rnams// rig 'dzin pad+ma'i bka' bsgos bzhin// dam las ma 'da' 'dir gshegs gsol// dngos 'byor yid sprul mchod pa'i rdzas// rab 'byams zhing kun khyab pa yi// spyan gzigs dkor chas tshar du dngar// phye mar nyer spyod gser skyems sogs// 'dod dgu'i longs spyod nam mkha'i mdzod// dgyes pa bskyed pa'i 'dod yon rnams// mchod pa 'bul bzhes dgyes par rol// rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las rnams// yid bzhin 'grub ba'i sdong grogs mdzod// gzhi byes legs dang rgyal kha btod// bsam pa chos bzhin 'grub par mdzod// bkra shis dge ba'i dpal spyod shog

/ ces si tu pad+ma'i ming gis/ dpon bkra dbang ngor spel ba dge legs 'phel/// / ༈ oṃ/ rin chen snod mchog stong gsum mnyam pa'i nang*// 'bru gsum 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i// 'dod yon nyer spyod mkho dgu'i mchod rdzas tshogs// yid sprul cir yang 'char ba ye shes kyi// bdud rtsir gyur pa'i bsang gi mchod pa 'dis// yul 'dir gnyug gnas rdza rgod rog po dang*// rdo yol dkar ze bla mtsho phyug mo dang*// dom ra brag dkar om mtsho khra leb zor// a rme dom gsham rin spungs ri dmar dang*// ri bkra rag re dil yag la sogs pa// gnas dang rten bcas yid kyi gzugs 'chang zhing*// yul gyi bde skyid spel ba'i nus stobs can// thams cad bsang zhing brngan no bdag cag la// phan pa bsgrub cing ci bcol las rnams kun// rje btsun bla ma'i bka' yi dam bzhag bzhin// thogs med yid bzhin 'grub par mdzad du gsol// zhes karma bsam 'phel gyi 'dod ngor si tus spel/// / ༈ yul lha btsan rgod 'bar ba'i bsang mchod spro na/ mchod rdzas rnams la a kā ro sa byin brlabs nas/ hrīḥ bdag nyid che mchog pad+ma'i skur gsal ba'i// thugs las 'od 'phros yul gnas gzhi yi bdag /btsan rgod rdo rje drag rtsal 'khor bcas rnams// sngon gyi dam bca' rjes dgongs deng 'dir ni// zhi dang byams pa'i tshul gyis gshegs su gsol// 'dir bshams phyi nang gsang ba de kho na'i// bla med mchod pa'i sprin phung bdug pa'i spos// phyogs kyi go skabs 'phrog pa'i zer ma las// gang 'dod dgyes dgu'i mthun rdzas ma tshang med// spyan gzigs dkor chas 'dod pa'i longs spyod rnams// rgya chen rgyun mi chad par spros byas nas// 'bul bzhes dgyes rol thugs dam gnyen po bskang*// nongs bshags bzod gsol bcol ba'i phrin las ni// rnal 'byor gang 'dod phrin las sgrub pa dang*// kha 'dzin sdong grogs mel tshe ma g.yel bar// srung skyob mi 'bral rtag par bu bzhin skyongs// bstan 'dzin zhabs brtan dge 'dun sde rgyas shing*// mnga' ris lo legs 'bru 'phel nad 'khrugs zhi// mdor na rdzogs ldan dpal la spyod pa yi// rnam kun phrin las ma g.yel bsgrub par mdzod// gats+tsha

sa rang gnas su gshegs/ zhes dad sbyin rgan po'i ngor si tus spel ba dge legs su gyur cig// / ༈ 'dir yul lha so sbram gnyan po'i bsang mchod spro na/ mchod gtor dkar bshos dang phye mar phud rgod bsang shing sogs 'du byas la chu gtsang gis bran/ a mṛ ta sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du bsang mchod 'dod yon gyi sprin phung zad mi shes pa sa dang bar snang ma lus yongs su gang bar gyur/ oṃ badz+ra s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ/ lan gsum/ rang nyid skad cig hrīḥlas pad+ma 'byung*// dkar gsal khro 'dzum za 'og ber phyam brjid// phyag gnyis rdo rje thod pa kha ṭāṃ 'dzin// snang stong zung 'jug dam ye dbyer med gsal// oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐ḥ zhes bzlas/ bdag nyid pad+ma thod phreng thugs ka nas// 'od zer 'phros pas so sbram 'khor bcas la// phog pas sngon gyi khas blangs dam bca' bzhin// rjes dgongs skad cig gnas 'dir gshegs par gyur// badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥ tiṣ+ṭha lhan/ kyai/ lha yi dge bsnyen 'khor bcas la// mthun pa'i mchod rdzas 'bul ba ni// dkar gsum phye mar phud kyis mchod// ja chang 'o zho btung bas mchod// dar tshon bal tshon rgyan gyis mchod// dri zhim bsang gi dud pas mchod// g.yag lug ra gsum gzugs kyis mchod// spyan gzigs dkor cha du mas mchod// rnga dung rol mo snyan pas mchod// ting 'dzin sngags dang phyag rgyas 'bul// mnyes shing tshims par gyur nas kyang*// phog thug 'gram 'khrugs zhi gyur cig /na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a wa sogs gsum gyis bsngo'o// kyai/ lha yi dge bsnyen yul bdag gnyan po ni// sku mdog dkar gsal dpa' ba'i chas dang ldan// rnam 'gyur cha lugs ma nges cir yang ston// rang phyogs srung dang gzhan phyogs 'joms par byed// khyod ni dam nyams dgra bo'i gshed ma ste// sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung ba'i bya ra ba// mthu stobs thogs pa med pa'i rdzu 'phrul can// sgrub mchog rnal 'byor ma yis bu ltar brtse// rtag tu mi 'bral srung skyob mdzad pa yi// rtsal ldan skyes bu 'khor dang bcas la bstod// deng 'dir khyod la bcol ba'i phrin las ni// rnal 'byor bdag dang rgyu sbyor yon bdag gi

/tshe bsod dpal 'byor yar ngo'i zla ltar bskyed// mi mthun bar chad thal bar brlag pa dang*// sangs rgyas bstan pa gnyan po khyod kyis srungs// bstan 'dzin skyes bu'i sku dgra khyod kyis sgrol// las bzhi'i phrin las gang brtsam khyod kyis sgrubs// btsa' sad ser gsum lo nyes than pa zlog /mi phyugs nad rims dal kha khyod kyis sgyur// sngon gyi dam bca' ma g.yel dran mdzod la// gang bcol las kun thogs med bsgrub par mdzod// ces rang nyid pad 'byung du gsal bas ci bcol ba'i phrin las bsgrub par bsam zhing*/ gats+tsha sa rang nas su gshegs/ sbyin pa rgya chen sogs brjod/ ces dad ldan phun tshogs rab sgrub ngor spel ba dge// / ༈ kyai/ sngon tshe pad+ma thod phreng gi /spyan sngar khas blangs dam bcas pa'i// phyi nang gsang ba'i sde brgyad rnams// deng 'dir bsang dang gser skyems kyi// mchod pa sna tshogs so so yis// gang 'dod longs spyod rgya chen po// phul bzhes dgyes par rol mdzod la// o rgyan chen po'i bka' dam las// ma 'da' rnal 'byor bcol pa'i las// phrin las rnam bzhi sgrub pa dang*// khyad par yul ris sa phyogs 'dir// skyin thang gnod 'tshe las skyob pa'i// lo legs 'bru 'phel skya rgyal zhing*// 'gro ba sems can bde skyid ldan// bkra shis snang bas khyab pa yi// rnam kun bde skyid ldan par mdzod/// / ༈ swasti/ sbas yul a ta rong dang rjes 'brel gnas chen seng chen gnam brag la bsang mchod spro na/ thog mar mchod rdzas rnams 'du bgyid la/ a mṛ ta sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong las rin chen snod yangs par// lha rdzas mchod pa'i bye brag rnams// kun bzang smon lam las grub pa'i// nam mkha' mdzod bzhin rgya che ba// rgyun mi chad pa rnams su gyur// oṃ badz+ra s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ/ lan gsum/ hrīḥ rang nyid pad+ma 'byung gnas skur gsal ba'i// thugs las 'od 'phros mchod 'os dkon mchog dang*// rtsa gsum lha tshogs yul gzhi gnas bdag rnams// mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs bzhugs par gyur// kyai/

gdod nas yongs grub sa spyod kyi// gnas mchog seng chen gnam brag ces// pad+ma dbang gi dkyil 'khor na// o ḍi ya na'i ā tsar+ya// grub thob bye ba 'bum dang bcas// rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i lha yi tshogs// rgyud sde bzhi 'brel yi dam lha// ye shes las dang 'jig rten gyi/ chos skyong srung ma dam tshig can// gnas bdag yul bdag dkar phyogs skyong*// ma lus ji snyed gtso 'khor la// phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod tshogs dang*// nyer spyod bdun dang 'dod yon lnga// bkra shis rdzas rtags rgyal srid bdun// rin chen gser skyems bda' dgu'i phud// lha mi'i longs spyod dkor nor dbyig /mgyogs 'gro g.yag lug ra gsum sogs// so sor dgyes pa skyed byed pa'i// bzang zhing sna tshogs dud sprin zer// phyogs kun khyab par spro ba las// 'dod dgu'i dpal 'byor mi zad pa// 'bul bzhes dgyes pa bskang gyur cig /rab 'byams rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor lha// ma lus bdag gis bstod par bgyi// de ltar mchod bstod bskul ba'i mthus// ye shes las dang 'jig rten skyong*// lha tshogs 'khor dang yang 'khor la// snyigs ma'i 'gro rnams 'chol spyod kyi// ma rig dbang gyur nyes pa'i tshogs// bshags so bzod bzhes dag tshangs stsol// mi gtsang nyams grib bsang nas kyang*// lha zhal zla ltar dkar gyur cig /rnal 'byor bcol pa'i phrin las ni// sangs rgyas bstan pa gnyan po srungs// rdo rje slob dpon slob mar bcas// dge 'dun sde skyong sgrub pa po'i// tshe bsod ye shes 'byor ba rgyas// nad gdon bar chad zhi la sogs// rnam bzhi phrin las gang bcol ba// thogs pa med pa bsgrub par mdzod// yul khams kun tu bkra shis shing*// char chu dus 'bab lo tog legs// nad mug mtshon 'khrugs mi mthun zhi// rdzogs ldan bskal pa ji bzhin du// skye 'gro bde skyid ldan pa yi// don gnyis lhun gyis grub nas su// bkra shis dpal 'bar phun tshogs shog

/ dad dam ldan pa sngags 'chang a bkra'i ngor spel ba dge// / ༈ rgyam rdo ti gangs dkar gnyan po'i gsol mchod phrin bcol las bzhi myur 'grub bzhugs/ na mo pad+mā ka ra ye/ 'dir rgyam rgyal rdo ti badz+ra dhā dza'i gsol mchod phrin bcol kyi rim pa spro ba dag gis/ dang po rang nyid lha'i bskyed rim/ dkon mchog spyi 'dus gu ru zhi ba spros med rgyun gyi nyams len sgang du dril ba ni/ sngon 'gro la/ srung 'khor/ hrī: bdag nyid 'gyur med ye nas rdo rje'i sku: phyi nang snod bcud gzhal yas skye 'gro lha: phyogs dang phyogs mtshams 'ja' 'od mtshon chas gtams: rdo rje'i sa gzhi rwa gur me ris bskor: oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa dz+wa la raṃ: skyabs sems: oṃ āḥhūm̐ḥ skyabs gnas dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o: rgyud drug 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i pha ma rnams: bzod med gdung bas sangs rgyas thob bya'i phyir: kun kyang byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed do: lan gsum/ dngos gzhi la/ skad cig dran rdzogs kyi bskyed rim/ hrī: bdag nyid tha mal rang sems bzo med 'di: dkon mchog spyi 'dus pad+ma 'od 'bar sku: dkar gsal mdangs lnga mdzes 'dzum rgyan gyis spras: rdo rje thod pa tshe bum rin chen brgyan: pad zhu rgod ldem kha ṭ+wām̐ g.yon nas 'khril: phod ka chos gos za 'og ber phyam can: mtshan dpes rab brgyan 'od kyi dkyil 'khor mdzes: mnyam nyid bde chen 'khyil pa'i skyil krung bzhugs: 'od kyi lus la ye shes snying po can: gsal stong thugs rje'i 'od zer kun la snyoms: mkha' 'gro 'ja' sprin rnam mang 'khrigs pa'i dbus: sku yi sprul pas zhing khams yongs la khyab: nam mkha'i lus can gar yang thogs pa med: bde gshegs kun gyi bkod pa sku la rdzogs: kun kyang rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor zang thal la: bgegs dang bar chad ces bya'i ming yang med: snang stong sgyu ma tsam du gsal bar bskyed: ces rang gsal rig ba'i lha sku dang ye shes dbyer med gdod nas ye bzhugs chen por mos pas bzlas par 'jug

/gal te spros pa la dga' na rnam pa sgyu ma lta bur spyan 'dren byin 'bebs dang mchod bstod tsam bya/ de min mi dgos so// 'on kyang mngon rtogs grub nas/ tshig bdun gsol 'debs rgyas par spyan 'dren ltar ram/ yang na/ hūm̐: o rgyan yul gyi nub byang mtshams: pad+ma ge sar sdong po la: ya mtshan mchog gi dngos grub brnyes: pad+ma 'byung gnas zhes su grags: 'khor du mkha' 'gro mang pos bskor: khyed kyi rjes su bdag sgrub kyi: byin gyis rlobs phyir gshegs su gsol: gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: zhes pa ste gang rung dmigs pa dang bcas tshar kha shas kyis bskul zhing byin phabs: phyag 'tshal ba ni: na mo skye 'gag 'gyur med phrin las rdzogs: rang byung thugs rjes 'gro rnams sgrol: yid bzhin dngos grub char 'bebs pa'i: pad+ma 'od 'bar sku la phyag 'tshal lo: mchod pa ni/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ/ pad+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhu pe/ ā lo ke/ gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ye/ shab+da pra tīts+tsha āḥhūm̐ḥ ma hā pañca/ ma hā rak+ta/ ma hā ba ling ta khā hiḥ bstod pa ni/ hrī: rgyal ba thams cad ye shes klong du gcig: chos nyid don la cha lugs mi mnga' yang: thabs mkhas gang 'dul so so'i skur ston pa: thugs rje'i sprul bsgyur 'gyed la phyag 'tshal bstod: de nas dzab kyi dmigs pa gsal btab ste/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐ḥ zhes bzlas pa ci nus grag stong bsam brjod bral ba'i ngang du byed la/ gnyis pa rang nyid lha yi nga rgyal brtan po'i ngang nas gzhi gnas bdag po rnams mdun du bskyed pa'i rim pa ni/ mchod rdzas rnams/

a kā ra ོsa lan gsum gyi byin gyis brlabs nas bran la/ kyai/ 'phags mchog thugs rje chen pos byin brlabs gnas// mdo khams gling khri bar ma'i nor 'dzin gzhi// skyong zhing rgyal bstan spel pa'i lha chen po// rig 'dzin pad+ma'i bka' nyan dam tshig can// sa brgyad dbang phyug byang chub sems ldan pa// gnas chen drug gi yul gzhi gnas bdag gtso// dge bsnyen rdo rje rgyal mtshan zhes bya ba// kun+da ltar dkar zhi 'dzum brjid chags shing*// dbu la dung rmog sku la dung khrab dang*// ber dkar gsol zhing phyag g.yas rgyal mtshan 'phyar// g.yon pas gter bum 'dzin cing rta dkar chibs// dar dang rin chen sga srab mdzes pas spras// rang 'dra'i sprul pa brgyad brgyad 'khor yang 'khor// bye ba 'bum sdes bskor ba'i dbus su gsal// bar snang ga ru ḍa dang 'brug seng 'phyo// g.yag dkar zhol can rgya stag phyi nas 'brang*// rin chen 'byung gnas sa mu dra yi klong*// 'ja' zer 'od du 'khyil pa'i gur khang dbus// mtsho sman nor bu 'od ldan 'dzum mdzes dkar// dbu skra thor tshugs nor bu rin chen rgyan// dar dkar ber gsol phyag g.yas mda' dar g.yob// g.yon pas me long 'dzin cing g.yu 'brug zhon// bstan pa'i mel tshe rnal 'byor bu ltar brtse// lha sman brgya rtsa brgyad kyis bskor bar gsal// dug gi mtsho chen khol zhing 'bar ba'i dbus// klu bdud kha la rak+ṣa mthu bo che// dud kha dbu dgu rtsa zhal chu srin gdong*// khro gtum mche gtsigs ljags bskyod zhal lhag ma// sbrul mgo brgyad kyang gdug pa'i dug rlangs 'phyo// sku stod mi la sku smad sbrul mjug can// lus kun mig gang phyag g.yas spu gri 'phyar// g.yon pas dgra snying sbrul zhags 'dzin bzhin tu// chu srin la zhon bu yug thog ser 'bebs// klu bdud nag po 'bum sdes bskor bar gsal// gzhan yang lha chen mched lcam dgyes sde mo// phyi nang blon 'khor dkar po'i phyogs skyong ba// dpag med char sprin 'khrigs bzhin gsal ba yi// gnas gsum 'bru gsum 'od dang rang nyid lha'i// thugs ka'i 'od zer 'phro 'dus rang gnas nas// spyan drangs dam tshig ye shes dbyer med gyur// oṃ bhū mi pa ti badz+ra dh+wa dza sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥ

dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ zhes spyan drangs la bzhugs gsol dang dam sbrags bstod phyag ni/ rin chen dar zab la sogs khri steng du// rang rang 'tshams pa'i gdan la bzhugs su gsol// sngon tshe o rgyan chen po pad+ma 'byung*// snang srid zil gnon karma pak+shi dang*// ma ti rat+na'i drung du dam bcas ltar// rdo rje'i tha tshig rjes su dran par mdzod// badz+ra sa ma ya rak+ṣan+tu/ sangs rgyas bstan srung rnal 'byor bu ltar skyongs// bden pa mthong ba'i dge bsnyen yal gam can// yab yum sras lcam 'khor dang yang sprul bcas// rdzu 'phrul thogs med rtsal ldan rnams la bstod// de nas mchod pa 'bul ba ni// bsang rdzas dang mchod pa rnams slar yang bran la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥhrīḥ lan gsum/ kyai/ bsang khang rin chen dkar zlum nang*// tsan+dan dkar dmar a ga ru// g.yu shug bal bu la sogs pa'i// bzang shing sna tshogs dud sprin 'khrigs// de las bkra shis rdzas rtags brgyad// rgyal po la 'os rin chen bdun// lha klu mi yi longs spyod kyi// 'dod dgu sna tshogs char bzhin 'bebs// gzhan yang mchod pa'i bye brag ni// dag gtsang ya na lag brgyad ldan chab// chu dang thang skyes me tog tshal// sman mchog ji snyed spos ngad ldir// snang zhing gsal byed 'od du 'bar// dri bzang byug pa'i lde gu dang*// lha yi zhal zas ro brgya ldan// dbyangs snyan rol mo'i bye brag ldir// 'dod yon mchod rdzas rnam pa lnga// phye mar dza gad rin chen skyems// sna tshogs phud sna mang po dang*// skong rten sgrub cing mchod pa'i rdzas// ma tshang med pa tshar du dngar// go cha mtshon cha dar zab gos// spyan gzigs dkor chas dpag tu med// gtso 'khor dgyes pa skyed byed pa// nam mkha' mdzod kyi rang bzhin can// mchod do 'bul lo dgyes par rol// oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhūpe/ ā lo ke/ gan+dhe/ nai wid+ya/ shab+da āḥhūm̐/ rū pa/

shab+da/ gan+dhe/ rā sa/ spar+she pra tits+tsha swā hā/ de nas bstod pa/ kye hoḥ dzam gling byang phyogs char brten pa'i// gangs ri shel dkar spungs 'dra sogs// gnas mchog dam par mnga' dbang bsgyur// srid pa'i lha chen dpal 'bar ba// 'jig rten skyong ba yongs kyi rje// dkar po lha yi sde dpon mchog /nag po bdud kyi kha gnon te// dge bsnyen chen po khyod la bstod// bdud rtsi lta bu'i rgya mtsho la// gnas bcas ma yis bu bzhin skyong*// bzhin mdzes mtshar sdug lang tsho can// nor bu 'od ldan ma la bstod// 'jigs rung dug mtsho khol dbus su// ma rungs dgra bgegs yongs kyi gshed// klu bdud gdol pa lag ring zhes// klu rgyal drag po'i rtsal ldan bstod// gzhan yang mched brgyad lcam dral dang*// btsun mo blon 'bangs sprul yang sprul// bsam mi khyab pa'i 'khor tshogs la// dang ba'i yid kyis bstod par bgyi// zhes bstod la/ bsnyen pa ni/ rang lhar gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ 'od kyis yul lha'i snying ga'i sa bon mthar sngags phreng la thim pas las bzhi'i phrin las 'grub par mos la/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra dhā dza hūm̐/ bzlas mthar/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra dhā dza ma ma rak+ṣa ku ru ye swā hā/ a yuḥpuṇ+ye sid+dhi hūm̐/ zhes kyang bzlas la/ 'di skabs gtor 'bul gter gzhung bzhin/ kyai/ dad pa dang ni sogs gtso 'khor gsum gyi gtor 'bul phrin bcol rnams bton la/ mnga' gsol dang bskang ba ni/ hrīḥ kun bzang dpal chen pad+ma thod phreng gi /bka' nyan gsung sdod lha yi lha mchog khyod// sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung phyir mnga' gsol lo// phyi nang gsang gsum mchod pas thugs dam bskang*// dus gsum rgyal kun phrin las gsang mdzod 'dzin// dpal ldan karma pa yi sgrub brgyud kyi// ring lugs phyogs mthar spel phyir mnga' gsol lo// skong rten sgrub rdzas tshogs kyis thugs dam bskang*// nges don snying po'i zab gsang gzhung 'dzin cing*// chos spyod bcu dang 'khor lo gnyis kyi bdag

/bstan 'dzin dge 'dun sde skyong mnga' gsol lo// spyan gzigs dkor chas sna tshogs thugs dam bskang*// dge bcu dang len gtan gyi 'dun ma sgrub// dkon mchog sri zhu lhag blos khur 'degs pa'i// rgyu sbyor don gnyis 'grub phyir mnga' gsol lo// mnyes rdzas mchod sprin rgya mtshos thugs dam bskang*// de ltar mnga' gsol thugs dam bskang ba'i mthus// bdag rgyud nyes gsum dri mas bslad pa yis// nongs par gyur kun mthol bshags bzod par bzhes// byang dag tshangs pa'i dngos grub stsal du gsol// yig brgya brjod/ phye mar dang skyems phud nam mkhar mchod/ de nas phrin las bcol ba ni/ hūm̐/ che mchog he ru ka dpal thod phreng rtsal// srid gsum zil gnon dbang drag 'bar ba yi// spyan sngar sngon tshe dam bca' ma g.yel bar// zo dor gnyan po sras 'khor dgongs su gsol// bskal bzang rnam 'dren bcom ldan shākya seng*// mtsho skyes pad+ma'i ring lugs mdo sngags bstan// phyogs dang tha grur khyab cing yun du gnas// bstan 'dzin zhabs brtan dge 'dun sde rgyas mdzod// rig 'dzin sgrub pa'i rnal 'byor dam ldan gyi// tshe bsod dpal 'byor ye shes snang ba rgyas// gang bcol 'dod don phrin las rnam pa bzhi// chos bzhin bsam pa 'grub pa'i sdong grogs mdzod// dad gsum lhag pa'i bsam sbyor ma smad pa'i// blo ldan yon gyi bdag po'i 'gal rkyen sol// mthun rkyen yid bzhin lhun gyis grub nas su// byang chub lam gyi bar chad zhi bar mdzod// rgyal khams bde zhing nad mug mtshon 'khrugs zhi// lo legs 'bru 'phel rta phyugs rkang bzhi bde// dgra rkun jag sogs mi mthun gnod pa bral// gnas skabs mthar thug dga' bde'i dpal spyod mdzod// bstan la sdang ba'i dgra bgegs mi mi min// bsam sbyor log par 'dren pa'i duṣ+ṭan rnams// lhag ma rjes shul ming tsam med pa ru// thal ba'i rdul bzhin brlag par mdzad du gsol// dam rdzas brgyan pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la// rnal 'byor bcol pa'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod//

ces bskul/ gtor 'bul/ de nas rjes kyi rim pa ni/ de ltar bsang gsol mchod cing bstod pa'i mthus// yul bdag mchog dman bar ma'i mgron rnams la// snyigs dus skye bo nyon mongs dbang gyur pas// chos min log par spyod pa'i mi gtsang grib// dam grib dme grib yug grib la sogs dang*// sdig pa'i sa bon nyes med ri dwags bshor// thab mkhon gzhob kyis mnol zhing bying rmugs 'thib// grib rigs thams cad byang dag sangs gyur cig /sa g.yos chu 'brub zhugs 'bar skyi bser 'tshubs// 'byung bzhi'i gnod pa rang sar zhi bar mdzod// gzhi byes kun tu 'go ba'i dgra bla dang*// dpung grogs rgyab brten mel tshe ma g.yel kye// bsang gis mi sangs khrus kyis mi dag med// lha zhal zla ltar dkar zhing gsal gyur cig /stong nyid zab mo'i don rtogs byang sems kyis// rgyud smin grol nas bdud bzhi'i g.yul las rgyal// bsam don yid bzhin 'grub pa'i bkra shis gang*// bkra shis des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog / ces shis pa'i me tog gi char bsnyil bar bya'o// slar yang*/ sangs rgyas bstan srung dkon mchog dbu 'phang bstod// dge 'dun sde skyongs rnal 'byor tshe dpal spel// snyan pa'i dar phyor grags pa'i dung bus la// 'khor dang longs spyod rgyas pa nyid du mdzod// rgas med lang tsho ldan pa'i lus stobs rgyas// mig la ya mtshan ltad mo'i dga' ba dang*// rna bar rtag tu snyan pa'i gtam thos shing*// dri zhim ngad pa sna dang mi 'bral bar// zas skom 'byor pas ro 'dzin tshim byed cing*// lus la reg bya bde ba kho nas 'tsho// yid la rnam par bkra ba'i shes rab dang*// zag med bde bas nam yang ngom par mdzod// khyod gsol khyod brten khyod mchod khyod rbad na// mthu rtsal ma chung brtse gdung che bar mdzod// gzhi la bkra shis phun tshogs longs spyod ldan// byes su lam 'phrang chu la sgrol 'don mdzod// 'jigs sar dgra jag chom rkun 'tshe ba skyobs// mdor na bsam don yid bzhin 'grub par mdzod// bdag dang mtha' yas sems can thams cad kyis// bla med rdzogs pa'i byang chub bsgrub pa la// 'gal rkyen bar chad ma lus zhi ba dang*// mthun rkyen bsam don lhun gyis grub par mdzod//

ces dang*/ srid zhi'i dpal 'byor ma lus 'byung ba'i gzhi// thub pa'i bstan pa yun ring gnas pa dang*// de 'dzin byed pa'i skyes bu dam pa rnams// dpal 'byor gyis brgyan yun ring zhabs brtan shog /bdag mchis bzod par bzhes// ye shes rten bzhugs 'jig rten rang gnas gshegs// 'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa'i dge legs tshogs// gong nas gong du 'phel ba'i bkra shis shog / sogs kyang brjod/ de nas las gzhung snying po gsal byed du gsungs pa'i don gsal bar/ dpal ldan dpa' bo rdo rje gtsug lag dga' bas bsgrigs pa sarba maṅga lam̐/ slar si tu pad+ma'i ming can gyis bslab gsum rnam dag bstan pa'i phrin las kyi shing rta pa bla'o sprul sku karma āḥyu tiṣ+ṭha wan+dha'i bzhed ltar rgyas par spel ba dge bar gyur cig dza ya/ dge'o/// / ༈ bsang mchod rin chen char 'bebs bkra shis re skong bzhugs so// kyai bla ma dkon mchog rnam gsum la// sgo gsum gus pas skyabs su mchi// 'gro ba sems can kun don du// bdag gis bsang dang mchod pa bya// chos rnams stong pa'i ngang nyid las// rang nyid rdo rje gro lod sku// gshegs su gsol// gtso 'khor 'tshams pa'i gdan la bzhugs// dngos 'byor yid sprul mchod pa 'bul// yan lag drug cu'i dbyangs kyis bstod// kyai bsang gi rgyu byung gang nas byung*// grangs med bskal pa'i sngon rol nas// bcom ldan shākya thub pa nyid// rgyal po chos kyi dbang phyug gyur// de yi sangs rgyas mchod pa'i phyir// spos kyi reng bu gcig bsregs nas// sil snyan bkrol zhing bsang mchod mdzad// spos sprin na bun chen po yis// zhag bdun bar du 'dzam gling khyab// de nas bsang byung gang nas byung*// slob dpon 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis// 'dzam gling spyi bsang bsdus pa brtsams// rgya gar lha rang byung rgyal ba yis// 'dzam gling spyi yi bsang mchod mdzad// khams phyogs sa bdag klu gnyan dga'// sog gi chu la lcags zam tshugs// sngon dus srid pa de bzhin du// da lta rnal 'byor bdag cag gis// bzang shing sna tshogs bsreg pa la// 'bru sna phye mar zas phud dang*// ja chang 'o zho'i phud kyis mchod// ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ gis mi gtsang sbyangs// oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis byin gyis brlabs// dhu las lha mo bdug spos ma// mthing gsal mdzes sdug rgyan rnams rdzogs// phyag g.yas bum pas nyams grib 'khrud// g.yon pas sman spos gzhong pa bsnams// spos sprin bsang dud khams gsum khyab// rab 'byams sangs rgyas zhing rnams kun// spos kyi 'khri shing du ba 'khrigs// dud pa'i cha shas re re las// 'dod yon lnga dang rgyal srid bdun// bkra shis rdzas rtags mchod pa'i tshogs// ci 'dod longs spyod char ltar drug pa rdo rje 'chang chen = longs sku rigs lnga yab yum = sprul sku sangs rgyas stong rtsa = thub pa gnas brtan bcu drug = gu ru sku lnga mtshan brgyad = rgya gar grub chen brgyad cu = bod kyi rje 'bangs nyer lnga = lo paṇa chos rgyal thams cad = rgya bod mkhas grub thams cad = rtsa ba brgyud pa'i bla ma = mgon po tshe dpag med pa = yi dam thugs rje chen po = rgyud sde bzhi yi lha tshogs = theg pa dgu yi lha tshogs = dmar nag me phreng lha tshogs = dbang chen rta mgrin lha tshogs = bka' dgongs phur gsum lha tshogs = bde gsang 'jigs gsum lha tshogs = sgrol ma nyi shu rtsa gcig = phag khros seng gsum lha tshogs bsang*// kyai dus gsum rgyal kun 'dus pa'i dpyid// ko sha'i mtshor 'khrungs pad+ma 'byung*// ma rungs dregs pa tshar gcod phyir// khrag 'thung dbang drag 'bar ba'i sku// che mchog rdo rje gro bo lod// ye shes khro bo'i dkyil 'khor bsang*// dz+nya na ḍā ki'i gtso mchog ma// bde chen dbyings phyug mtsho rgyal yum// rdo rje drag mo seng ge'i gdong*// mkha' 'gro bye ba 'bum sde = nor bdag rmugs 'dzin dzam ser nag /las mgon trak+shad mthu bo che// yum bzhi srog bdud brgyad la sogs// bdud kyi dmag tshogs rgya mtsho bsang*// kyai 'og min byang phyogs dur khrod kyi// grong khyer sum brtsegs pho brang bdag /ma hā kā la yongs kyi rje// dpal ldan mgon po rdo rje ber// mgon chen sde bzhi 'khor bcas bsang*// ma ning mched gsum rigs lnga = mgon chen bzhi bcu rtsa lnga = byang shar yongs 'du'i ljon pa'i tshal// thod pa 'phrul gyi lding khang nas// rang byung srid rgyal mu kha le// ma gcig gnyen gyi re ma ti// dpal ldan lha mo dpon g.yog = lha mo stong dang rtsa brgyad = dpal mgon bdun cu rtsa gnyis = zhing skyong nyi shu rtsa bzhi = mkha' 'gro sum cu so gnyis = dregs pa'i sde dpon sum cu =

srog bdag dregs chen bco brgyad = nor lha rnam sras rigs brgyad = gter bdag dzam lha rigs lnga = nor rgyun lha mo mched brgyad = gnod sbyin 'brog gnas mched lnga = re man rta lha lnga brgya = zhing skyong kun dga' gzhon nu = srin mgon thod phreng yab yum = klu rgyal man+t+ra pa ti = mkhar nag rdo rje rgyal po = 'og min gnas dang ma la ya// pha wang long bu'i sku mkhar na// ye shes las dang 'jig rten gyi// dam can skyes bu rdo rje legs// mgar ba nag po dgyes sde 'khor// ging chen sde bzhi la sogs pa'i// mched zla sum brgya drug cu bcas// 'khor dang yang 'khor thams cad bsang*// ma gcig dpal gyi lha mo = a phyi chos kyi sgrol ma= bkra shis tshe ring mched lnga = bod khams brtan ma bcu gnyis = brag btsan dbang drag 'bar ba = gnyan chen thang lha yar bzhur = rma rgyal rdo rje bdud 'joms = sku lha a bo ger mdzo = sbas yul a ta rong gi char// 'bri gnyan rdo rje blo gros sogs// dkar po lha yi dge bsnyen tshogs// dam tshig can gyi zo dor bsang*// khyad par gnas 'di'i yul gzhi'i bdag /dbu che brag dkar yab yum = /sgo srung sde bzhi la sogs = /rdo rgyal mu nam mched brgyad = rmugs sangs rtse rgyal zhal da= /kyai bsil ldan bod yul bstan srung ba// pad+ma'i dge bsnyen tha tshig can// rje yi mgur lha bcu gsum = /dge bsnyen nyi shu rtsa gcig = /phyogs bzhi'i gnyan chen sde bzhi = /gnyan phran bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis= /pha mtshun dgra lha bla 'khor bcas= /khyim lha zhing lha thab lha= /bdag la 'go ba'i lha srung bsang*// 'khor 'das gnyis la gtogs pa yi// gnyug mar gnas dang glo bur mgron// ma lus lus pa med rnams bsang*// zhi ba bsang mchod 'di phul bas// grib dang mi gtsang bsang gyur cig /rnal 'byor 'dod don kun 'grub mdzod//

ces mchod gtor skyems phud phye mar 'bul la/ lam lha spro na/ kyai spyan lnga mngon shes lnga ldan rnams// lam lha dpung grogs ma g.yel bar// mthun rkyen sgrubs la 'gal rkyen sol// bde zhing dge bar bskyang du gsol// zhes dang*/ kyai rnal 'byor dam tshig mos blo rnam dag gis// rab dkar dge ba'i spyod tshul ma smad pas// mchod cing sbyin pa'i dngos po la brten nas// dkon mchog gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs pa dang*// yi dam lha yis dngos grub mchog stsol zhing*// chos skyong srung mas bar chad sel ba dang*// yul lha gnyan gyis sdong grogs rgyab rten mdzod// dgra lha bla wer mas pha rol rgol ba 'joms// rig 'dzin sgrub po'i phrin las rnam bzhi sgrubs// rgyal bstan rin chen dar zhing rgyas pa dang*// skyes mchog zhabs brtan dge 'dun 'dus pa mthun// ye shes yon tan dpal dang 'byor pa 'phel// char chu dus 'bab lo phyugs rtag tu legs// mi nad phyugs nad yams nad 'khrugs rtsod zhi// 'jig rten khams kun bde legs snang bas khyab// rdzogs ldan gsar pa'i lang tsho ngom par mdzod// ces phrin las bcol nas/ g.yang len bya ba ni/ kyai srid zhi phun tshogs 'byung gnas gter// rtsa brgyud bla ma'i thugs rje dang*// yi dam dpa' bo mkha' 'gro yi// dngos grub rten 'brel dam pa rnams// khu ye phywa dang g.yang du len// rnal 'byor rig 'dzin mchog brnyes shog /dam can chos skyong drag rtsal dang*// dkar phyogs lha yi gzi byin dang*// dgra lha bla wer ma'i stobs rtsal rnams// khu ye phywa dang g.yang du len// nus mthu'i dpal du 'bar ba dang*// 'bad med phrin las ldan par shog /gzhan yang srid pa'i che dgu yi// snyan grags dbang thang 'byor ba stobs// rma g.yang longs spyod zas nor 'bru// rkang bzhi phyugs kyi 'phen g.yang rnams// khu ye phywa dang g.yang du len// mi 'dzad nam mkha'i mdzod thob shog
